chapters.title: Chapter 1303: The Sky Pillar Domain
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Sky Pillar Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

The Sky Pillar Domain is the most advanced domain in the Paradise Realm; it represents the peak of civilization in the Paradise Realm: a place where science, cultivation, technology, and creativity merge seamlessly. The domain’s growth is simply astonishing, leaving other domains far behind in progress and sophistication.
The Sky Pillar Domain constructs its cities with self-sustaining energy systems, floating transport networks, and advanced formations that control almost everything within the domain.

Medical technology in the Sky Pillar Domain can heal almost any injury or disease instantly, combining cultivation methods with advanced science. Alchemy has evolved into a perfect fusion of modern alchemy and cultivation methods, producing peak-level potions, pills, serums, and materials that provide many benefits to its inhabitants or visiting cultivators.

In blacksmithing, the Sky Pillar Domain forges weapons and equipment using materials refined and reinforced by various types of formation arrays. Their blacksmiths and artifact crafters design and build tools, armor, and many other things that are useful for daily or special needs.
Various kinds of formation arrays are deeply integrated into everything—from architecture and agriculture to defense, ensuring efficiency and security throughout the entire domain.

The Sky Pillar Domain possesses the most advanced and impenetrable defense system in the entire Paradise Realm. In case of attack, the domain’s Shield Array will activate instantly, forming a massive layered barrier that can absorb, nullify, and reverse both physical and qi-based attacks.
"Where is the best hospital in this domain?" Zhang Fei asked Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan, as both of them were natives of the Sky Pillar Domain.
Fei Yinglin looked at Zhang Fei. "Did you or any of your wives sustain any injuries?"

"Not injured." Zhang Fei put his arm around Mu Lingshu’s shoulders. "Lingshu was born with a Stone Body. I’ve asked Tian Yishen and Xiao Laoshu to repair her body, but they still haven’t found a solution. I’ve tried several ways to cure her myself, but none of my methods have worked. I brought her here because you mentioned that this domain is the most advanced in the entire Paradise Realm, and I hope to find a cure for her. She’s been suffering for decades, so it doesn’t matter how much it costs; I’ll pay it as long as they can cure her."
Mu Lingshu didn’t say anything, but she smiled happily because Zhang Fei had never forgotten her body condition, and she had tried various ways to cure her.

"Over there, Elder Zhang." You Shiyan pointed towards the east. "This domain has numerous hospitals, but the best of the best doctors live in Lianxu City in the east, and both of them come from the Zhi Clan."
"The Zhi Clan?"

You Shiyan nodded at Zhang Fei. "The Zhi Clan leads the Lianxu City, and their status is equal to my You Clan. They are the best medical clan, and they have many doctors, but the best among them are Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen. Therefore, we have to go there to meet them, and who knows, they may be able to cure your wife."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Don’t you two want to return to your two clans?"
"Haha." You Shiyan scratched his head. "Elder Zhang, Feiling and I are outcasts from our two clans, so we won’t go back there, or they will chase us out as soon as we set foot there."
"Where are your two clans located? What are the professions of your two clans?"
"My You Clan lives in Tianzhu City in the northeast, and my clan focuses on swordsmithing." You Shiyan pointed his index finger in that direction.

Meanwhile, Fei Yinglin pointed to the southwest. "My Fei Clan lives in Cangyun City, which is located in that direction. We do not focus on one area, but we focus on several areas, such as artifact crafting, formation arrays, and advanced technology."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at You Shiyan. "Why does your family only focus on forging swords? Since they are blacksmiths, they should be able to forge other weapons or equipment, right?"

"Elder Zhang, I don’t know how that happened, but my clan members have never managed to forge weapons other than swords." Zhang Fei found it difficult to believe You Shiyan’s answer, especially since he himself was a supreme-rank blacksmith. "I’m not lying to you, Elder Zhang. In the past, my father had often tried forging other weapons, but the results were always disappointing, so he stopped trying and focused on swords."
"That’s weird." Zhang Fei looked northeast, rubbing his chin in thought. "Since we’re going to Lianxu City in the east, we’ll stop by your clan after I meet Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen."
"But—"

Zhang Fei stopped You Shiyan instantly. "Don’t worry, they won’t dare chase you away as long as I’m with you. You know that I’m a supreme-rank blacksmith, right? I’m curious about the strangeness of your clan members, so I want to meet them to see their blacksmithing abilities. After that, we’ll go to the Fei Clan because I want to find formation arrays for our sect, and I also need some materials to create a teleportation portal."
"Don’t you already have a teleportation portal like the one you use to connect our sect with the Blazing Union Sect, Elder Zhang?" Fei Yinglin asked in confusion.

Zhang Fei took out his teleportation portal. "This one can only connect two places in the same realm, and the distance between the two realms cannot be too far. Therefore, I want to create a new portal that will connect this Paradise Realm with the Three Mortal Realms.

"What?" Fei Yinglin screamed in shock. "Are you serious about creating such a teleportation portal, Elder Zhang? Actually, my clan has been trying to create one for a long time, but they have never succeeded. According to my grandfather, they failed not because of a failure in their device, but because the barrier that separates the two realms prevented them."

"The barrier, huh?" Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "When I was on my way from the Three Mortal Realms to this realm, I tried checking the barrier, and it was truly powerful. However, I believe there is a gap that we can use to connect the two realms; otherwise, those tunnels wouldn’t exist, right?"

Fei Yinglin let out a soft sigh. "Elder Zhang, I’ve never passed through those tunnels or been to the Three Mortal Realms before, but I heard that those tunnels weren’t man-made, and they were created naturally when the barrier separating the two realms appeared."
"Whatever happens, I want to try creating one first; failure or success, we will see the results in the future." Zhang Fei then took Mu Lingshu and his other wives to fly east.

Fei Yinglin could only shake her head at Zhang Fei’s stubbornness, but Xu Ling’er immediately spoke to her. "My big brother is always like that, Senior Sister Fei. If he has an idea, he’ll try everything until he reaches a dead end, so you don’t need to be confused by his attitude."
"Let’s follow them." Fei Yinglin brought Xu Ling’er to catch up with Zhang Fei and the others, followed by You Shiyan, who seemed to be thinking about something beside them.
Sometime later, they arrived at Lianxu City. Unlike other domains, they had to pay a hefty entrance fee to enter the city, and the guards gave them badges that had to be returned each time they left.
"Tch! Those people are extorting my money!" Zhang Fei grumbled while sniffing the thick smell of herbs and pills that wafted from various corners of the city.

Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan laughed at Zhang Fei’s grumbling. "Elder Zhang, we not only have to pay entrance fees for this city but also for all the cities in this domain, and the fee amount varies based on each city’s classification. This Lianxu City has the most expensive entrance fee compared to most cities, and there are only five other cities where the entrance fee is as expensive as here. Thus, ordinary cultivators will never seek treatment in this city, as the entrance fee is too expensive for them."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei led them toward the Zhi Clan residence while looking at the shops they passed along the way. He found some interesting items in some of the shops, but the prices were simply exorbitant, and he was reluctant to waste gold coins on them. ’What do you think if I open a shop here, Mei?’

[Master, I know you want to collect as many jewels as possible, but you’re just asking for trouble if you open a shop in this city. In this city, dozens of cultivators have reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable stage, and five of them are members of the Zhi Clan. Your pills, especially the ones you bought from the system, have extremely potent effects. If you sell them here, those old fogeys will definitely be jealous of you, and they might cause you a lot of trouble.]
’Yeah, you’re right.’
Before long, they arrived in front of the Zhi Clan, but the guards stopped them. Zhang Fei could see that they were glaring at Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan, and their eyes showed disgust.
One of them spoke to Zhang Fei. "Young master, you and all your women can enter our clan, but we do not welcome the presence of the two outcasts from the Fei and You Clans."

chapters.title: Chapter 1304: The Zhi Clan
paragraphs: "Elder Zhang—"
Zhang Fei stopped Fei Yinglin, but the way she addressed him shocked the guards from the Zhi Clan. After all, he was still young, and his cultivation was only at the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm.

Zhang Fei didn’t care much about the guards’ gazes at him, and he spoke to them directly. "So, this is how the Zhi Clan treats their guests, huh? I do need treatment for one of my wives, but I will never accept it if anyone insults my disciples."
"Young master, we—" The guards’ eyes widened as soon as Zhang Fei took out his alchemy badge. "God... god rank alchemist!"

"Heh! Not even Jin Nanqing dares to be presumptuous in front of me, yet mere guards like you guys dare to insult my disciples!" Zhang Fei placed his badge back in his inventory before turning to leave while hugging Mu Lingzhu’s waist. "Lingzhu, I will definitely find a cure for you, but we don’t need to ask for help from arrogant doctors like them. Arrogant doctors will never be able to cure their patients, and they will only make their illnesses worse."
Mu Lingzhu nodded at him. "It’s okay; I’ve lived with this condition for decades, so it doesn’t matter if I have to wait a little longer."
"Let’s go, Big Brother! There are many doctors in this domain; I’m sure one of them can cure Big Sis Lingshu." Xu Ling’er hugged Zhang Fei’s arm, pulling him and Mu Lingzhu away from the Zhi Clan.
Luo Yunxiao, Wu Lianzhi, Zhang Lin, Ning Zhuan’er, and some other women looked at the guards, who were still stunned, before following them.
Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan exchanged glances for a moment before sighing softly, and the two of them hurriedly caught up with Zhang Fei and the others.
After they had gone far enough, one of the guards rushed into their clan to report to their leaders about Zhang Fei.
"Elder Zhang, you—"

"No need, Yinglin." Zhang Fei stopped Fei Yinglin again. "I do need their help to try to cure Lingzhu’s condition, but our dignity is paramount. You two are my disciples, so I will never allow anyone to insult you, as it’s no different from insulting me and our sect."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled and spoke to her. "Yinglin, my husband has always been like this, so you don’t need to be surprised by his decision. Those guards will report to their leaders about him, and I’m sure one of them will come to see us soon, especially after they learn of his status as a god-rank alchemist. No matter how weak his cultivation is, no one dares to underestimate a god-rank alchemist. Moreover, doctors and alchemists are quite closely related, so I’m sure they won’t waste the opportunity to build a relationship with him."
Fei Yinglin was aware of this, but she felt guilty that Zhang Fei had missed the chance to meet with the Zhi Clan due to her and her partner’s presences.
"So, where is the second-best medical clan in this domain?"
"Elder Zhang, they also live in this city." You Shiyan then pointed to the house far ahead of them. "The Qiao Clan is the best medical clan after the Zhi Clan, and Qiao Yisheng is their best doctor."
Zhang Fei looked at the residence and checked it through the map, where he found Qiao Yisheng together with many people. "Let’s go there."
Since the two clans weren’t too far, they quickly arrived at the Qiao Clan. However, the guards asked them to wait because the line ahead of them was still long.
Unlike the guards of the Zhi Clan, the guards of the Qiao Clan only glanced at Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan, and they didn’t say anything about the two, let alone insult them.

Zhang Fei didn’t show his alchemist badge to them, and he brought all his wives to wait in line at the teahouse in front of the Qiao Clan. You Shiyan and Fei Yinglin didn’t join them, and they queued in his stead.
At the Zhi Clan, the guard arrived at a room where a middle-aged man was chatting and joking with a middle-aged woman. "Patriarch Zhi Qingshong! Madam Nie Shuyin!"
"Hmm?" Zhi Qingshong looked at the guard and asked, "What happened? Why are you in such a hurry?"
The guard immediately informed the two of the arrival of Zhang Fei and his entourage, and he also told them about his status as a god-rank alchemist, which shocked both of them.

"Are you sure his alchemist badge is genuine?" Nie Shuyin doubtfully asked. "If what you say is true and he is still that young, then he shouldn’t have reached that stage. At least, he needs hundreds or even thousands of years to reach it."
"Madam, I don’t know whether his alchemist badge is genuine or not, but he dares to mention Senior Jin Nanqing’s name without his title."
Nie Shuyin raised an eyebrow after hearing the name from the guard because Jin Nanqing was the best male alchemist in the Paradise Realm, and everyone respected him greatly, including their Zhi Clan.

Zhi Qingshong immediately spoke to Nie Shuyin. "Wife, contact your Nie Clan members in the Divine Samsara Sect and ask them to see Jin Nanqing or his disciples. This way, we can confirm the authenticity of that young man’s status, and I will go see him myself if he is truly a god-rank alchemist."
"Okay." Nie Shuyin followed her husband’s orders directly.
Zhi Qingshong then asked the guard. "Where are they now?"
"Patriarch, that young man wants to find doctors to treat one of his wives, so—"
"The Qiao Clan." Zhi Qingshong spread his senses toward the clan to look for Zhang Fei and the others.
Even though they had never met before, the guard’s previous explanation made it easy for Zhi Qingshong to find Zhang Fei and his party at the teahouse in front of the Qiao Clan.

However, Zhi Qingshong’s expression turned to shock as soon as Zhang Fei repelled his senses and tracked him back. ’What the hell? How could such a young cultivator like him do that?’ "Go back to your post."
"Yes, Patriarch."

After waiting for some time, Nie Shuyin informed Zhi Qingshong of the answer from the Nie Clan members. "Husband, Jin Nanqing was out with Liang Huizhong, so they didn’t meet him. However, they met Luo Lianjin there, who informed them that a young alchemist had indeed reached the god-rank level. According to him, his name was Zhang Fei, and he was the one who tested him during his alchemist rank test. However, he forbade him to publicize his status, so not many people knew about him."
"Zhang Fei? The Zhang Clan from the Starfall Martial Domain?" Zhi Qingshong looked at Nie Shuyin with disbelief.

Nie Shuyin shook her head at Zhi Qingshong. "According to Luo Lianjin, Zhang Fei has no relationship with the Zhang Clan from the Starfall Martial Domain, and he ascended to this realm several years ago. But—"

"But what?" Nie Shuyin immediately told Zhi Qingshong some of the information that the Nie Clan members had gotten from Luo Lianjin. "Is that true? Does Zhang Fei really have connections with Empress Huo?"

Nie Shuyin nodded to Zhi Qingshong. "Empress Huo never hid her identity, and she accompanied Zhang Fei to the Forbidden Land back then. Additionally, he married the only daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi shortly after he ascended to this realm, so he is the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."
"Did they tell you any other information about Zhang Fei?"

Nie Shuyin released a soft sigh. "Luo Lianjin also told them that Zhang Fei was an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he changed the sect completely. That sect was no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal sect, and he brought many talented people to join the sect."
"Talented people?"

Zhang Fei stopped Fei Yinglin, but the way she addressed him shocked the guards from the Zhi Clan.
After all, he was still young, and his cultivation was only at the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm.
Zhang Fei didn’t care much about the guards’ gazes at him, and he spoke to them directly.
"So, this is how the Zhi Clan treats their guests, huh?
I do need treatment for one of my wives, but I will never accept it if anyone insults my disciples."
"Young master, we—" The guards’ eyes widened as soon as Zhang Fei took out his alchemy badge.
"God... god rank alchemist!"
"Heh!

Not even Jin Nanqing dares to be presumptuous in front of me, yet mere guards like you guys dare to insult my disciples!" Zhang Fei placed his badge back in his inventory before turning to leave while hugging Mu Lingzhu’s waist.
"Lingzhu, I will definitely find a cure for you, but we don’t need to ask for help from arrogant doctors like them.
Arrogant doctors will never be able to cure their patients, and they will only make their illnesses worse."
Mu Lingzhu nodded at him.
"It’s okay; I’ve lived with this condition for decades, so it doesn’t matter if I have to wait a little longer."
"Let’s go, Big Brother!
There are many doctors in this domain; I’m sure one of them can cure Big Sis Lingshu." Xu Ling’er hugged Zhang Fei’s arm, pulling him and Mu Lingzhu away from the Zhi Clan.
Luo Yunxiao, Wu Lianzhi, Zhang Lin, Ning Zhuan’er, and some other women looked at the guards, who were still stunned, before following them.
Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan exchanged glances for a moment before sighing softly, and the two of them hurriedly caught up with Zhang Fei and the others.
After they had gone far enough, one of the guards rushed into their clan to report to their leaders about Zhang Fei.
"Elder Zhang, you—"
"No need, Yinglin." Zhang Fei stopped Fei Yinglin again.
"I do need their help to try to cure Lingzhu’s condition, but our dignity is paramount.
You two are my disciples, so I will never allow anyone to insult you, as it’s no different from insulting me and our sect."
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled and spoke to her.
"Yinglin, my husband has always been like this, so you don’t need to be surprised by his decision.
Those guards will report to their leaders about him, and I’m sure one of them will come to see us soon, especially after they learn of his status as a god-rank alchemist.
No matter how weak his cultivation is, no one dares to underestimate a god-rank alchemist.
Moreover, doctors and alchemists are quite closely related, so I’m sure they won’t waste the opportunity to build a relationship with him."

"Elder Zhang, they also live in this city." You Shiyan then pointed to the house far ahead of them.
"The Qiao Clan is the best medical clan after the Zhi Clan, and Qiao Yisheng is their best doctor."
Zhang Fei looked at the residence and checked it through the map, where he found Qiao Yisheng together with many people.
"Let’s go there."

Unlike the guards of the Zhi Clan, the guards of the Qiao Clan only glanced at Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan, and they didn’t say anything about the two, let alone insult them.
Zhang Fei didn’t show his alchemist badge to them, and he brought all his wives to wait in line at the teahouse in front of the Qiao Clan.
You Shiyan and Fei Yinglin didn’t join them, and they queued in his stead.
At the Zhi Clan, the guard arrived at a room where a middle-aged man was chatting and joking with a middle-aged woman.
"Patriarch Zhi Qingshong!
Madam Nie Shuyin!"

Why are you in such a hurry?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1305: Qiao Yisheng
paragraphs: *Tap... Tap... Tap...*
After waiting for some time, Luo Lianjin finally arrived at the Zhi Clan. He didn’t come alone but with Xuan Yun, and they went to meet Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin. "Where is Zhang Fei now?"
"Unfortunately, Zhang Fei isn’t here, Lianjin." Nie Shuyin immediately explained the situation to them.
"Haish!" Luo Lianjin’s reaction confused Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin. "Your guard has made a fatal mistake."
"What do you mean by that?" Zhi Qingshong asked.

Luo Lianjin let out a soft sigh. "You don’t know him, but I know his character well enough. I’ve been to his sect several times and seen him interact with the people there, so I can say that your chances of establishing a relationship with him are zero. He never cares about status, and he considers the people in his sect to be his family. If you insult them, it’s the same as insulting him, and he has no interest in associating with such people."

"Lianjin, you can’t blame us, right?" Luo Lianjin nodded to Nie Shuyin. "Everyone in this domain hates dual cultivators very much, which has been going on since the era of our ancestors. This task has been passed down from generation to generation, and our guards are just carrying out their duties as usual. Moreover, Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan should have already explained to him about the situation in this domain, and if he was smart, he wouldn’t have brought them to our clan because they would get such a welcome."

"Regardless, I can’t help you build a relationship with Zhang Fei. You don’t need to think about asking my master for help either, as he won’t be able to help you after that incident." Both Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin frowned at Luo Lianjin. "Do you think a man who has such a favorable relationship with Empress Huo will care about my master’s status? Not to mention, he is not only a god-rank alchemist, but he is also a god-rank swordmaster and supreme-rank blacksmith."
"What?" Both Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin screamed in shock. "Are you kidding us? How could Zhang Fei achieve all that in just a few decades?"

Luo Lianjin shook his head at them. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei was able to achieve all that, but that’s the truth. Even the sword maniac Jian Kuang and the speed demon Shu Shentian have great respect for him, and they voluntarily stayed in his sect to train his disciples."

Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin stared at Luo Lianjin with wide eyes, as they both knew that Jian Kuang and Shu Shentian were rogue cultivators. They had never been interested in siding with anyone, but they had willingly chosen to help Zhang Fei.

Luo Lianjin spoke to them again. "Like the people in this domain, Liang Huizhong has never liked dual cultivators, and he has always looked down on them and despised them. However, he began to change his mind after he learned of the changes to the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he began to consider collaborating with them because of Zhang Fei’s presence. Not only him, but several other sects and clans who previously disliked dual cultivators have also considered establishing relations with them."

"How did Jian Kuang and Shu Shentian know Zhang Fei? How did Zhang Fei convince them to help him? What exactly happened that made those clans and sects start considering cooperating with the Moonlite Passion Temple?" Nie Shuyin curiously asked.

"Their first meeting was at the auction in the Forbidden Land, and their second meeting was in the Endless Night Dungeon. The two of you didn’t send your representatives at that time, so you don’t know some of the events that happened in both places at that time." Luo Lianjin informed them about the attacks of the demon races and the evil beast races in both places. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei was able to summon and bring Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong into the dungeon at that time. If it weren’t for the appearance of the three of them, the number of casualties would definitely be numerous."

"From what I heard, Zhang Fei has a close relationship with the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, Tianshi Shengjie. He also has a favorable relationship with Tian Yizu’s daughter, Tia Huangjin." Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin looked at Xuan Yun. "I heard about this matter from my clan members who attended the opening ceremony of the new Moonlite Passion Temple, and they saw those two women there with him. In fact, the beast and winged race sent four of their representatives to that sect, and they became their special disciples."
"Did you see them there too, Lianjin?"

"Yes." Luo Lianjin nodded to Zhi Qingshong. "That’s why I couldn’t help you two establish a relationship with Zhang Fei after the previous incident, and you should think twice about becoming his enemy. He’s far more powerful than he intentionally shows to the public, and his connections are too extensive for us to reach, especially Empress Huo. She has already announced that the Moonlite Passion Sect is under her protection, and anyone who attacks them will become her enemy."
Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin took a deep breath after Luo Lianjin mentioned Feng Yao; not even their ancestors dared to fight her, let alone the two of them.

"Zhang Fei just contacted me, and he asked me to meet him at the Qiao Clan. Therefore, I have to take my leave now, and I will go to the clan to meet him." Luo Lianjin immediately led Xuan Yun to leave the room.
Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin could only stare at them leaving in a daze, as they couldn’t understand how Zhang Fei knew about Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun’s arrival in their clan.
"Can you detect that Zhang Fei is watching us, husband?"

"No." Zhi Qingshong shook his head at his wife. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei was watching us, but I tried to check him with my senses earlier. However, he deflected my senses and tracked me back, but I only detected it for a moment, and it immediately disappeared again."

Nie Shuyin let out a soft sigh. "Even though we have a good relationship with Jin Nanqing, we’ll still be at a disadvantage if we can’t build a relationship with Zhang Fei, especially with the status of the people behind him like Empress Huo and Long Wuzhao."

"The rice has become porridge; there’s no point in regretting it," Zhi Qingshong spoke with a heavy sigh. "Even so, I won’t give up, and I will find another way to build a relationship with Zhang Fei. Additionally, we seem to need to change our perspective on dual cultivators, and we must do something to prevent an incident like this from happening again. However, I can’t decide on my own, and I have to discuss these matters with my parents and grandparents first."
Nie Shuyin agreed with him before getting down from her chair. "Let’s meet them now."
"They specifically invited you to help them persuade me, right, Old Luo?"
"Haha." Luo Lianjin laughed before nodding to Zhang Fei. "They did ask for my help in establishing a relationship with you, but I already told them I can’t help them."

Zhang Fei smiled faintly in response. "Honestly, I would rather not have any problems with them, but I hate people who look down on others because of their status or decisions the most. It doesn’t matter if they don’t like the dual cultivators, but their actions have gone too far; even their guards dare to act like that."

"The problem is that this situation has been going on for generations, and such attitudes have long been ingrained in the minds of the people of this domain. Otherwise, the You and Fei Clans would not expel Fei Yinglin and You Shiyan from their clans, right?" Zhang Fei did not dismiss Luo Lianjin’s words. "I believe Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin won’t give up so easily, and I think their seniors might come out to meet you, so you have to be prepared to face them."
"I know." Zhang Fei then looked at Fei Yinglin, who signaled to him that it was their turn to enter the Qiao Clan. "Would you two like to join us, Old Luo and Old Xuan?"
Both of them nodded to Zhang Fei. "Let us accompany you to meet Qiao Yisheng."
When they arrived inside a large room, Zhang Fei and the others saw a man with the appearance of a man in his early forties, none other than Qiao Yisheng, reading some parchments.
"Hmm?" Qiao Yisheng looked up at them directly. "Oh? What are you doing here with them, Old Luo? Why don’t you come in and see me directly? The guards from my clan won’t dare stop you."
"Ha ha." Luo Lianjin patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "Actually, I didn’t have any plans to come here at first, but Nie Shuyin contacted me about this young man, so I immediately rushed here."
Qiao Yisheng looked at Zhang Fei directly. "You are not an ordinary young man."
"Yisheng, this kid is a god-rank alchemist like me." Qiao Yisheng abruptly stood up from his seat and stared at Zhang Fei in disbelief. "Show him your badge, kid."

Zhang Fei took out his alchemist badge and showed it to Qiao Yisheng, who right away ran out of the room. "Guards! Tell the others to come back tomorrow! I won’t be accepting any more patients today."

chapters.title: Chapter 1306: Healing Process
paragraphs: When he returned to the room, Qiao Yisheng’s attention immediately fell on Mu Lingshu. "Stone body, huh? Did you guys come here because of her?"

"Yes, Senior." Zhang Fei nodded at him. "I’ve tried everything to cure her, but all my efforts were in vain. You Shiyan told me that the best doctors are in this domain, so I brought her here to find a cure."

"The Zhi Clan rejected you because of their presence, right?" Zhang Fei didn’t hide it from Qiao Yisheng. "I don’t know how you managed to reach the god rank in alchemy at such a young age, but people like you are very rare. Although I’m not an alchemist, I can smell far more herbs from your body than Old Luo’s, proving that you are superior to him in alchemy."
Zhang Fei shook his head. "Senior, I dare not say that I am superior to Old Luo, and I only like herbs and alchemy."
"Hahaha." Qiao Yisheng laughed before speaking to Luo Lianjin. "No wonder you like him, Old Luo."
"If you knew more about him, you’d like him too, Yisheng." Luo Lianjin then asked him. "Can you treat this little girl?"
"Let me check first." Qiao Yisheng pulled Mu Lingshu towards a bamboo bed, and he used his senses to check her body after she lay on it.
Zhang Fei and the others waited anxiously, and they hoped that Qiao Yisheng could cure Mu Lingshu’s stone body, as she had suffered for so many years.
A while later, Qiao Yisheng withdrew his senses and took out several golden needles. "Little girl, this might hurt a little, so you must endure it, okay?"
"Yes, Senior."

Qiao Yisheng carefully began to stick his golden needles into several parts of her body, but Mu Lingzhu didn’t feel anything at first because of her stone body. After a significant number of golden needles were inserted into her body, she began to feel pain, which eventually intensified to the point that sweat started to soak her body.
Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi squeezed Zhang Fei’s hands when they saw Mu Lingshu’s expression, as she had never shown any in the past, even when she had suffered a sword injury.

Just like Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao and Ning Zhuan’er also smiled after seeing Mu Lingshu’s expression, and they truly hoped that Qiao Yisheng could cure her completely so she could enjoy her life with their husband.
Beside them, Luo Lianjin nodded his head while rubbing his white beard. ’Yishen’s medical abilities are getting better, and he should have surpassed Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen.’

After all the golden needles were stuck in Mu Lingshu’s body, Qiao Yisheng took two pills and asked her to swallow them. Thereafter, he started flowing his qi into her body through his needles to begin the actual treatment process, causing her to feel more pain.
Several hours passed quickly, and Mu Lingshu’s body was already drenched in sweat, making her body shape visible from beneath her dress.

Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun were already sitting on the chairs, their eyes closed. Qiao Yisheng naturally couldn’t close his eyes, but he wasn’t interested in observing Mu Lingshu’s body, and he was fully focused on treating her.
Under normal circumstances, Zhang Fei would never allow such a situation, but he had no choice but to allow it for the sake of Mu Lingzhu’s recovery.
While waiting, Zhang Fei suddenly felt several senses trying to check on him, but he immediately activated the soul link and repelled them.

Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun also felt those senses, even though the owner did not use them to check the two of them. They frowned slightly while turning to Zhang Fei, but he signaled them not to say or do anything.

Qiao Yisheng, who focused himself on healing Mu Lingshu, could also feel those senses. He secretly contacted his clan members and asked them to stop their actions. ’Those people are always like that! They were too stupid to reject such a young man just because they disliked dual cultivators, and they ended up regretting their decision.’

A day had passed, but Qiao Yisheng still hadn’t finished treating Mu Lingshu. Even so, Zhang Fei and the others could see that her condition had improved significantly, and she was no longer in pain, which relieved them.

Since he and Mei had been monitoring the movements of the Zhi Clan members from the beginning, Zhang Fei saw on his map that some of them had deliberately come to the Qiao Clan, and he certainly knew that they had come because of him.
[What are you going to do with them, Master? Are you going to build a relationship with them?]

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. ’They’re powerful cultivators, but their mindsets are trash, and I have no interest in building a relationship with them. Although this Qiao Clan wasn’t as big as the Zhi Clan, they were much better than that clan’s people, and Qiao Yisheng’s medical abilities were surprisingly superb. Compared to them, I’m more interested in establishing a relationship with him and his clan, but I’ll look into the situation in more detail first.’

[Even though she hasn’t fully recovered yet, I can already detect that Mu Lingshu’s stone body is starting to recover, Master. She’ll probably make a full recovery once Qiao Yisheng finishes her treatment, and she can start enjoying her life with you afterward.]
’I hope so.’
Crack

A middle-aged woman suddenly entered the room, and she nodded to Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun before approaching Zhang Fei. ’Kid, people from the Zhi Clan have come to our clan to see you. I already told them that you don’t want to be disturbed until your wife’s treatment is finished, but they insisted on seeing you, so I came here to inform you. Do you want to meet them now?’

’Sigh.’ Zhang Fei immediately answered her. ’Senior, please inform them that I will meet them, but I will only meet them after I confirm that my wife is completely cured. If they still insist on meeting me now, please tell them that I will never meet them, let alone have a relationship with them.’
’Alright.’ The middle-aged woman nodded slightly and walked out again.
Luo Lianjin immediately followed her. ’I will accompany you to meet them, Tang Qingyan.’
’Yes, Old Luo.’ Tang Qingyan and Luo Lianjin immediately left the room.
Soon, Tang Qingyan and Luo Lianjin arrived at the main hall of the Qiao Clan, where five people were waiting for them, two of whom were Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin.
"Where is that kid, Lianjin?" An old man immediately asked as soon as the two arrived.

Luo Lianjin sighed softly. "Zhi Shengyan, Zhang Fei is accompanying his wife to receive treatment from Yisheng, and he doesn’t want to be disturbed until his wife is fully recovered. If you want to see him, you should wait patiently, and—"
"Tell him to meet us right now." An old woman spoke to Luo Lianjin in a commanding tone, which made him frown.

’This old woman is still as arrogant as ever.’ Luo Lianjin shook his head at her. "Lan Yuerong, I know you are powerful and your Zhi and Lan clans have enormous influence in this domain, but your son and daughter-in-law should have told you some things about Zhang Fei, right? With your attitude, he will never be willing to meet you guys, let alone have a relationship with your two clans."
"He—"

"He what?" Luo Lianjin fiercely interrupted Lan Yuerong. "Do you think your Zhi and Lan clans are able to withstand Empress Huo’s wrath? She and Zhang Fei are close friends, and she has declared that he and his sect are under her protection. If you think you can fight her, you can go inside to force him out now. However, I assure you that your two clans will be destroyed if you do that, so you should think twice before doing it."
"You—"
"That’s enough, wife." Zhi Shengyan stopped her immediately. "How long will the healing process take?"
Luo Lianjin responded to Zhi Shengyan with a shake of his head. "I can’t say for sure, and Qiao Yisheng is still focused on healing that little girl."
"Senior Luo, what exactly is that little girl’s illness?"
"Please tell us the truth, Senior Luo."

Luo Lianjin looked at the two people, who were none other than Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen. "Little Lingshu was born with a stone body, so she couldn’t feel anything since she was born. Even so, her condition has improved significantly now, and she should be able to become a normal woman after Qiao Yisheng finishes healing her."
"I see." Zhi Qian nodded slightly. "The stone body is indeed troublesome for anyone, both men and women. However, such a condition is not incurable, and Qiao Yisheng should be able to cure her."

"I agree with you, sister." Zhi Shen chimed in. "The stone body is curable, but the process will take quite some time because it is related to all the nerves in one’s body, and we cannot rush the healing process, or it will have a bad impact on our nerves."

chapters.title: Chapter 1307: Open Challange
paragraphs: Seconds passed, minutes passed, and ten hours eventually passed.

After a lengthy and complicated process, Qiao Yisheng withdrew his qi before removing all the golden needles from Mu Lingshu’s body. "Kid, I believe this girl has recovered now, but you need to examine her yourself first."
"Okay." Zhang Fei approached Mu Lingshu, grabbed her hand, and used his demon touch on her for a split second. "Hmm? Do you feel it, Lingshu?"
"Yes." Mu Lingshu nodded with a smile, as for the first time in her life her body reacted to stimulation. She then looked at Qiao Yisheng. "Senior, thank you for healing me."

"Don’t mind it." Qiao Yisheng then explained to them. "In fact, the stone body is not a serious disorder, which is because most of your nerves were not developing properly when you grew up. Some others were withered from birth, so your body was insensitive to touch or any sensation. The healing process does take a long time, but it’s not difficult. Unfortunately, your husband doesn’t know the proper way to do it, so he can’t cure you."
Zhang Fei looked at Qiao Yisheng in disbelief. "Is the treatment really that simple, Senior?"

"I don’t know who the doctors who examined your wife previously were, but they clearly didn’t examine her nerves, so they couldn’t find the cause of her disorder." Qiao Yisheng then teased Zhang Fei. "Your wife’s body has become normal, so you have to start pampering her."
"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei laughed at that, unlike Mu Lingshu, who looked embarrassed. "Did you hear that, Lingshu? Once we return to this domain, I’ll pamper you as payment for the past few decades."
"Congratulations, Big Sister Lingshu! You’re cured now!" Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, and Ning Zhuan’er spoke in unison.
Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly and spoke to her. "Lingshu, you can have our husband for some time and let him satisfy you until you’re completely satisfied."
"Ugh! You guys!" Mu Lingshu covered her face in embarrassment, as Qiao Yisheng was still with them.

"Haha." Qiao Yisheng laughed as he patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "You are the luckiest man I have ever met, kid. You have so many beautiful wives, but the most important thing is that they get along so well. If I choose to become a dual cultivator like you, Qingyan will definitely castrate me."
Zhang Fei rubbed his nose. "You’re right, Senior. I’m indeed the luckiest man in this universe because I managed to win their hearts, and they always stay by my side to support me."

"Do you want to meet the people from the Zhi Clan?" Qiao Yisheng scanned the main hall using his senses. "They’ve been waiting for you there since midnight, and they won’t leave until they meet you. Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen probably won’t do anything to you if you refuse them. Zhi Shengyan is quite wise, and he should already know your status, but his wife is different from him. Lan Yuerong and her Lan Clan have been arrogant for a long time, and she might become your enemy if you refuse to cooperate with them."
"Haha." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Senior, Lan Yuerong is courting death if she chooses to be our husband’s enemy, and her Lan Clan will be wiped out of this domain forever."

"Oh?" Qiao Yisheng looked at Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao in turn. "Are you sure you can beat them, kid? The Lan Clan has four other powerful cultivators with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, and the Zhi Clan also has three cultivators at that level. Since the two clans are in-laws, they will probably team up to face you if you have a problem with one of them."

Zhang Fei shrugged helplessly. "I never thought of looking for trouble with anyone, let alone people I’ve never met before. They may be powerful, but I will never be afraid of them. As Yunxiao said just now, they are courting death if they choose to be my enemy, and I will not hesitate to destroy them."
"Hmm?" Qiao Yisheng was amazed by Zhang Fei’s self-confidence despite his low cultivation. "Can you show me your true strength?"

"Since you have cured my wife, I will show you some things about me." Qiao Yisheng swiftly jumped back as soon as Zhang Fei summoned the nine evil beasts, whose cultivation had already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. "Yao Qilin and Fei Lian are my women, and the rest are my slaves."

Qiao Yisheng took a deep breath as he looked at them one by one. ’Holy crap! No wonder he wasn’t the least bit afraid of the Lan and Zhi Clan; these evil beasts were simply too powerful compared to them.’ "How did you manage to subdue them, kid?"

"Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong defeated them, and I simply took advantage of the situation to subdue them." Qiao Yisheng looked at Zhang Fei in shock and disbelief, as the three dragons were truly powerful, especially the five-clawed golden dragon emperor, who was heralded as the most powerful cultivator in the Paradise Realm. "I have known the dragon emperor long before I ascended to this realm, and the princess of the celestial dragon race is my old friend."

Qiao Yisheng massaged his forehead after hearing that. "You are insane, kid! Even cultivators as powerful as my parents and ancestors never managed to establish a relationship with them because their levels are too vastly different, but you have such a relationship with them."
"Senior, our husband is different from what you imagined." Qiao Yisheng looked at Wu Lianzhi directly. "He’s also a dragon like them."

Upon hearing that, Qiao Yisheng returned his attention to Zhang Fei, who immediately transformed into his humanoid Calamity Dragon Form. "I couldn’t feel your beast aura before, but I can feel it now."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei returned to his human form and sent all the evil beasts back to his beast space. "When I use my human form, almost no one, including the beast and evil beast races, will be able to sense my beast aura. However, some of them can still detect my beast aura, such as Long Wuzhao and the others."
Qiao Yisheng stared at Zhang Fei in confusion as he handed him four bottles of pills. "Are they the result of your concoction?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at Qiao Yisheng. "I don’t have many valuables or jewels, but I’m confident in the effects of my pills. You and your wife can use them, and I’m sure you two will like their effects. For now, let’s meet those people, and I want to see what they will do to me if I refuse their wishes."
"Husband, send them back first, and I will accompany you to meet them." Luo Yunxiao spoke.

"Alright." Zhang Fei didn’t send Mu Lingzhu and the others into the training space; instead, he sent them into his soul world. "You don’t need to be confused, Senior. I am a soul cultivator, and I sent them into my soul space."

"I find it hard to understand you, kid. You’re so young, yet you’ve already accomplished many things that senior cultivators like me or the others couldn’t." Qiao Yisheng stored the pill bottles in his storage ring before leading Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao to leave the room for the main hall. "Let’s go."

Not long after, the three of them arrived at the main hall. Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen still looked relaxed, but Zhi Shengyan looked annoyed because he had been waiting for Zhang Fei for too long.

The one with the worst expression among them was Lan Yuerong, and she tried to suppress Zhang Fei using her aura. However, he immediately used the soul link and suppressed her back, causing her chair to shatter and sending her crashing to the floor.
Crack
"Arghh!"

Tang Qingyan and several senior members of the Qiao Clan in the room were shocked to see that. Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen also reacted the same as them. All of them immediately looked at Zhang Fei, who wore a flat expression, but they could detect that his cultivation was equal to or even stronger than cultivators at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, like them.
"Wife!" Zhi Shengyan exclaimed loudly before trying to help Lan Yuerong up, but Zhang Fei pressed her harder and harder. He looked at him with a frown. "What do you mean by this, brat?"
"Why don’t you ask your wife, Old Brat?" Zhang Fei casually responded. "You knew that she wanted to pressure me, and you let her do it, but you got angry because I pressured her."
"Pfft!" Qiao Yisheng, Tang Qingyan, and the members of the Qiao Clan couldn’t help but laugh when they heard Zhang Fei address Zhi Shengyan as an old brat.
"You—" Zhi Shengyan stopped talking as soon as Zhang Fei activated his soul, sword, and fire domains at the same time.
Zhang Fei’s actions not only shocked Zhi Shengyan, but everyone present, including Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun, was also shocked to see that.

Zhang Fei then spoke to the people from the Zhi Clan. "I’ve never liked to cause trouble with others, but I dislike it when others try to pressure and force me. If you think I’m a weak persimmon, then you can attack me now. However, I must warn you that all of you will die, and every member of your two clans will also be buried alongside you."

"I never thought of looking for trouble with anyone, let alone people I’ve never met before.
They may be powerful, but I will never be afraid of them.
As Yunxiao said just now, they are courting death if they choose to be my enemy, and I will not hesitate to destroy them."
"Hmm?" Qiao Yisheng was amazed by Zhang Fei’s self-confidence despite his low cultivation.
"Can you show me your true strength?"

"Since you have cured my wife, I will show you some things about me." Qiao Yisheng swiftly jumped back as soon as Zhang Fei summoned the nine evil beasts, whose cultivation had already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.
"Yao Qilin and Fei Lian are my women, and the rest are my slaves."
Qiao Yisheng took a deep breath as he looked at them one by one. ’Holy crap!
No wonder he wasn’t the least bit afraid of the Lan and Zhi Clan; these evil beasts were simply too powerful compared to them.’ "How did you manage to subdue them, kid?"

"Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong defeated them, and I simply took advantage of the situation to subdue them." Qiao Yisheng looked at Zhang Fei in shock and disbelief, as the three dragons were truly powerful, especially the five-clawed golden dragon emperor, who was heralded as the most powerful cultivator in the Paradise Realm.
"I have known the dragon emperor long before I ascended to this realm, and the princess of the celestial dragon race is my old friend."
Qiao Yisheng massaged his forehead after hearing that.
"You are insane, kid!

Even cultivators as powerful as my parents and ancestors never managed to establish a relationship with them because their levels are too vastly different, but you have such a relationship with them."
"Senior, our husband is different from what you imagined." Qiao Yisheng looked at Wu Lianzhi directly.
"He’s also a dragon like them."
Upon hearing that, Qiao Yisheng returned his attention to Zhang Fei, who immediately transformed into his humanoid Calamity Dragon Form.
"I couldn’t feel your beast aura before, but I can feel it now."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei returned to his human form and sent all the evil beasts back to his beast space.
"When I use my human form, almost no one, including the beast and evil beast races, will be able to sense my beast aura.
However, some of them can still detect my beast aura, such as Long Wuzhao and the others."
Qiao Yisheng stared at Zhang Fei in confusion as he handed him four bottles of pills.
"Are they the result of your concoction?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at Qiao Yisheng.
"I don’t have many valuables or jewels, but I’m confident in the effects of my pills.
You and your wife can use them, and I’m sure you two will like their effects.
For now, let’s meet those people, and I want to see what they will do to me if I refuse their wishes."
"Husband, send them back first, and I will accompany you to meet them." Luo Yunxiao spoke.
"Alright." Zhang Fei didn’t send Mu Lingzhu and the others into the training space; instead, he sent them into his soul world.
"You don’t need to be confused, Senior.
I am a soul cultivator, and I sent them into my soul space."
"I find it hard to understand you, kid.

You’re so young, yet you’ve already accomplished many things that senior cultivators like me or the others couldn’t." Qiao Yisheng stored the pill bottles in his storage ring before leading Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao to leave the room for the main hall.
"Let’s go."
Not long after, the three of them arrived at the main hall.
Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen still looked relaxed, but Zhi Shengyan looked annoyed because he had been waiting for Zhang Fei for too long.
The one with the worst expression among them was Lan Yuerong, and she tried to suppress Zhang Fei using her aura.
However, he immediately used the soul link and suppressed her back, causing her chair to shatter and sending her crashing to the floor.
Crack
"Arghh!"
Tang Qingyan and several senior members of the Qiao Clan in the room were shocked to see that.
Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen also reacted the same as them.

All of them immediately looked at Zhang Fei, who wore a flat expression, but they could detect that his cultivation was equal to or even stronger than cultivators at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, like them.
"Wife!" Zhi Shengyan exclaimed loudly before trying to help Lan Yuerong up, but Zhang Fei pressed her harder and harder.
He looked at him with a frown.
"What do you mean by this, brat?"
"Why don’t you ask your wife, Old Brat?" Zhang Fei casually responded.
"You knew that she wanted to pressure me, and you let her do it, but you got angry because I pressured her."
"Pfft!" Qiao Yisheng, Tang Qingyan, and the members of the Qiao Clan couldn’t help but laugh when they heard Zhang Fei address Zhi Shengyan as an old brat.
"You—" Zhi Shengyan stopped talking as soon as Zhang Fei activated his soul, sword, and fire domains at the same time.
Zhang Fei’s actions not only shocked Zhi Shengyan, but everyone present, including Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun, was also shocked to see that.
Zhang Fei then spoke to the people from the Zhi Clan.
"I’ve never liked to cause trouble with others, but I dislike it when others try to pressure and force me.
If you think I’m a weak persimmon, then you can attack me now.
However, I must warn you that all of you will die, and every member of your two clans will also be buried alongside you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1308: Zhang Fei’s Actions
paragraphs: Tang Qingyan pulled Qiao Yisheng to her side. ’How could he do such a thing, husband?’

’He’s more terrifying than you can imagine, wife. I’ll tell you some things about him, but we have to wait for him to deal with these people first.’ Tang Qingyan nodded to Qiao Yisheng and returned their attention to Zhi Shengyan, waiting for his response to Zhang Fei’s actions.
Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong broke out in cold sweat as soon as countless qi swords appeared in Zhang Fei’s domain, followed by countless golden crow flames.

Despite this, Lan Yuerong still continued to stare at Zhang Fei with hostility, unlike Zhi Shengyan, who had noticed several things about him. ’This sword domain and qi swords clearly indicate that he is a god-rank sword master. But what’s with these golden flames?’

Just as the two were pondering this, Zhang Fei forcefully pulled their souls out of their bodies. Seeing this, Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin wanted to attack him, but Qiao Yisheng and Tang Qingyan moved to stop them. Several members of the Qiao Clan also stepped in to stop Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen, making the atmosphere in the main hall completely tense.

"You two are stronger than me, but you don’t know anything about me. With your weak soul power, you won’t be able to do anything to stop me in my soul domain." Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong were completely shocked once Zhang Fei replicated their souls and merged them with his. He then created two soul swords, sent them into their souls, and returned their souls into their bodies. "Right now, I have complete control over both of your souls, and I can use my soul swords to destroy them whenever I want, so you should think twice about looking for trouble with me. If I know you guys are planning something wicked against me, I will immediately come to your Zhi Clan, and I will eradicate your two clans."

After saying that, Zhang Fei immediately removed his three domains and released Lan Yuerong from his suppression. He looked at Qiao Yisheng and the members of the Qiao Clan and cupped his hands. "Please forgive me for causing commotion in your clan, Seniors. I’d like to stay longer, but I don’t want your clan to get into trouble because of me, so I’ll take my wife and disciples with me now."
"Don’t worry, kid." Qiao Yisheng threw a plaque to Zhang Fei. "If you need treatment from us, you can bring anyone here, and I will treat them for you."
"Thank you, Senior." Thereafter, Zhang Fei took Luo Yunxiao, Fei Yinglin, and You Shiyan to disappear from the Qiao Clan.
"So fast!" Qiao Yisheng and others exclaimed in shock.
Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin immediately helped Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong up, and the four of them hurriedly left the Qiao Clan.
Zhi Qian released a heavy sigh. "I didn’t expect the situation to turn out like this, Brother Yisheng."
"I really didn’t want it to happen, but the relationship between our Qiao and Zhi clans seems to be getting worse, Brother Yisheng," Zhi Shen also spoke.

"Haha." Qiao Yisheng laughed at that. "If your mother hadn’t acted like that, the situation wouldn’t have turned out like this, right? She didn’t know anything about that kid, but she acted arrogantly by trying to suppress him first, and she had to bear the consequences of her arrogance."

"Lan Yuerong is the most arrogant woman I have ever met, and she can only blame herself for their situation." Luo Lianjin spoke with a shake of his head. "Your brother and sister-in-law have already informed her about several things regarding Zhang Fei, and I have also warned her not to behave that way, yet she foolishly did it anyway. I don’t know what your grandparents will do in this matter, but if you two are smart, then you should not interfere in their problems, even though you are members of the Zhi Clan."
Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen looked at Luo Lianjin. "What—"

"You two have already witnessed Zhang Fei’s abilities, and you should have been able to detect his cultivation just now." Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen nodded to Luo Lianjin. "The strength he displayed just now was indeed borrowed, but it was still his, and his strength surpassed your grandparents and the others. Even if Empress Huo and the others don’t help him, he can still defeat them and destroy your Zhi Clan. If that happens, you guys only have two choices: leave them or sink with them."
Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen did not say anything to Luo Lianjin, and both of them said goodbye to the Qiao Clan people before leaving the clan to return to the Zhi Clan.
Luo Lianjin and Xuan Yun were the same; they immediately said goodbye to the Qiao Clan people before leaving for the Heavenlight Main Domain.
After ahey all left, an old man and an old woman appeared inside the main hall. "What do you think of Zhang Fei, Yisheng?"

"Grandpa Tianze, do we need to think about it any further?" Qiao Yisheng turned the question around. "No matter what happens, we must be on Zhang Fei’s side, even if the Zhi Clan will be hostile to us."
Qiao Tianze nodded in agreement with Qiao Yisheng, but then the old woman spoke to him. "Tell us what you know about Zhang Fei, Yisheng."

"Yes, Grandma Wu Xinlan." Qiao Yisheng immediately explained to them some of the things Zhang Fei had told her before, especially regarding his relationship with Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong.

However, Qiao Yisheng didn’t mention the nine evil beasts, as they were Zhang Fei’s hidden secret. If people knew about their existence by his side, it would only bring trouble for him, and he also didn’t tell them about his identity as a dragon.

Qiao Tianze and Wu Xinlan could see that Qiao Yisheng was still hiding some things about Zhang Fei from them, but they were old and experienced cultivators, and they were quite familiar with the situation in the cultivation world. They didn’t press him for further details, and they immediately made a decision. "In that case, we will follow your plan, and we will be on that kid’s side no matter what happens. If the Zhi Clan becomes hostile and wants to fight us, we don’t need to follow their madness, and we just need to leave this domain."

"Grandpa, I’m thinking about going to the Moonlit Passion Temple." Qiao Tianze raised an eyebrow at Qiao Yisheng. "That sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, and Zhang Fei has rebuilt it as a universal sect. Additionally, he has many people who are experts in several fields there, so I want to see the situation there with my own eyes."

Qiao Tianze nodded in understanding. "Alright, you can go to that sect, and you can tell us everything you saw there later. If the sect has become much better than in the past, we will make another decision regarding our relationship with Zhang Fei."
"Yes, Grandpa." After Qiao Tianze and Wu Xinlan disappeared, Qiao Yisheng immediately took Tang Qingyan back to their room, where he distributed to her the pills Zhang Fei had given him earlier.
"What effect do all these pills have, Husband?" Tang Qingyan asked while looking at the pills in her palms.

"Zhang Fei didn’t explain their effects to me in detail, but I believe they aren’t poisonous, so you don’t need to worry about that." Qiao Yisheng then pointed to the two pills on Tang Qingyan’s palm. "I’m most curious about these two pills because they are different from the rest, so we should try swallowing them now."
"Which one first?"
"The white one first."
"Alright."

Qiao Yisheng and Tang Qingyan began to swallow one of the pills first, the Beauty Restoring Pill. They were surprised when the black liquid began to appear in their bodies, but they cleared it away until it no longer emerged. After that, they swallowed the last pill, the Youthful Retaining Pill.
Thereafter, they walked in front of the mirror to check their changes, but they fell into a daze when they saw their reflections.

Tang Qingyan began to touch her face as she was stunned. "Husband, this... how could this happen? Not only our faces but also our bodies have been rejuvenated. Look at us now; our faces have become so young, like when we first met."

"As expected, that kid is really scary." Qiao Yisheng answered while continuing to stare at his reflection. "There are so many god-rank alchemists in this realm, but I have never heard of any of them possessing such pills. If they had them, they would have sold them long ago, and they would have made a lot of fortune from them."
Tang Qingyan agreed with her husband. "I think we should hide our new appearance, including from our two families."
"Yes." Qiao Yisheng pulled Tang Qingyan to the bed. "Let’s swallow the rest of the pills."
"Alright."
At the Zhi Clan, Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong vented their anger over Zhang Fei’s previous treatment by smashing many things in their room.
Seeing their parents so enraged, Zhi Qingshong and Nie Shuyin chose to keep their mouths shut and wait for them to calm down.
However, the commotion they caused attracted the attention of others, and an old man immediately appeared in the room. "What are you two doing? Why are you guys acting childish like this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1309: Looking For Swordsmith
paragraphs: The old man was Zhi Yongbo, and his expression turned furious after Nie Shuyin and Zhi Qingshong informed him of the incident at the Qiao Clan earlier. He wasn’t furious with Zhang Fei for treating his clansmen like that, but he was furious with Lan Yuerong, who couldn’t control her arrogance.
Slap
"Argh!" Lan Yuerong was thrown to the floor after Zhi Yongbo slapped her. "Why—"

"You are the most arrogant and idiotic woman I have ever met!" Zhi Yongbo furiously shouted at Lan Yuerong. "Shuyin and Qingshong already told you that Zhang Fei has a close relationship with Empress Huo Yanling, yet you dared to act arrogantly in front of him, and you even tried to suppress him with your meager strength!"
"But—"

"But what?" Zhi Yongbo released his killing intent and enveloped Lan Yuerong with it. Even though their cultivation was at the same level, the old man had reached that stage much earlier than her, and his strength was several levels above hers, causing her to shiver in fear. "Do you think your Lan Clan is so powerful compared to Empress Huo? Not even your grandparents dare to fight her, yet you act like your strength is the greatest in the universe! To tell you the truth, your grandparents would immediately kneel on the floor if they met her; she once beat them until they couldn’t get out of bed for a hundred years!"
Not only Lan Yuerong, but also Zhi Shengyan, Nie Shuyin, and Zhi Qingshong were stunned by Zhi Yongbo’s revelation.
"Is that true, Father?" Zhi Shengyan asked.

"In the past, he witnessed with his own eyes how Empress Huo beat up Lan Fengyu and Chen Wuhen, which almost caused them to die!" After Zhi Yongbo spoke, Lan Yuerong, Zhi Shengyan, Nie Shuyin, and Zhi Qingshong swallowed their saliva. "Let alone us, those higher-ups wouldn’t dare challenge Empress Huo! The moment she returned to this realm, she ordered her subordinates to slaughter everyone who had ever tried to take over her domain. Her subordinates slaughtered tens of thousands of people in just a few days, but those people didn’t dare stop them, including Long Wuzhao! If you are tired of living, you can die with your Lan Clan, but don’t take my Zhi Clan with you!"
Lan Yuerong didn’t dare to refute Zhi Yongbo and lowered her face in shame, but her attitude only made the old man even more furious.
Nie Shuyin immediately approached Zhi Yongbo and rubbed his back. "Grandfather, I know you’re angry because of my mother-in-law’s mistake, but you need to calm down, or your old injury will recur."
"Sigh." Zhi Yongbo let out a heavy sigh. "I don’t know how I could have allowed my stupid son to marry an idiotic woman like her in the past. Do you know where Zhang Fei is now, Shuyin?"

"I don’t know, Grandpa." Nie Shuyin shook her head in response. "Zhang Fei had already left before we left the Qiao Clan, and he didn’t say anything to them about his next destination. If you are thinking of meeting him to resolve the problem between us, I think we can go to the Moonlit Passion Temple in the Twin Flames Domain."
"Hmm?" Zhi Yongbo furrowed his brows.

Nie Shuyin immediately explained, "Grandpa, Zhang Fei is a dual cultivator, and he has several women by his side. Additionally, he is an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he is more like their leader because Qing Qiu’er is one of his women, and he has completely overhauled the sect."
"What do you mean by that, Shuyin?"

"The Moonlit Passion Temple is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one." Nie Shuyin’s answer surprised Zhi Yongbo. "They opened various cultivation path branches, including alchemy, blacksmithing, swordsmanship, and various others. In fact, some sects have begun to establish relations with them, and they sent some of their disciples to be their representatives in the sect."
"Is it really Zhang Fei who changed the sect?"

"Yes." Nie Shuyin nodded at Zhi Yongbo. "I got all this information from Luo Lianjin; he and Jin Nanqing attended the opening ceremony of the new Moonlit Passion Temple, and he also came to the sect several times afterward. Actually, Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru from the Emerald Bamboo Sect in the Peach Garden Domain have also sent their disciples as representatives in the sect."
"Have you told this idiot woman about all that?" Zhi Yongbo glanced at Lan Yuerong.
"I’ve explained everything to my mother-in-law, Grandpa."

Zhi Yongbo glared at Lan Yuerong again. "Your daughter-in-law has already explained so much about Zhang Fei to you, but you thought you were superior to him, and you acted arrogantly in front of him before."

"Grandpa, everything has already happened, so please stop treating my mother like this." Zhi Qingshong finally spoke. "Moreover, she has already borne the consequences of her mistakes, so you don’t need to blame her anymore. For now, we must think about how to repair our clan’s relationship with Zhang Fei, and I believe we must visit him at the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"I agree with my son, Father." Instead, Zhi Yongbo glared at Zhi Shengyan. "Father, I know I was wrong, but I—"

"Shut up!" Zhi Yongbo snapped at him. "Do you remember asking me back then why I didn’t choose you to be the patriarch of our clan? You couldn’t even control your idiotic wife, let alone manage this clan."
Zhi Shengyan chose to remain silent, fearing that Zhi Yongbo would continue to be angry and blame him further.

Thereafter, Zhi Yongbo spread his senses to several areas near his city, especially the city where the You Clan resided, in search of Zhang Fei. However, he couldn’t find him anywhere, and he decided to give up. "Shuyin and Qingshong, we’ll visit the Moonlit Passion Sect in a few days."
"Yes, Grandpa."
"Grandpa, the two of us will go with you." Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen spoke as soon as they arrived there.

Zhi Yongbo nodded at them before disappearing from the room, much to the relief of Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong. However, they were worried about their situation, especially after Zhang Fei replicated their souls and merged them with his.
Zhi Qingshong immediately led his wife, Nie Shuyin, to leave the room to attend to other matters. Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen looked at their parents, sighed softly, and left again.
Zhang Fei had brought Luo Yunxiao, Mu Lingshu, Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, Ning Zhuan’er, Fei Yinglin, and You Shiyan to the city where the You Clan resided.
"Elder Zhang, I think you and your five wives should go to my clan without us; otherwise, my clan’s people will behave the same way as those from the Zhi Clan." You Shiyan spoke.
Fei Yinglin nodded in agreement with her partner. "Elder Zhang, I know you are strong, but there is no point in attracting trouble to you, right?
"I think they’re right, husband." Luo Yunxiao tried to persuade Zhang Fei. "We’ve already had trouble with the Zhi Clan, so we shouldn’t go looking for trouble with the You Clan."

chapters.title: Chapter 1310: You Feng - You Jian
paragraphs: After waiting for a while, the guard returned and led them into the You Clan, specifically to a forging workshop. Along the way, they saw many children and teenagers practicing by swinging hammers, each of which was of a different size, depending on their strength.
Zhang Fei and the others also saw several middle-aged people not far from the location, but they didn’t practice with hammers; instead, they practiced using various forging materials.
"Ling’er, our husband is drooling over those forging materials," Wu Lianzhi whispered softly.

Xu Ling’er nodded in agreement after seeing Zhang Fei’s expression. "Our husband is a blacksmith, but he doesn’t have many materials for forging equipment because we were in isolation for so long. Therefore, it’s natural for him to be eager to get those forging materials."
"Unfortunately, our husband didn’t bring Sister Shi Xi to this domain; I’m sure she would also be eager to get them." Ning Zhuan’er added.

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed softly. "Just like our husband, Shi Xi has been focused on practicing blacksmithing for over two decades, and she’s also already reached the supreme-rank blacksmith, so she’ll definitely be overjoyed if he brings her here."

The guard leading them could hear Luo Yunxiao’s words, and he stole a glance at Zhang Fei, thinking, ’Is this young master really a supreme-rank blacksmith? If so, he’s truly talented since he has the god-rank alchemist badge. But why did he have to come to our clan to look for a swordsmith? With his blacksmith rank, he should be able to forge his own sword, right?’
Before long, they had arrived in front of the largest forging workshop in the clan, and the guard immediately left them after reporting to the people inside.
Zhang Fei immediately led his five wives into it, where they saw two people busy forging swords. They were not alone, and several people assisted them in some ways.
Luo Yunxiao had no interest in blacksmithing, and she pulled her sisters to the side of the room to sit there.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei approached the middle-aged man on the left. Based on his status from the system’s scan, he was You Jian, the best swordsmith in the You Clan. The middle-aged man on the right was You Shiyan’s father, You Feng.

You Jian briefly glanced at Zhang Fei before returning his focus to the sword he was forging. ’I don’t need to examine his body in detail, and I can already tell that this kid is an expert blacksmith.’

You Feng also glanced at Zhang Fei, and he had the same thought as You Jian. ’Why would an expert blacksmith like him come here looking for us? Unlike us, who can only forge swords, he should be able to forge various types of equipment.’

Zhang Fei stood in the middle of You Jian and You Feng, carefully observing their sword-forging process without disturbing them. ’Hmm? There’s nothing wrong with their forging process, but why can’t they forge other equipment besides swords?’

[Master, it seems like they can’t forge equipment apart from swords because of their brains.] Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow for a moment. [I don’t know what happened to them in the past, but they seem unable to imagine any other equipment besides swords, which prevented them from forging them.]

Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. ’When Old Gang first taught me blacksmithing, he said that forging requires a high level of imagination, and we must organize everything in our minds first before we begin forging. For so many years, I’ve always held onto his words every time I forge equipment, and the results are in line with my thoughts. Could it be that there is something wrong in their brains, Mei?’
[I think so, Master. However, I found it strange because it didn’t happen to one person, but to the entire clan.]

’You’re right.’ Zhang Fei agreed with that. ’Their condition is indeed strange and illogical, and something may have happened to them in the past. Some illnesses are indeed hereditary, but they shouldn’t affect the entire clan, and they will only be passed down to the descendants of the owner of the disease.’

[With their status and wealth, it shouldn’t be difficult for them to seek treatment from the Zhi and Qiao Clans. They may have done so in the past, but people from those two clans were unsuccessful in curing them.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. ’I hope they have the materials to upgrade my Demon Extermination Sword to immortal grade.’

As the sun sets, You Jian and You Feng finally complete their swords. Zhang Fei could see that both swords were immortal-grade, making him even more eager to ask for their help in upgrading the Demon Extermination Sword.
You Jian and You Feng asked the people who helped them to tidy up everything. "Sorry to keep you waiting, young man."

"Two Seniors, it’s not a problem because I came to this clan without a prior appointment. Moreover, I had the opportunity to witness you two forging those swords, and I am very satisfied with it." Zhang Fei then introduced himself. "My name is Zhang Fei, and I came here because I want to upgrade my sword. Additionally, I want to buy new weapons for my wife, but I may not be able to afford weapons in this clan."
"How did you know about us, young man?"
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "Two seniors, I don’t want to lie to you, and I learned about this clan from You Shiyan."
"Hmm?" You Feng instantly frowned as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned his son. "Did my unfilial son come here with you?"
Zhang Fei nodded at You Feng. "You Shiyan and Fei Yingling are natives of this domain, so I asked them to bring me here, and they’re waiting for me at the teahouse not far from here."
Hearing that, You Feng used his senses to search for You Shiyan and Fei Yingling. He found them in the teahouse, but he immediately withdrew his senses.
"What is your relationship with them, young man?" You Jian asked Zhang Fei, but his tone was not as friendly as before.
Zhang Fei showed them his sect plaque. "I am an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and—"
"You should leave our clan now." You Jian pointed towards the exit.
"Hahaha." Instead, Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Aren’t you being too petty, Senior?"
"You—"

Zhang Fei released his aura, forcing You Jian to swallow his words. "The Moonlit Passion Sect used to be a dual cultivation sect, but it changed after I joined them, and I overhauled it into a universal sect. Moreover, becoming a dual cultivator is everyone’s personal choice, and no one can forbid someone from taking the path they like, including our families."

"You’re not wrong about that, young man." You Feng said while nodding in agreement. "As you said, everyone has their choice, and no one can interfere with theirs. They can choose to become dual cultivators, but we can also choose not to like them."
Zhang Fei smiled at that. "What’s wrong with being a dual cultivator? Look at me, I am a dual cultivator, but I am also a god-rank alchemist, and I am also a supreme-rank blacksmith."
"Huh?" You Jian and You Feng were shocked to hear Zhang Fei say that he was a supreme-rank blacksmith. "What—"

"Senior, I managed to become a god-rank alchemist at this age, okay? Do you really need to doubt that I can also become a supreme-rank blacksmith?" Zhang Fei took out his alchemist badge and showed it to them. "If you two doubt the authenticity of my badge, you can contact Jin Nanqing and Luo Lianjin to verify its authenticity, since they were the ones who issued it for me."

You Jian took out his communication device and tried to contact Jin Nanqing, but he received no response from the old man. He decided to contact Luo Lianjin, who confirmed that he was the one who issued the alchemist badge to Zhang Fei.
"How did it go, Brother Jian?" You Feng asked him.
You Jian nodded at You Feng. "Luo Lianjin said that he was the one who tested this young man when he took his alchemist rank promotion test, and he was also the one who issued his alchemist badge."

"Haha." Zhang Fei put away his badge again. "I don’t mean to brag, but I dare say that I am superior to you in status. Unlike you two, I am more skilled in many things, even though I am a dual cultivator. If you two doubt my blacksmithing abilities, I will show them to you, and you can watch me directly. However, I don’t have the materials to forge high-level equipment, so I hope you are willing to lend them to me."
You Jian unhesitatingly took out some forging materials and handed them to Zhang Fei. "Use them to forge anything you like."
"Alright." Zhang Fei went straight to the forging area on the left side and talked to those people. "You guys don’t need to help me, and I will forge the weapon myself."
You Jian frowned for a moment, but he immediately ordered his assistants to retreat, as he wanted to prove for himself Zhang Fei’s ability in blacksmithing.

You Jian and You Feng took a deep breath when Zhang Fei took out his Heavenly Forge Hammer and Heavenly Soulwave Anvil. ’Divine-grade blacksmith equipment! Even so, neither of them will be able to match ours, as our two pieces of equipment are immortal grade.’
