chapters.title: Chapter 1311: Forge Three Weapons
paragraphs: You Jian and You Feng were shocked again when Zhang Fei used his golden crow flames to ignite the furnace. They could feel the extreme heat from his flames, but they couldn’t identify them.
"Have you ever seen such golden flames before, Brother Jian?" You Feng asked.

You Jian thought for a while before answering. ’As far as I know, only Long Wuzhao possesses golden flames. Moreover, this young man is an ordinary human like us, so his flames are definitely not dragon flames. Even though the heat of his flames is high, he has complete control over them.’
’Yes.’ You Feng nodded in agreement. ’Wasn’t one of the materials you gave him the Fragment of Heaven’s Alloy?’

You Jian nodded at him. ’I deliberately gave him the Fragment of Heaven’s Alloy to test his abilities because we needed a month to soften it, but I apparently underestimated him, and he should be able to soften it in a few hours with his flames.’

’Hmm?’ You Feng looked at the remaining materials beside Zhang Fei. ’They are Sun Steel, Blood Alloy, Blackstar Meteorite, and Earthheart Stone, right? How is he going to forge a weapon with four opposing materials?’
You Jian smirked faintly without responding to his brother. ’Heh! He’s so arrogant, so I wanted to see how you forge a weapon from those materials.’

Even though Zhang Fei had never seen those materials before, he knew for sure that he could not use them to create a weapon. However, he didn’t think too much about it, and he conceived of another solution.

’You Jian deliberately played tricks on me, but I won’t let his plan succeed.’ After he thought things through, Zhang Fei took out some of his own forging materials. ’Let’s see if this idea will work.’
You Jian frowned as soon as Zhang Fei activated his fire domain, and those forging materials floated within it before being enveloped by his golden crow flames.

’Does he intend to simultaneously soften those materials with his golden flames? Can something like that really be done?’ You Feng wondered to himself. ’Brother Jian, your plan to make things difficult for this young man is useless. Although his materials aren’t high-rank materials, they can still be combined with the materials you gave him.’
You Jian didn’t respond to You Feng, but his expression looked displeased as he watched Zhang Fei process all the forging materials.
Unlike You Jian, his assistants looked enthusiastic to watch Zhang Fei because he did everything himself, and he could do everything at once.

Four hours later, everything was ready, and Zhang Fei began to forge the Fragment of Heaven’s Alloy, the Sun Steel, and the Blood Alloy at the same time. Utilizing his speed and body strength, he swung his hammer at a high speed at the three metals one after another, leaving those who watched his action dumbfounded.

Usually, a blacksmith would focus on one material, and he or she would continue with the next material and so on. However, Zhang Fei actually processed all the materials at the same time, and there was not the slightest hesitation in every swing and blow of his hammer, which was something they had never seen before.

Two hours passed, the three materials had taken their forms, and they could see that Zhang Fei had deliberately forged three different weapons, even though their forms were not yet completely perfect.

You Jian’s face darkened, and his facial veins bulged out; even his fists were tightly clenched. It had taken him several months just to soften the Fragment of Heaven’s Alloy, but Zhang Fei had done it in just three hours, which caused jealousy and envy to rise in his heart. ’Fuck! Where did he get his golden flames? If I also had such flames, I definitely wouldn’t lose to him.’

You Feng also felt jealous and envious of Zhang Fei, but he did not have the slightest negative thought towards him; Instead, he felt lucky because he came to their clan, allowing him to witness a forging process he had never seen before. ’Did my son learn forging from this young man? If that’s true, he will surpass me and become a skilled swordsmith.’

Luo Yunxiao, Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, Mu Lingshu, and Ning Zhuan’er repeatedly glanced at the two men. They could see the hostility in You Jian’s eyes, but they didn’t say anything and waited for Zhang Fei to finish his forging first. ’He better not think stupidly like the people from the Zhi Clan, or he will suffer if he is hostile to our husband.’
In the end, Zhang Fei spent another two hours completing the three weapons, and he immediately cooled them using a special cooling liquid inside a small stone box.

After everything was done, Zhang Fei deactivated his fire domain and retracted his golden crow flames. He then gave the three weapons—a short sword, a dagger, and a spearhead—to You Jian and You Feng. "Do you two still think I’m bragging about my blacksmithing skills? Unlike you two, I’m a true supreme-rank blacksmith because I can not only forge a sword, but I can also forge other weapons, and I can forge these three weapons much faster than you. Unfortunately, I don’t have many materials right now, or else I would show you my abilities to forge various other types of equipment."

"Marvelous! You are truly marvelous, young man!" You Feng then took out the short sword. "Even though this sword is too short compared to a true sword, it is still an immortal grade, and its appearance is also exquisite."
You Jian didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei, and his gaze was fixed on the dagger and spearhead, admiring both of them.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed and took the short sword from You Feng’s hand. "Senior, the size of a sword isn’t everything, you know? In the hands of a true swordmaster, even a leaf can become a deadly weapon, let alone this short sword."
Both You Jian and You Feng looked at Zhang Fei as they realized something. "Don’t tell us that—"

"Yes." Zhang Fei immediately used his sword Qi, causing the short sword to look as long as a normal sword. He moved the sword in slow motion, creating many qi swords that stunned the two men. They were even more stunned when he activated his sword domain, creating countless qi swords within it. "I never like showing off my abilities, but I want you to know that dual cultivators can also achieve many things in this life. As you already know, I am a god-rank alchemist and a supreme-rank blacksmith, and I am also a god-rank swordmaster. You guys always hate dual cultivators, but my achievements are much better than yours, even though I am a dual cultivator, right?"
"We—"

"Senior, I don’t know what happened in this domain in the past, but I think your hatred towards dual cultivators is too excessive." Zhang Fei canceled everything before continuing. "Some dual cultivators are indeed vicious, and they use various heretical methods to improve their cultivation. However, it is unfair to assume that all dual cultivators share the same mentality, right? Look around you; there are no dual cultivators in this domain, but there are many evil cultivators here, right?"
You Jian released a heavy sigh and nodded to Zhang Fei. "You are right that not all dual cultivators are evil people, and not all non-dual cultivators are good people. However, you—"
"You want to say I should be aware of the traditions in this domain, right?" You Jian and You Feng nodded to Zhang Fei. "Senior, let me ask you two a simple question."
"What’s your question?"
"What is the purpose of your cultivation?"
You Jian and You Feng exchanged a confused glance for a moment before answering Zhang Fei. "We cultivate to defy the heavens and achieve longevity."

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed at that. "I’m not looking down on you two, as you’re both more senior and stronger than me. But my question is, how are you two going to defy the heavens if you can’t defy traditions?"
"That’s—" You Jian and You Feng were speechless, unable to refute Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei then spoke to them again. "Traditions arise because of past experiences, and they become one of the chains that chain us to worldly things. If you two cannot free yourselves from the worldly chains that restrain you, how will you fight against something as mysterious as the heavens? Even if the two of you cultivate for so long and manage to reach the pinnacle of cultivation like the Golden Dragon Emperor, you will never succeed in defying the heavens; instead, they will punish you for your arrogance in defying them."
"What do you know about the heavens? You—"

"Senior, my husband knows more about the heavens than you two." Both You Jian and You Feng looked at Luo Yunxiao, who walked to Zhang Fei’s side and hugged his arm. "My name is Luo Yunxiao, and I am the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."
"Huh?" Luo Yunxiao’s revelation shocked You Jian and You Feng, as they never knew that Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi had a daughter, but she immediately showed them her identity jade.

Luo Yunxiao then spoke to them again. "The heavens have repeatedly tried to kill my husband using lightning tribulations every time he breaks through, and they will definitely do it again once he breaks through to the Celestial King Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1312: Hereditary Curse
paragraphs: "What have you done to incur the wrath of heaven?" You Feng asked.
You Jian was also curious about this, as he couldn’t sense Zhang Fei’s killing intent or bloodlust, even though he had both activated all the time.
"Sigh." Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before spreading his killing intent and bloodlust within the room.

You Jian, You Feng, and their assistants hurriedly moved away from Zhang Fei, as his killing intent and bloodlust were too frightening and suffocating for them, forcing him to suppress the two of them back.
However, Zhang Fei’s actions did not escape the attention of the seniors of the You Clan, and two people appeared in the room while glaring at him.

You Feng spoke to them directly. "Grandfather You Ran! Grandmother Tan Yunxi! Please don’t misunderstand this young man; he has no intention of attacking us; instead, we asked him to show us his killing intent and bloodlust."

"Brother Feng is right, grandfather and grandmother." You Jian also spoke to the two new arrivals. "We were discussing several things earlier, including the heavens. Young Miss Luo told us that the heavens were trying to kill her husband, but we didn’t know the reason; thus, we asked him to explain it to us."
"Which Luo Clan?" Luo Yunxiao showed her jade identity to Tan Yunxi. "Eh? Are you really a member of the Luo Clan of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary?"

Luo Yunxiao nodded with a smile. "Senior, my parents are Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. Not many people from other domains know about my existence, but everyone from the Empyrean Domain already knows about me because they were present at our wedding."

"I see." Tan Yunxi nodded in understanding. "No one will dare to claim to be a member of the Luo Clan of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary as long as Luo Meizhen and the four of them are still alive and kicking."
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled at that. "Grandma Meizhen and the others are still alive, and they are getting stronger now; otherwise, those heretics would have attacked our clan long ago."

"I haven’t seen them in decades, and the last time I met them was when your parents returned to this realm. They invited us to Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan’s wedding, but we were forced to miss their wedding due to some issues." Tan Yunxi then looked at Zhang Fei. "Is he really your husband? How could Xiaoyi let you marry him if he never liked a dual cultivator?"

Luo Yunxiao hugged Zhang Fei’s arm before explaining. "Senior, I was born in one of the realms of the Three Mortal Realms, and we were childhood friends. We grew up together until we were ten years old, and I have liked him since then. Unfortunately, he was born as an ordinary mortal, and we had to part ways when my parents returned to this realm. Although I wasn’t sure we would ever meet again, I kept waiting for him to come to me. Fortunately, he managed to become a cultivator and ascended to this realm, and my hundreds of years of waiting were worth it, as we are now married."

"I see." Tan Yunxi nodded in understanding and spoke to Zhang Fei. "You are truly fortunate, young man. Your wife is the princess of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and men would surely flock to her if they knew of her existence, but she chose to wait for you for hundreds of years. Therefore, you must always love, protect, and look after her well."
Zhang Fei smiled in response. "Senior, Yunxiao is my wife. Naturally, I will always love her, and I will kill anyone who dares to hurt her."
"That’s good."

"Grandfather, look at these weapons." You Feng approached You Ran and handed over the three weapons that Zhang Fei had placed before. "This young man forged them by himself, and none of us helped him in the process."

With just one look, You Ran could see that these three were immortal-grade weapons, but he was shocked to hear that Zhang Fei forged all three by himself. Moreover, he was not assisted by anyone in the process, and he also forged them in a short time. "Do you—"

"Grandfather, this young man is a true supreme-rank blacksmith, unlike us swordsmiths." You Ran nodded to You Jian, who immediately continued. "Additionally, he is a god-rank alchemist and a god-rank swordmaster."
"What?" You Ran and Tan Yunxi exclaimed, staring at Zhang Fei in shock.

Luo Yunxiao smiled in amusement at their reactions. "Seniors, my husband is an expert soul cultivator, and he believes that something within your souls may be preventing you from forging weapons other than swords. Therefore, please allow him to examine your souls to determine whether his guess is correct."

’How did he learn all of them at such a young age?’ Both of them inwardly wondered, but then Tan Yunxi asked Zhang Fei. "How did you suspect that there’s something inside our souls, young man? In fact, we once asked Hun Lingwu of the Immortal Soul Palace to examine our souls, but he found nothing inside."

"Senior, swordsmithing is one branch of blacksmithing, right?" They nodded to Zhang Fei. "If you can forge swords, then you should also be able to forge other types of weapons, which makes me believe there is something unusual in your souls. After all, the soul is the most essential part of a living creature, so I want to examine your soul to find the cause and satisfy my curiosity."

Tan Yuxi turned to You Ran, who nodded to her before speaking to Zhang Fei directly. "Since you have such confidence, I will allow you to examine our souls. I don’t mean to belittle you, but Hun Lingwu of the Immortal Soul Palace is the best soul cultivator in this realm, and he couldn’t find anything inside our souls."

"Whether my suspicions are correct or not, we’ll know the answer after I examine your souls, so please take them out now." After You Ran, You Feng, and You Jian released their souls, Zhang Fei immediately activated his soul domain. He carefully checked their souls, and he found a small black symbol on all three of them.

’What kind of black symbol is that?’ Zhang Fei tried to touch one of the black symbols, but a black creature suddenly came out of it and attacked him, shocking all of them. Fortunately, they were in his soul domain, so he could immediately restrain the black creature. "This—Gah!"
The sudden attack knocked Zhang Fei back, but he swiftly stabilized himself. However, the black creature disappeared as it returned to the black symbol.
"Are you okay, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked, supporting her husband.
Tan Yuxin also asked Zhang Fei, "Do you know anything about that black symbol and black creature?"

"I’m fine, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei forced the three men’s souls back into their bodies and deactivated his soul domain. "I don’t have any information about that black creature, but I suspect it’s a curse."
"A curse?"
"Yes."
You Ran and the others exchanged confused glances, as they had never experienced or encountered anything or anyone that could curse them.
"Are you sure about that, young man?" You Ran asked.

Zhang Fei nodded in response. "Honestly, I’ve never seen a curse before, but I’m sure that the black symbol and the black creature are part of a curse technique. I don’t know how it got into your souls, but I think it’s a hereditary curse, and all members of your clan have inherited it from your ancestors."
"A hereditary curse?" Tan Yanxiu then asked her husband. "Did your clan’s ancestor ever experience such a thing in the past?"

"I’ve never heard of that, and my ancestors are no longer around, so we can’t find out the real information." You Ran turned to Zhang Fei and asked him a question. "Who do you think has that kind of curse technique?"
"Heretic cultivators or demons."
"Demons?"
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "The witch demon races are not only skilled in potions, but they are also skilled in curse techniques."
"Husband, I thought that heretical cultivators would never use such a restrictive curse, and they would use a killing curse." Luo Yunxiao spoke.

"Yes." Zhang Fei then spoke to them. "At first, I thought I could help you with this, but the results were different from what I had imagined. I don’t have any information about curse techniques, so I can’t do anything to help you. As Yunxiao said just now, those heretics would never use such a restrictive curse, so I dare say that the one who cursed your clansmen is a member of the witch demon race, and only a member of their race can remove it from your souls."

You Ran nodded in understanding. "I’m not knowledgeable about the demon races, but I’ve heard that the witch demon race is almost extinct, and no one has ever seen them again because their numbers are too few in this realm."

"Actually, I once heard from an acquaintance that there is a witch demon active in the Nightshade Domain, but it is close to the Celestial Demon Domain. If we go there, the celestial demon race will definitely notice our presence, and they will attack us directly." You Ran agreed with Zhang Fei. "Mo Shentian is too strong, and he can bend reality. If we meet him, we will definitely die at his hands."
"How are you familiar with the demon races, young man?" Tan Yuxin suspiciously asked.

"Whether my suspicions are correct or not, we’ll know the answer after I examine your souls, so please take them out now." After You Ran, You Feng, and You Jian released their souls, Zhang Fei immediately activated his soul domain.
He carefully checked their souls, and he found a small black symbol on all three of them.
’What kind of black symbol is that?’ Zhang Fei tried to touch one of the black symbols, but a black creature suddenly came out of it and attacked him, shocking all of them.
Fortunately, they were in his soul domain, so he could immediately restrain the black creature.
"This—Gah!"
The sudden attack knocked Zhang Fei back, but he swiftly stabilized himself.
However, the black creature disappeared as it returned to the black symbol.
"Are you okay, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked, supporting her husband.
Tan Yuxin also asked Zhang Fei, "Do you know anything about that black symbol and black creature?"
"I’m fine, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei forced the three men’s souls back into their bodies and deactivated his soul domain.
"I don’t have any information about that black creature, but I suspect it’s a curse."
"A curse?"
"Yes."
You Ran and the others exchanged confused glances, as they had never experienced or encountered anything or anyone that could curse them.
"Are you sure about that, young man?" You Ran asked.
Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"Honestly, I’ve never seen a curse before, but I’m sure that the black symbol and the black creature are part of a curse technique.
I don’t know how it got into your souls, but I think it’s a hereditary curse, and all members of your clan have inherited it from your ancestors."
"A hereditary curse?" Tan Yanxiu then asked her husband.
"Did your clan’s ancestor ever experience such a thing in the past?"
"I’ve never heard of that, and my ancestors are no longer around, so we can’t find out the real information." You Ran turned to Zhang Fei and asked him a question.
"Who do you think has that kind of curse technique?"
"Heretic cultivators or demons."
"Demons?"
Zhang Fei nodded at him.
"The witch demon races are not only skilled in potions, but they are also skilled in curse techniques."
"Husband, I thought that heretical cultivators would never use such a restrictive curse, and they would use a killing curse." Luo Yunxiao spoke.
"Yes." Zhang Fei then spoke to them.
"At first, I thought I could help you with this, but the results were different from what I had imagined.
I don’t have any information about curse techniques, so I can’t do anything to help you.

As Yunxiao said just now, those heretics would never use such a restrictive curse, so I dare say that the one who cursed your clansmen is a member of the witch demon race, and only a member of their race can remove it from your souls."
You Ran nodded in understanding.
"I’m not knowledgeable about the demon races, but I’ve heard that the witch demon race is almost extinct, and no one has ever seen them again because their numbers are too few in this realm."
"Actually, I once heard from an acquaintance that there is a witch demon active in the Nightshade Domain, but it is close to the Celestial Demon Domain.
If we go there, the celestial demon race will definitely notice our presence, and they will attack us directly." You Ran agreed with Zhang Fei.
"Mo Shentian is too strong, and he can bend reality.
If we meet him, we will definitely die at his hands."
"How are you familiar with the demon races, young man?" Tan Yuxin suspiciously asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1313: Immortal Soul Crystal
paragraphs: Zhang Fei asked the assistants to leave before taking out the memory extractor device, and he displayed some of his memories through it. "My sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal sect, and our members come from various races now. Humans, beasts, natural races, demons, and winged races live side by side within it. Although they had difficulty mingling with each other at first, they gradually grew into each other’s presence."
"Husband, aren’t they—"
"Yes." You Ran nodded to Tan Yuxin. "One of them is the princess of the celestial dragon race, Tianshi Shengjie. The other one is Tian Yizu’s daughter, Tian Huangjin."
Tan Yuxin looked at Zhang Fei again. "How do you know them?"

"I met them in the Three Mortal Realms." Zhang Fei’s answer surprised both seniors. "I met Tianshi Shengjie in a realm, but I only met her avatar. I met Tian Huangjin when she was hunting Xereth there, and I helped her capture him. Since then, we have had a positive relationship with each other."
"What about those natural races?" You Jian asked, pointing his index finger to one of the screens.

Zhang Fei looked at the screen and explained. "I met all of them on three different planets in the Three Mortal Realms. Some of them came from the lower realm, where I started my cultivation path. Some others came from the middle and upper realms, where I met some of my other wives."
"Huh?" The four people looked at Luo Yunxiao and the others in shock.
"Haha." Wu Lianzhi laughed at their reactions. "Our husband has more than a hundred wives, and all of us live under one roof."
"Most of us have been together for almost three decades, so our relationship is incredibly close and harmonious, and much better than most people’s relationships." Xu Ling’er added.
Mu Lingshu and Ning Zhuan’er said nothing, simply nodding their heads at the four senior cultivators, making them feel strange about their relationship.

Tan Yuxin looked at Luo Yunxiao, who smiled at her. "Senior, we belong to our husband; we live and die for him. My parents have known about my husband’s relationship for a long time, and they don’t have a problem with it; otherwise, they wouldn’t let me marry him, right?"

"You’re right." Tan Yuxin nodded at Luo Yunxiao. "I know your mother’s character quite well, and she would never allow you to marry him if she didn’t know him well. So, back to the original problem, what did you actually discuss with our grandsons before? Why did you release your killing intent and bloodlust in our clan?"
You Jian immediately explained everything to You Ran and Tan Yuxin from the beginning until Zhang Fei released your killing intent and bloodlust, which caught both of their attention.
You Ran nodded in understanding. "Young man, we—"

"Senior, I don’t mean to lecture you, but I can tell you that this universe is far more profound than you can imagine." You Ran and Tan Yuxin looked at Zhang Fei seriously. "I can’t explain the details because you two must explore and understand everything for yourselves, especially about the heavens, the dao, and many other things. If you remain attached to such trivial worldly matters, you will be stuck in this situation for the rest of your lives; if that happens, how will you defy the heavens? The heavens are much stronger than you imagine because I have faced them too many times, and you will die if you try to defy them."

Zhang Fei replaced the images that appeared on the screen with his memories of when he faced all his lightning tribulations, especially those in the Moon Illusion Domain years ago. The manifestation of the heavens that appeared on the screen caused the four people from the You Clan to gasp in shock.

"I don’t dare say that I’m better than you as a living being because I still have some attachments to worldly matters myself, but I dare say that I understand some things much better than you." Zhang Fei pointed at the screen. "Everything you see in it is all the evidence."

"My sword is my Dao; the heavens shall tremble before my sword! One sword, one strike, eliminate all obstacles before me! If you block my path, you will die! Even if all the realms fall, my sword will remain!" You Ran recited Zhang Fei’s words that sounded from the screen.

Tan Yuxin also did the same thing with her husband, repeating Zhang Fei’s words. "Heaven gives birth to materials, Earth nurtures them, and Man refines them! Alchemy is not just about concocting pills, and it is a miracle from the heavens. My flame can burn anything, but it can also create anything! This is my Dao of alchemy!"
’Hey, Brother Jian, isn’t that golden beast the golden crow?’ You Feng noticed the bird that appeared when Zhang Fei and his five clones refined the lightning from his lightning tribulations.
You Jian nodded in agreement. ’You’re right, it is indeed a golden crow, which means this young man possesses its bloodline; otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to use its golden flame.’

"Have either of you comprehended your dao?" You Ran and Tan Yuxin shook their heads at Zhang Fei. "That’s why I say free yourselves from those worldly chains, or you’ll never be able to see the depths of cultivation and the mysteries hidden within this universe. Dual cultivation path is a choice, and becoming dual cultivators is people’s right. Right or wrong has nothing to do with a person’s chosen path, and it comes from the person’s own mindset and character. Some dual cultivators are evil, but many universal cultivators are far more evil than them."
You Ran let out a heavy sigh. "Are you saying all this because of You Shiyan?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei denied with a shake of his head. "I say all this not because of one or two people, but for the sake of all the dual cultivators who have always been marginalized in this realm. I don’t think about being their savior, and I just want other cultivators to be more open-minded about us."
Tan Yuxin then spoke. "We understand what you mean, but you must know that changing traditions that have been passed down through generations is not as easy as turning over the palm of our hand, so—"

"Whether it’s easy or not is not the main issue, and the main issue is whether you want to change or not. There is a saying in my home realm that says ’if there’s a will, there’s a way,’ so the final result depends on you." Zhang Fei turned off the memory extractor and put it away before taking out a piece of paper and handing it to You Ran. "Senior, my original purpose in coming here was to search for these materials, and I wanted to use them to forge my new weapon, but I didn’t know if you had them."
You Ran and the others read the materials on the list. "These materials aren’t for forging a new weapon, but they’re more useful for upgrading a soul weapon."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei chose to admit it. "I have a soul weapon, but it is still a divine grade, so I want to upgrade it to the immortal grade."

You Ran nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, we don’t have these materials in stock because some of them are very rare, and the price of each of them is exorbitant. If you want to get all these materials, you have to wait at least ten years, especially for the Immortal Soul Crystal, which is the most expensive among them at around one hundred million golden jewels."
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei instantly cursed after learning the price. "One hundred million golden jewels for one material is really too much!"

"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao burst into laughter when she heard that. "Husband, I don’t understand forging, but the Immortal Soul Crystal is indeed extremely rare, and you need extra patience to obtain it. Even if you wait ten years, you might not be able to obtain one. Since the time it takes to find them is very long, you must be more patient while collecting golden jewels, and I will help you if you are short of them."
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before speaking to You Ran. "Senior, please help me to get these materials, and you can contact me whenever you get one of them."
"Alright." You Ran handed the list to You Feng. "Bring it to our shop and order them to send people looking for these materials."
"Yes, Grandfather."
Zhang Fei spoke to them again. "All seniors, my business here is finished now, so I’ll take all my wives away because I still have to look for some other materials for formation arrays."

"Formation arrays? Do you want to go to the Fei Clan? Are you also an array master?" Zhang Fei answered Tan Yuxin with a smile, making her sigh helplessly. "The Fei Clan’s hatred for dual cultivators is even more extreme than ours because many of their clan members fell victim to evil dual cultivators in the past, so I advise you not to bring them to that clan. Additionally, you should avoid mentioning Fei Yinglin in front of them, or they will consider you an enemy and attack you."
"The situation at the Fei Clan is that bad, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered under his breath. "Thank you for your advice, senior. We’ll be leaving now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1314: Cangyun City
paragraphs: You Ran and Tan Yuxin walked out of the workshop together. "Do you think we should change the rules within our clan, wife?"

"Honestly, that young man’s words are correct." Tan Yuxin turned to her husband before continuing. "However, this tradition has existed for generations, so I think changing it will be very difficult. Even so, there’s no harm in trying, and I think it would be better for our clan, but we must do it slowly and let our members adapt to the changes."
"Let’s try to start changing that tradition." You Ran then asked her. "Do you want to accompany me to the Moonlit Passion Temple?"
"Eh?" Tang Yuxin was momentarily surprised. "Do you want to prove for yourself the truth of the images we saw before?"

You Ran nodded slightly in response. "The young man has extraordinary abilities, and we have quite extensive connections, especially in blacksmithing. If the situation in the sect is like that now, I think that establishing a positive relationship with them would greatly benefit both parties."

"In that case, we don’t need to wait for that young man to return to his sect, and we will go there today to see the situation there in person." After she contacted and instructed several members of her clan, Tan Yuxin and You Ran immediately left the You Clan for the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Zhang Fei arrived at Cangyun City, but he was only accompanied by Luo Yunxiao and Fei Yinglin. For personal reasons, You Shiyan waited in the lower city instead of joining them.

Before they entered Cangyun City, Zhang Fei had already sent Mu Lingshu, Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, and Ning Zhuan’er back to his sect, especially after the You Clan members had previously advised him not to bring them to that city.
Additionally, Zhang Fei used his body modification ability to change Fei Yinglin’s appearance so her presence wouldn’t bring any trouble to them.

Cangyun City was built upon a sea of clouds suspended between two colossal pillars that pierce the skies, and its civilization was the most advanced of any city or planet that Zhang Fei had ever seen. It. Its citizens were a mixture of noble cultivators, array masters, and artifact crafters. It was governed by the Cangyun Council, which governs all regulations within the city.

Unlike the Tianzhu City, which was filled with mental booms and smoke, or the Lianxu City, which was filled with people seeking treatment, the Cangyun City was more similar to modern cities on Earth, making Zhang Fei feel like he was at home.

However, Cangyun City was more advanced than cities on Earth. Even the Xianjin Realm, the most advanced planet in the Three Mortal Realms, couldn’t compare to it. It was the epicenter of formation arrays, artifact crafting, and modern technology.

To reach Cangyun City, they couldn’t fly directly because it was shrouded by a special barrier, like the floating plateau where the Moonlit Pavilion Temple was located or the floating island belonging to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. They had to travel to the small city below, where several teleportation portals connected them to it. The most striking landmark in the city was the twin bridge that connects two pillars.
Since Fei Yinglin was a native of Cangyun City, she led Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao to look around the city while explaining to them about the Cangyun Council and the rules within the city.

"This city is truly advanced, thriving, and lively! Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji would surely be thrilled if I brought them here. Zhang Fei looked at Fei Yinglin and questioned her. "Where does your clan live, Yinglin?"

"Over there, Elder Zhang." Fei Yinglin pointed to a futuristic five-story building floating a few meters in front of them with a statue of a man on top. "The statue above my clan residence is the founder of our clan, Fei Xuanyang. He was the best artifact crafter in the past, but he was not talented in cultivation, and he died out of lifespan. After his era, our clan continued to produce reliable artifact crafters and array masters, and our clan became the best in those two fields in this domain."
"Which clan is the second best in both fields?"

Fei Yinglin pointed to a building that was no less large and magnificent than the Fei Clan. "People consider the Liao Clan to be second best, but in fact, their members’ abilities are on par with our Fei Clan’s, and the two clans constantly compete in both fields to prove who is the best among them. The difference between the two clans is their total strength, and the Liao Clan is slightly weaker than our Fei Clan."
"Who is the best array master in both clans?" Zhang Fei asked again.
"Fei Minghan is the best in our Fei Clan, and Liao Hanxue is the best in the Liao Clan."

Luo Yunxiao smiled when she saw Zhang Fei’s expression and smile, and she knew for sure that he was thinking of Liao Hanxue, who was clearly a woman. "Are you thinking about going to the Liao Clan and meeting Liao Hanxue, husband?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Among all my wives, only Duanmu Luolan truly masters formation arrays, so I want to recruit a few others to assist her in the Array Hall. However, you know my character yourself, and I will never allow any man to be around her."
"Pfft! Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed heartily at that. "You are such a possessive husband, but we all like you like that."

Fei Yinglin smiled in amusement as she listened to them. Since Zhang Fei had lived in the Moonlit Passion Sect for quite some time, she was naturally familiar with his character. "Are you and the others really okay with Elder Zhang acting like that, Sister Yunxiao? Won’t his attitude only limit your relationships with others?"

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled. "Actually, my husband never forbade us from getting to know other men, and he just doesn’t like them staying around us too long. Moreover, you already know that we know many other men because they live in our sect now."
"Well, that’s true." Fei Yinglin nodded in agreement before asking Zhang Fei. "Do you want to go to one of the clans now, Elder Zhang?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei pondered for a while before deciding. "We spent too much time in the You Clan, and it’s getting late now. Therefore, I think we’ll stay in this city tonight, and I’ll go to the Liao Clan first tomorrow."
"Where’s the best hotel, Yinglin?"

"Over there, Sister Yunxiao." Fei Yinglin pointed her index finger at a hundred-story building. "That hotel belongs to the Liao Clan, and Liao Hanxue often appears there, especially on the top floor. If you two stay there, you can see the entire domain, but the price per room is costly."
"How expensive?"
"Ten thousand golden jewels per night."
"Fuck!" Luo Yunxiao and Fei Yinglin laughed when they heard Zhang Fei cursing. "There’s nothing cheap in this domain!"
Luo Yunxiao spoke straight away. "Husband, this domain is the most advanced in this realm, so it’s natural that everything is expensive, right?"
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei sighed heavily. "You should come with us, Yinglin."
"Eh?" Fei Yinglin was surprised. "But Elder Zhang, you two—"
"Just join us, Yinglin." Luo Yunxio grabbed Fei Yinglin’s hand and pulled her toward the hotel.

Zhang Fei followed behind them, browsing the shops along the street, but the prices of the goods displayed inside made him sigh heavily, especially since they were too high. Moreover, he only had one shop in the Paradise Realm, so his number of golden jewels wasn’t that large yet. ’Sigh! I have to open more shops soon, or I’ll continue to have difficulty purchasing essential items in this realm.’
"This isn’t a bedroom, but a football field!" Zhang Fei shouted as soon as they arrived inside their room. "Moreover, this room looks small from the outside, but it’s this big inside."
"What’s football, Elder Zhang?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly. "It’s a sport in my home realm, but only ordinary humans play it."

"Oh." Fei Yinglin then asked Zhang Fei. "Did you see that room at the north end, Elder Zhang? That room is Liao Hanxue’s private room, and she usually spends her time alone there when she’s brainstorming ideas for her new formations. As for this bedroom, it is actually a private space, and the Liao Clan created it themselves."
Zhang Fei tried to check the bedroom at the north end using the map, but it couldn’t show anything. "Did the Liao Clan really create an artifact that can create a private space?"
"Yes." Fei Yinglin nodded in response. "Actually, my Fei Clan also has such an artifact, but the Liao Clan’s is much better and more spacious."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin in thought. "The price of that artifact must be very expensive, right?"

"The price of an artifact depends on its size, Elder Zhang." Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao looked at Fei Yinglin with curious looks. "The smallest one costs ten million golden jewels, and the one as big as this bedroom costs one hundred million golden jewels."

Zhang Fei was utterly speechless, but he didn’t need such artifacts because he had his training space. Moreover, he had the portable mansion that he could move whenever and wherever he wanted, so such artifacts were useless to him.
"I’ll sleep in that room, Elder Zhang and Sister Yunxiao." Fei Yinglin then walked away, leaving them.

"In that case, we don’t need to wait for that young man to return to his sect, and we will go there today to see the situation there in person." After she contacted and instructed several members of her clan, Tan Yuxin and You Ran immediately left the You Clan for the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Zhang Fei arrived at Cangyun City, but he was only accompanied by Luo Yunxiao and Fei Yinglin.
For personal reasons, You Shiyan waited in the lower city instead of joining them.

Before they entered Cangyun City, Zhang Fei had already sent Mu Lingshu, Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, and Ning Zhuan’er back to his sect, especially after the You Clan members had previously advised him not to bring them to that city.
Additionally, Zhang Fei used his body modification ability to change Fei Yinglin’s appearance so her presence wouldn’t bring any trouble to them.

Cangyun City was built upon a sea of clouds suspended between two colossal pillars that pierce the skies, and its civilization was the most advanced of any city or planet that Zhang Fei had ever seen.
It.
Its citizens were a mixture of noble cultivators, array masters, and artifact crafters.
It was governed by the Cangyun Council, which governs all regulations within the city.

Unlike the Tianzhu City, which was filled with mental booms and smoke, or the Lianxu City, which was filled with people seeking treatment, the Cangyun City was more similar to modern cities on Earth, making Zhang Fei feel like he was at home.
However, Cangyun City was more advanced than cities on Earth.
Even the Xianjin Realm, the most advanced planet in the Three Mortal Realms, couldn’t compare to it.
It was the epicenter of formation arrays, artifact crafting, and modern technology.

To reach Cangyun City, they couldn’t fly directly because it was shrouded by a special barrier, like the floating plateau where the Moonlit Pavilion Temple was located or the floating island belonging to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
They had to travel to the small city below, where several teleportation portals connected them to it.
The most striking landmark in the city was the twin bridge that connects two pillars.
Since Fei Yinglin was a native of Cangyun City, she led Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao to look around the city while explaining to them about the Cangyun Council and the rules within the city.
"This city is truly advanced, thriving, and lively!
Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji would surely be thrilled if I brought them here.
Zhang Fei looked at Fei Yinglin and questioned her.
"Where does your clan live, Yinglin?"
"Over there, Elder Zhang." Fei Yinglin pointed to a futuristic five-story building floating a few meters in front of them with a statue of a man on top.
"The statue above my clan residence is the founder of our clan, Fei Xuanyang.
He was the best artifact crafter in the past, but he was not talented in cultivation, and he died out of lifespan.
After his era, our clan continued to produce reliable artifact crafters and array masters, and our clan became the best in those two fields in this domain."
"Which clan is the second best in both fields?"
Fei Yinglin pointed to a building that was no less large and magnificent than the Fei Clan.

"People consider the Liao Clan to be second best, but in fact, their members’ abilities are on par with our Fei Clan’s, and the two clans constantly compete in both fields to prove who is the best among them.
The difference between the two clans is their total strength, and the Liao Clan is slightly weaker than our Fei Clan."
"Who is the best array master in both clans?" Zhang Fei asked again.
"Fei Minghan is the best in our Fei Clan, and Liao Hanxue is the best in the Liao Clan."
Luo Yunxiao smiled when she saw Zhang Fei’s expression and smile, and she knew for sure that he was thinking of Liao Hanxue, who was clearly a woman.
"Are you thinking about going to the Liao Clan and meeting Liao Hanxue, husband?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"Among all my wives, only Duanmu Luolan truly masters formation arrays, so I want to recruit a few others to assist her in the Array Hall.
However, you know my character yourself, and I will never allow any man to be around her."
"Pfft!
Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed heartily at that.
"You are such a possessive husband, but we all like you like that."
Fei Yinglin smiled in amusement as she listened to them.
Since Zhang Fei had lived in the Moonlit Passion Sect for quite some time, she was naturally familiar with his character.
"Are you and the others really okay with Elder Zhang acting like that, Sister Yunxiao?
Won’t his attitude only limit your relationships with others?"
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled.
"Actually, my husband never forbade us from getting to know other men, and he just doesn’t like them staying around us too long.
Moreover, you already know that we know many other men because they live in our sect now."
"Well, that’s true." Fei Yinglin nodded in agreement before asking Zhang Fei.
"Do you want to go to one of the clans now, Elder Zhang?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei pondered for a while before deciding.
"We spent too much time in the You Clan, and it’s getting late now.
Therefore, I think we’ll stay in this city tonight, and I’ll go to the Liao Clan first tomorrow."
"Where’s the best hotel, Yinglin?"
"Over there, Sister Yunxiao." Fei Yinglin pointed her index finger at a hundred-story building.
"That hotel belongs to the Liao Clan, and Liao Hanxue often appears there, especially on the top floor.
If you two stay there, you can see the entire domain, but the price per room is costly."
"How expensive?"
"Ten thousand golden jewels per night."
"Fuck!" Luo Yunxiao and Fei Yinglin laughed when they heard Zhang Fei cursing.
"There’s nothing cheap in this domain!"
Luo Yunxiao spoke straight away.
"Husband, this domain is the most advanced in this realm, so it’s natural that everything is expensive, right?"
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei sighed heavily.
"You should come with us, Yinglin."
"Eh?" Fei Yinglin was surprised.
"But Elder Zhang, you two—"
"Just join us, Yinglin." Luo Yunxio grabbed Fei Yinglin’s hand and pulled her toward the hotel.
Zhang Fei followed behind them, browsing the shops along the street, but the prices of the goods displayed inside made him sigh heavily, especially since they were too high.
Moreover, he only had one shop in the Paradise Realm, so his number of golden jewels wasn’t that large yet. ’Sigh!
I have to open more shops soon, or I’ll continue to have difficulty purchasing essential items in this realm.’
"This isn’t a bedroom, but a football field!" Zhang Fei shouted as soon as they arrived inside their room.
"Moreover, this room looks small from the outside, but it’s this big inside."
"What’s football, Elder Zhang?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly.
"It’s a sport in my home realm, but only ordinary humans play it."
"Oh." Fei Yinglin then asked Zhang Fei.
"Did you see that room at the north end, Elder Zhang?
That room is Liao Hanxue’s private room, and she usually spends her time alone there when she’s brainstorming ideas for her new formations.
As for this bedroom, it is actually a private space, and the Liao Clan created it themselves."
Zhang Fei tried to check the bedroom at the north end using the map, but it couldn’t show anything.
"Did the Liao Clan really create an artifact that can create a private space?"
"Yes." Fei Yinglin nodded in response.
"Actually, my Fei Clan also has such an artifact, but the Liao Clan’s is much better and more spacious."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin in thought.
"The price of that artifact must be very expensive, right?"
"The price of an artifact depends on its size, Elder Zhang." Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao looked at Fei Yinglin with curious looks.
"The smallest one costs ten million golden jewels, and the one as big as this bedroom costs one hundred million golden jewels."
Zhang Fei was utterly speechless, but he didn’t need such artifacts because he had his training space.
Moreover, he had the portable mansion that he could move whenever and wherever he wanted, so such artifacts were useless to him.
"I’ll sleep in that room, Elder Zhang and Sister Yunxiao." Fei Yinglin then walked away, leaving them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315: Visitors
paragraphs: Luo Yunxiao lay beside Zhang Fei with her hand inside his trousers, caressing and squeezing his dick. "Will your fifth clone stay there for long, husband?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded at Luo Yunxiao. "According to the old fox’s soul, the process will be completed in at least six months and at most one year."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "Yan Jinwu, Sima Huiqing, and Qing Qiu’er have not dual cultivated with your fifth clone for a long time, so I believe you should replace your fifth clone with a different one, husband."

"Yeah, you’re right." Through his fifth clone, Zhang Fei asked the old fox’s soul about the matter. Since the old fox’s soul said that it didn’t matter, he replaced his fifth clone with his fourth clone before sending him back to the sect. However, he found the two seniors from the You Clan in front of his sect. "You Ran and Tan Yuxin are in our sect now."

Luo Yunxiao looked up at Zhang Fei. "I don’t think it’s a problem; they probably just want to confirm the truth with their own eyes. Why haven’t you taken You Feiling as your partner yet? Not to mention, there’s still Fang Roulan and several female elders without partners, right?"

Through his fifth clone, Zhang Fei asked Tian Kui and Serpentera to let the two guests into the sect; he then answered Luo Yunxiao. "I am interested in You Feiling, but she is not yet ready to be my partner. As for Fang Roulan and the other female elders, I know you want me to become stronger faster, but I have no interest in them. Therefore, I will never take them as partners, but I will help them develop themselves in other areas."
"Then, what are your next plans?"

"I want to open some shops as soon as possible because I want to forge lots of new weapons and equipment for you guys, but the prices of those materials are simply too expensive." Luo Yunxiao wanted to say something, but Zhang Fei immediately covered her mouth. "I know you can help me with jewels, but I can’t depend on you forever. You are all my wives, so I have to be responsible for you all. This domain is one of the best choices for opening my shop, and I’m sure I can get lots of jewels here. Unfortunately, the situation is too complicated, and we still don’t have the right allies here."
"What about the Qiao and You Clans?"

Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "The people from the Qiao Clan aren’t bad, and I’ve examined all of their souls. However, they focus more on the medical field, so I’m not sure if they can help me with my shop. If they can help me, they can only help me sell a few types of pills. The You Clan has several shops, but their focus is swordsmithing, and my items are more general, so they won’t be able to help me."

"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "In that case, we should wait to meet the Fei and Liao Clans first, but I’m not sure the former will be willing to help you, especially with your status as a dual cultivator. Therefore, the best choice is the latter, and Liao Hanxue will probably be your right choice."

"Yes." Zhang Fei agreed with that. "Let’s wait until tomorrow, and we’ll go to the Liao Clan directly. I hope they aren’t too hostile toward dual cultivators, and it would be great if they were willing to become our business partners."

After that, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao sat on the bed, and they took off their clothes. They summoned their avatars, released their souls, and began both dual cultivation and dual-soul cultivation simultaneously.
In the sect, Zhang Fei [5] sat with Yan Jinwu, Sima Huiqing, and Qing Qiu’er while watching You Ran and Tan Yuxin, who were looking around their sect.
"Husband, I think you should buy the time formation, and we can install it in our sect to speed up our people’s cultivation."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Qing Qiu’er. "Time formations are very rare, you know? Moreover, such a formation wouldn’t be able to cover a large area, and we can only place it in one place."

"I know that." Qing Qiu’er replied with a nod. "Even if it can only cover a small area, it will still be beneficial to us, right? If we combine it with Jin Zhongli’s gravity techniques, we can build a special place where the flow of time is faster and the gravity is also much heavier, which will significantly improve our disciples’ abilities."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "My real body is in Cangyun City now, and I will meet the Liao Clan tomorrow. The Liao and Fei Clans focus on formation arrays and artifact forging, and they may have a time formation array. Even if they do have one, the price will be exorbitant, and we might not be able to afford it."

"At least, you could try asking them first, right?" Qing Qiu’er then stood up and took off her dress, followed by Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing. "The three of us haven’t dual cultivated with you in a long time, so we want to do it now, okay?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that, but he immediately summoned his avatars. "Summon your avatars first, and we’ll start dual cultivating right away."
Qing Qiu’er hurriedly summoned her avatars, and she began to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei [5], with Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing waiting for their turn beside the two.
"Oh? What are you two doing in this sect?" Jian Kuang questioned You Ran and Tan Yuxin, who had just arrived at the Sword Hall.

You Ran and Tan Yuxin were slightly surprised by Jian Kuang’s presence because they hadn’t seen him in Zhang Fei’s memories, and they were even more surprised when Su Shentian appeared there. However, they could not recognize Zhuxian Sheng and Han Ling, as they had never met the two men before.
"Why are you two in this sect?"

"Ha ha." Jian Kuang laughed in response. "I like that kid, Zhang Fei. He asked me to help him train disciples from this sect, and since I don’t have any business outside, I decided to stay here and help him."

"My reasons are not much different from Old Jian’s." Su Shentian then asked them. "Did you two come to this sect after meeting Zhang Fei? If I remember correctly, your clan never liked dual cultivators, so your arrival was quite surprising."
Tan Yuxin nodded at them. "Zhang Fei visited our clan before, and he showed us some things, so we decided to come here to confirm the truth."
"Have you all seen the truth now?"

"Not yet." Your Ran replied with a headshake. "We just arrived at this sect, and we went straight to this hall because Zhang Fei previously used his killing intent and bloodlust, and we knew that he was a god-rank swordmaster, so we wanted to know about this hall first."
"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed before pointing to Han Ling. "Little Han is Zhang Fei’s master in swordsmanship, and he is also a god-rank swordmaster like us."
Both You Ran and Tan Yuxin looked at Han Ling directly, but they felt that his cultivation was still too low, and Zhang Fei was much stronger than him.

Seeing that the two people doubted Han Lin, Jian Kuang immediately spoke to them again. "They met in the Three Mortal Realms, and they ascended to this realm at the same time. However, Little Han is not a dual cultivator, so his cultivation is slower than that kid’s. In fact, most of the new members of this sect also came from that realm, so their overall strength is still not as great as that of other supreme sects."

"Even though they came from the Three Mortal Realms, many of them are experts in their respective fields." Su Shentian then pointed towards the Alchemy Hall, which was located a little away from the Sword Hall. "If you go there, you will meet three god-rank alchemists there, and one of them is Empress Huo’s subordinate."
"Empress... Empress Huo." You Ran and Tan Yuxin stuttered. "Is... is Zhang Fei really related to Empress Huo?"

Jian Kuang nodded at them. "Empress Huo has visited this sect several times, and she also joined Zhang Fei in the Endless Night Dungeon before. She declared that this sect is under her protection, and anyone who disturbs it will be her enemy. Since that kid told you some things and you guys came here in person, I presume he wants to build cooperation with your clan, so you should consider your choice carefully."
"I see." Ran You and Tan Yuxin nodded at them. "In that case, the two of us will take a look around the other halls first."
After the two of them left, Zhuxian Sheng asked the others, "Do you think they will really accept Zhang Fei’s offer?"

"If the two of them reject Zhang Fei’s offer, then they are the biggest fools." Su Shentian nodded in agreement with Jian Kuang. "Little Han, let’s continue our spar, and Sheng will spar with Old Su."

After touring all the halls of the Moonlit Passion Sect, You Ran and Tan Yuxin decided to leave the sect and began considering partnering with Zhang Fei. However, they couldn’t make a decision right away and had to discuss the matter with their members first.

chapters.title: Chapter 1316: Liao Hanxue
paragraphs: After returning to the You Clan, You Ran and Tan Yuxin gathered all their clan members to explain everything they had seen in the Moonlit Passion Temple.

After a long and difficult discussion, they decided to establish a cooperative relationship with the Moonlit Passion Temple, and their main reason was Zhang Fei’s relationship with Feng Yao. Additionally, he also had favorable relations with the beast and winged races, and he still had many experts in various fields in his sect, all of which would benefit their clan.
After they agreed, You Ran and Tan Yuxin asked them to prepare some things, and they intended to give them to the Moonlit Passion Temple as a token of their cooperation.
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
[Master, Liao Hanxue has appeared.]
Hearing that, Zhang Fei signaled Luo Yunxiao to stop their cultivation. "What happened?"
"Liao Hanxue is already in this hotel." Luo Yunxiao was momentarily taken aback before nodding to Zhang Fei. "Shall we try to meet her now?"
"Let’s go." Luo Yunxiao pulled Zhang Fei down from the bed, and the two hurriedly got dressed.
*Knock... Knock...*
"Who?"

Luo Yunxiao looked at Zhang Fei before answering Liao Hanxue. "Senior Hanxue, my name is Luo Yunxiao from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and I hope to meet you first before I visit your Liao Clan tomorrow."
*Crack*
As Luo Yunxiao expected, Liao Hanxue immediately opened the door of her room as soon as she heard the name of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

Liao Hanxue’s face is youthful and well-defined, with a natural charm. Her skin is smooth and fair, her nose is slim, and her lips are soft with a subtle pink tint. Her gaze is sharp but composed. A sheer, layered gown of pale silver tones trimmed with gold embraces her slim, well-proportioned figure with a noticeable chest and deep curves.

Liao Hanxue’s hair is long, straight, and a deep brown shade with a smooth, glossy texture. It is neatly styled with a decorative hairpiece featuring a silver-blue flower and fine details that match the tones of her dress.

Liao Hanxue momentarily raised an eyebrow when she saw Zhang Fei, but she immediately shifted her gaze to Luo Yunxiao before asking, "Are you really a member of the Luo Clan? Why haven’t I heard your name before?"

"I am truly a member of the Luo Clan." Luo Yunxiao immediately showed her identity to Liao Hanxue. "Not many people know about me because my parents had several powerful enemies, so they deliberately hid me from the public in the past."

Liao Hanxue took Luo Yunxiao’s jade, and she observed it for a while before returning it to her. "I’ve met Huang Xiaoyi several times in the past, so I can confirm that your jade is indeed genuine. So, what is your purpose in looking for me?"

"My husband is looking for some formation arrays for our sects, and one of our disciples said that you are the best in that field, so we came to see you." After Luo Yunxiao spoke, Liao Hanxue cast a displeased glance at Zhang Fei. "Our sect is the Moonlit Passion Temple, but it is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal sect."

Liao Hanxue was momentarily taken aback. "I’ve heard about the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple, but I didn’t expect a princess of the Luo Clan like you to choose a dual cultivator as your husband. Furthermore, he has quite a few women, as I can detect over a hundred different Yin Qis in his body."

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed in response. "Unlike the people of this domain, I never care about other people’s choices, as everyone has the freedom to choose the cultivation path they desire. Oh, his name is Zhang Fei; he is my childhood friend, and we have loved each other since childhood. So, can we talk inside?"
"Come in."
After the two of them sat down on the sofa, Liao Hanxue sat across from them and observed Zhang Fei for a while. "So, what kind of formation array are you looking for?"
"Do you have a time formation array, Senior?" Zhang Fei returned the question.

chapters.title: Chapter 1317: Liao Hanxue Agreed
paragraphs: Liao Hanxue shook her head at Luo Yunxiao. "Like I said before, the materials to create the formation array are difficult to obtain, so I don’t have them in stock. If you really want to create one, I’ll help you gather those materials, but I won’t be able to gather them anytime soon."

"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "In that case, help us collect those materials, Senior. If possible, I want you to collect them to create two formation arrays, as my husband has another plan."
Zhang Fei turned to Luo Yunxiao in surprise, as he had not told her about his other plans for the formation array, but she had already guessed it.

Liao Hanxue briefly glanced at Zhang Fei before nodding to Luo Yunxiao. "Alright, I will collect those materials to create two formation arrays. What other purpose do you guys have for wanting to go to my Liao Clan?"

"I have some purpose to meet your clan, Senior." Liao Hanxue curiously looked at Zhang Fei. "First, I need a teleportation portal that can connect the Three Mortal Realms with the Paradise Realm, but I want it to be one-way."

"I’m not sure my clan can help you with that, kid." Liao Hanxue explained it directly to them. "Actually, my clan and the Fei Clan have repeatedly tried to create a teleportation portal to connect the two realms, but our attempts always ended in a dead end because the barrier blocked the path. Therefore, we have no other choice but to go back and forth between the two realms through those passages, and the people of the Three Mortal Realms must break through to the Five Celestial Realms first."

"Unfortunately, cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms will never be able to break through to the Five Celestial Realms due to the absence of Celestial Qi there." Liao Hanxue looked at Zhang Fei confusedly, as he previously ascended from that realm. "I ascended to this realm before I broke through to this stage, Senior. Feng Yao told me the way to go to this realm, and I also have some acquaintances who came from this realm before I ascended."

Liao Hanxue nodded understandingly. "To this day, my clan and the Fei Clan are still trying to find a way to create such a teleportation portal, but we still haven’t found a solution to bypass the barrier. If only there were someone who had the ability to go back and forth between the two realms without going through those passages, we might be able to find a solution by analyzing his or her abilities first."
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled at that. "Husband, show your abilities, husband."

"Yeah." Liao Hanxue hurriedly stood up from her seat as soon as Zhang Fei opened a gate leading to one of the realms in the Three Mortal Realms. He pulled Luo Yunxiao to his feet. "Shall we go there, Senior?"
"Let’s go there, Sheng." Liao Hanxue immediately pulled Zhuxian Sheng and brought him into the gate, followed by Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao.

"Unbelievable! We actually arrived at the Three Mortal Realms in just the blink of an eye!" Liao Hanxue exclaimed in awe as she looked around the realm. "This realm is quite advanced, but it still can’t compare to my domain!"
"Haha." Zhuxian Sheng laughed at that. "This realm is in the Three Mortal Realms, and your domain is in the Paradise Realm, so there’s no way you can compare them."
"You’re right." Liao Hanxue looked at Zhang Fei. "What realm is this? How did you manage to create that gate? Since you have the gate, you shouldn’t need a teleportation portal, right?"

"You’re not wrong about that, Senior. However, I don’t know everyone in the Three Mortal Realms, so I would rather not waste my time with them, and I only want to give them the opportunity to ascend to the Paradise Realm through the one-way teleportation portal." Liao Hanxue nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei, who immediately continued. "This planet is the Xianjin Realm, the most advanced planet here. In the past, I thought this planet was already extraordinary, but the Sky Pillar Domain changed my mind. Do you think you and your clan can create the teleportation portal by analyzing my ability?"
Liao Hanxue responded with a shake of her head. "I don’t dare say whether we will succeed or not, but we should at least try first."
"Let’s go back first because the time flow between the two realms is too big."

They were sitting together in Luo Hanxue’s private room again, and Zhang Fei directly spoke to her. "Senior, I can’t stay in this domain for too long, and the gate will disappear if I leave. Therefore, I hope you’re willing to bring some people from your clan to visit my sect, and you guys can analyze my gate there."

"I’ll contact them now, and we’ll talk to them tomorrow." After contacting her clan members, Liao Hanxue immediately spoke to Zhang Fei again. "Even though I’m not confident we’ll succeed in creating the teleportation portal, I forbid you from asking the Fei Clan for help in this matter, at least for now, and you can ask for their help if we fail."
Zhang Fei naturally understood the rivalry between the two clans. "I agree with that, Senior. I won’t say anything to the Fei Clan regarding this matter, and your clan members can try first."
"Haha." Liao Hanxue laughed with satisfaction when he heard that. "So, what’s your other purpose?"
"I’m looking for a reliable artifact crafter, and I think you are the right choice for that because you are also an expert in that field."
"Who exactly told you about me?"

"Fei Yinglin." Liao Hanxue raised an eyebrow for a moment after Zhang Fei mentioned the name, but then she recalled that the woman had indeed joined the Moonlite Passion Temple to become a dual cultivator, which ultimately led to her expulsion from the Fei Clan. "Actually, I have two artifact crafters in my sect, and they come from the Xianjin Realm. Their abilities in that field may not be as good as yours or your Liao Clan members, but I have full confidence in their abilities, so I want to find someone who can help them improve their abilities in that field. If you are willing to help them, I will give you the best reward that you won’t be able to find anywhere or in any amount."

Liao Hanxue was curious and tempted by that, but she found it difficult to believe Zhang Fei, especially since she still didn’t know anything about him. However, her eyes widened in shock as soon as Zhuxian Sheng told her several things about him, especially his status in several fields. "Are you fucking kidding me? How did you manage to master all those fields when you’re still in your mid-forties?"

"Senior, talent has nothing to do with age, right?" Liao Hanxue scowled at Zhang Fei. "Since I sincerely want to establish a positive partnership with you, and you’re also Senior Zhuxian’s close friend, I’ll tell you a few things about me."

Liao Hanxue suddenly stood up from her seat as soon as Zhang Fei opened the portal leading to the training space, but she fell dumbstruck as soon as three of his five clones walked out from within it. "How is this possible? How did you manage to create three clones that are completely identical to your original body? What kind of technique did you use to create them?"

"I didn’t use cultivation techniques to create them, and I still have two other clones, but they are busy with other things." Liao Hanxue stared at Zhang Fei in disbelief and shock, but she turned furious as soon as he transformed into his demon form.
However, Zhuxian Sheng immediately suppressed and calmed Liao Hanxue down. "You don’t have to act like this, Hanxue. Zhang Fei is different from other demons, and he is human at heart."
"What do you mean by that?" Liao Hanxue asked Zhuxian Sheng while continuing to glare at Zhang Fei.
"Show her, Zhang Fei."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei took out the memory extractor device and showed several events to Liao Hanxue, starting from his death to his awakening as a lust demon. "As you can see, I used to be an ordinary human, and I turned into a demon after my death. I have more than just my human and demon forms, though."
"What—" Liao Hanxue swallowed her words back as soon as Zhang Fei transformed into his complete fox form. "What kind of creature are you? How can you have human, demon, and beast forms?"

Zhang Fei returned to his human form. "Let’s just say I’m a special living being, and I became like this because of my savior, who brought me back to life. I don’t know her identity or origin, as she was already gone when I came back to life."
"Sigh." Liao Hanxue sat down on the sofa again while continuing to stare at Zhang Fei like she was looking at a freak, especially since there was no other living being like him.

Zhang Fei smiled at Liao Hanxue before displaying several other memories through the memory extractor device, causing her to fall into a daze again. "As you can see, the current Moonlit Passion Temple is a gathering place for all races, and they coexist together well now. There are not too many of them now, but their numbers will continue to increase in the future."
