"You don’t have to act like this, Hanxue.
Zhang Fei is different from other demons, and he is human at heart."
"What do you mean by that?" Liao Hanxue asked Zhuxian Sheng while continuing to glare at Zhang Fei.
"Show her, Zhang Fei."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei took out the memory extractor device and showed several events to Liao Hanxue, starting from his death to his awakening as a lust demon.
"As you can see, I used to be an ordinary human, and I turned into a demon after my death.
I have more than just my human and demon forms, though."
"What—" Liao Hanxue swallowed her words back as soon as Zhang Fei transformed into his complete fox form.
"What kind of creature are you?
How can you have human, demon, and beast forms?"
Zhang Fei returned to his human form.
"Let’s just say I’m a special living being, and I became like this because of my savior, who brought me back to life.
I don’t know her identity or origin, as she was already gone when I came back to life."
"Sigh." Liao Hanxue sat down on the sofa again while continuing to stare at Zhang Fei like she was looking at a freak, especially since there was no other living being like him.
Zhang Fei smiled at Liao Hanxue before displaying several other memories through the memory extractor device, causing her to fall into a daze again.
"As you can see, the current Moonlit Passion Temple is a gathering place for all races, and they coexist together well now.
There are not too many of them now, but their numbers will continue to increase in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 1318: The Fei Clan
paragraphs: "All races coexisting together in one place is truly an unusual sight." Liao Hanxue muttered to herself, watching Zhang Fei’s memories. "In the past, the Golden Dragon Emperor once tried to do the same, but his efforts ended in vain because each race had its own ambitions, with humans and demons having the greatest ambitions compared to the other races."

Zhuxian Sheng directly spoke to Liao Hanxue. "If we were to talk about this matter under normal circumstances, Zhang Fei would never be able to do that either, Hanxue. His main advantage is his three identities, allowing him to build relationships with all races. If you pay attention to the beast and winged races, their leaders are Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin."
"One of them is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and the other one is Tian Yizu’s daughter." Liao Hanxue easily recognized the two. "How do you know them and the people from those races?"

Zhang Fei explained several things to Liao Hanxue, especially regarding his relationship with the two women and the people from those races, leaving her stunned for some time. "Currently, the Celestial Dragon Race has officially joined me, but the Ice Phoenix Race will follow soon. As for the Void Dragon Race, I do know Long Xukong, but he hasn’t made a clear decision about whether to join me or not. At least, Long Wuzhao is already on my side, but he won’t force the other beast races to join me."

"You have only ascended to this realm for a few years, but you have already achieved many things that the senior cultivators, including my ancestors, could never achieve." Liao Hanxue then asked Zhang Fei again. "What’s your biggest goal in all of this?"

"Peace between all races." Liao Hanxue stared at Zhang Fei without saying anything. "My sect is the beginning, and the Twin Flames Domain is next. Once I become truly strong, this Paradise Realm will become a utopia for all races."
"Such a lofty ambition!" Liao Hanxue let out a low cry. "Are you sure you can do all that?"

"Whether I will succeed or not, let time tell the result." Zhang Fei shrugged in response. "After all, who doesn’t want to live in peace? Even though the scale is still small, I’ve succeeded in implementing it within my sect. For a larger scale, I won’t be able to do everything myself, and I need help from more people, so I want to connect with more people from all races to make it happen."
Liao Hanxue nodded in agreement. "The vast majority of living creatures definitely want peace, but unfortunately, many of them prefer chaos, such as those evil beasts and demons."

"You are right about those evil beasts, but you are mistaken about those demons." Liao Hanxue didn’t believe Zhang Fei about the latter, especially since they caused chaos in their realm too often. "Senior, you don’t know the situation in the demon races, so you think they are all evil. In reality, many of them desire peace, but they struggle to attain it due to the pressure from a stronger demon, and they have no choice but to follow his orders."
"Who is the demon you are referring to?"
"Mo Shentian, the Celestial Demon God." Liao Hanxue was not surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei. "Besides him, there are still four others: Shang Zhanluo, Jiu Mozu, Sha Mo, and Ku Shenzu."
"What about the remaining five?"

"Nalan Shizhe is my mother-in-law, and Ye Futian is my great-grandmaster in swordsmanship." Zhang Fei’s revelation shocked Liao Hanxue. "Apart from them, Ye Mingran, Wu Mian, and Qi Qingxiu have also decided to join me. As for Qin Yan, I have never met him, so I don’t know anything about his wishes yet."
"What about the human and natural races from this realm?"

Zhang Fei told Liao Hanxue about the people from both races who had decided to join him. "From this domain, I am confident that I can win the support of the Qiao and You Clans. Therefore, I hope you are willing to bring your Liao Clan to my side, and we will help each other grow."

Liao Hanxue was not surprised about the Qiao Clan, but she was skeptical about the You Clan, prompting Zhang Fei to tell her about his meeting with the latter and the visit of the two seniors from that clan to his sect. "Your ambition really interests me, as I always hope for peace. I will talk to my clan members tomorrow, but I can’t promise you whether they will agree to join you. Other people consider me the best talent in my clan, but my opinion doesn’t matter much to my seniors, and all decisions are in the hands of my ancestors."

"I know." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "At least, you should try to persuade them first, but I hope you won’t reveal everything I told you today to them, especially regarding my two other identities."

Liao Hanxue nodded slightly. "I’m not a fool, okay? I know what to tell them and what not to tell them, so you don’t have to worry about that. If they want proof, I’ll have them visit your sect to see for themselves."
"I think that’s the best choice." After they discussed a few other matters, Zhang Fei took Luo Yunxiao back to their room, but Zhuxian Sheng decided to stay behind.

Liao Hanxue climbed onto Zhuxian Sheng’s lap, hugged his neck, and kissed him. "I missed you so much, Sheng. You told me you would only be gone for a while, but you were gone for so long, and you didn’t tell me anything about Zhang Fei."

"I’m sorry, okay?" Zhuxian Sheng briefly kissed Liao Hanxue. "I missed you too, but you know my habits. I wanted to come back to see you earlier, but I had made a promise to Empress Huo to assist Zhang Fei, so I decided to stay there. She forbade me to tell anyone about him, so I couldn’t tell you anything. Moreover, Jian Kuang and Su Shentian were there, and they asked me to spar with them every day."
Liao Hanxue released a heavy sigh. "Did you meet many women there? Did they try to seduce you?"

"Hahaha!" Zhuxian Sheng laughed before pinning Liao Hanxue under him on the sofa. "I’m not a womanizer like Zhang Fei, you know? There are many attractive women in his sect, but none of them can catch my attention, and the only woman who can catch my attention is you."
"Humph!" Liao Hanxue snorted. "You are mine, and you will always be mine alone. If those women dare to seduce you, I will kill them myself, and I will feed their corpses to my contract beast."
"Hahaha!" Zhuxian Sheng laughed out loud. "You are such a jealous woman, but I really like you. You don’t need to worry, okay? I am yours, and you are mine."
A smile blossomed on Liao Hanxue’s face upon hearing that. "Do you think joining Zhang Fei is our best option?"

"Absolutely." Zhuxian Sheng nodded in response. "I’ve lived there for half a year, and I’ve seen too many things that most people don’t know about. No matter what happens, whether your Liao Clan agrees or not, you must join Zhang Fei at all costs."
"Since you say so, I will join Zhang Fei, regardless of my Liao Clan’s decision." Liao Hanxue embraced Zhuxian Sheng’s neck. "You’ve been gone for so long, so I want to have some fun with you now."
Without wasting any time, Zhuxian Sheng immediately pounced on Liao Hanxue, and her moans quickly echoed in the room.

In the morning, Zhang Fei led Luo Yunxiao and Fei Yinglin to leave their room. However, he couldn’t find Zhuxian Sheng and Liao Hanxue at the hotel, but Mei informed him that they were at the Liao Clan.
As soon as they left the inn, Fei Yinglin received a voice transmission from someone, which made her expression turn ugly.
"What happened?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

Fei Yinglin looked in the direction of the Fei Clan before informing them. "Shiyan accidentally ran into some people from my clan last night; they captured him and took him there. They know that the two of us always travel together, and one of them contacted me just now, forcing me to return or he would die."
"Why did they do that? Didn’t you and Shiyan meet in our sect?"
"Sigh." Fei Yinglin released a soft sigh. "I don’t understand why they suddenly acted like that, especially since they expelled me long ago."

"There’s nothing to think about, and we must go there right now." Zhang Fei immediately led them to the Fei Clan. "Since they dared to attack and capture my disciple and they also made such threats, then they are my enemies."
Fei Yinglin wanted to say something to Zhang Fei, but Luo Yunxiao hurriedly stopped her. "Leave everything to my husband, okay? They’ve gone too far, so we have to teach them a lesson."
After walking for some time, they arrived in front of the Fei Clan. However, the guards couldn’t recognize Fei Yinglin because Zhang Fei hadn’t restored her appearance to its original state.
"What is your need to come here, young master? What—Guah!" Zhang Fei immediately kicked the guards and sent them flying through the gate, shocking the passersby. "How dare—Gah!"
Zhang Fei moved before them and stomped at their chest directly. "Where is You Shiyan? Answer me now, or you will die."

chapters.title: Chapter 1319: Fighting The Fei Clan
paragraphs: "He... he’s imprisoned in the underground." The guards pointed in that direction.
Zhang Fei looked in that direction, but dozens of people quickly ran toward him, each carrying their own weapons. Luo Yunxiao grabbed Fei Yinglin’s shoulder and carried her to his side. "Husband."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "If you guys think your numbers scare me, then you should think again."
The guards did not respond to Zhang Fei and surrounded the three of them, pointing their weapons at them.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Several other people appeared at that place, led by a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman, with two young men behind them.
Fei Yinglin informed Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao. ’They are the current patriarch and his wife, Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan.’
’What is their relationship to you?’ Zhang Fei read their status after Mei displayed it to him.
’Fei Tianluo is my first uncle.’
’Who contacted you before?’
’That man, Elder Zhang.’ Fei Yinglin pointed to a young man behind Fei Tianluo. ’He is his first son, Fei Juechen. The other two men by his side were his brothers, Fei Renshu and Fei Ruogang.’
Fei Juechen furrowed his brows as Fei Yinglin pointed at him, but he couldn’t recognize her because her appearance wasn’t her original. "Father."

"Yeah." Fei Tianluo immediately released his aura to restrict their movement, but Luo Yunxiao swiftly dispelled it using the ability of her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, shocking all of them. "Who are you three? Why are you attacking our guards?"
"Why don’t you ask your cowardly son?" Zhang Fei responded by pointing at Fei Juechen. "He captured my disciple, and I came here to free him."
Fei Tianluo turned to Fei Juechen. "Who is he referring to?"
"I don’t know, Father." Fei Juechen did not know that Zhang Fei was a member of the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Who—"
"You Shiyan." Zhang Fei summoned the demon extermination sword directly, pointing it at them. "Return him to me, or I will destroy this clan."
All the guards surrounding them laughed out loud when they heard that, mocking Zhang Fei’s ignorance.
"Aren’t you being too arrogant, young man? Do you think you can fight all of us with your cultivation?" Mu Hanyan asked with disdain in her tone.

"Heh! You’re so old, yet you’re naive and ignorant, old woman." Zhang Fei’s words infuriated Mu Hanyan, and she wanted to attack him. However, she stopped as soon as he activated the soul link, which made his strength surpass theirs. "Do you really think I would come here if I was afraid of you all?"
After saying this, Zhang Fei immediately suppressed those guards with his aura, causing all of them to fall to the floor without being able to move their bodies in the slightest.
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their children were completely shocked by the sudden increase in Zhang Fei’s strength.
"Hand You Shiyan over to me right now, or I will kill them."

"Hahaha." Fei Tianluo laughed at Zhang Fei’s threat. "You are in our clan; do you really think you can act as you wish? I don’t know how you can increase your strength, but such a technique is only temporary, and I just need to wait for time for your strength to return to normal."
On the other hand, Mu Hanyan instructed the members of his clan to activate their barrier, and a golden barrier slowly appeared around the area of the Fei Clan.
"Hahaha!" Fei Juechen laughed at Zhang Fei. "You—"
*Bang*

A black spear pierced the floor between them, followed by the appearance of Zhuxian Sheng. He had rushed to the Fei Clan after hearing from the Liao Clan about the commotion there, but he had come alone without Liao Hanxue. "I thought you came here to look for some things, but you actually caused a commotion here, Zhang Fei."
Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan’s expressions changed slightly as soon as they heard the name. ’Is he a member of the Zhang Clan from the Starfall Martial Domain?’

"Senior Zhuxian, you’ve been living with us for a few months, so you should know my character, right?" Zhang Fei looked at the people from the Fei Clan again. "Last night, they ganged up on You Shiyan and captured him, which is why I came here to bring him back."
Zhuxian Sheng was momentarily taken aback. "As I recall, the You and Fei Clans had some enmity in the past, and they probably captured him because of that."

"I couldn’t care less about the enmity between their two clans, Senior Zhuxian. You Shiyan is one of my disciples, and they are my family. Since they dare to gang up and capture him, this clan is my enemy." Zhang Fei then spoke to the members of the Fei Clan again. "Hand him over to me now, or you will suffer the consequences."

"Hahaha!" Fei Tianluo still underestimated Zhang Fei. "Show me how far your balls go, brat! My Fei Clan has been around for tens of thousands of years, and no one has ever dared to threaten us in the past. If you kill our guards, then—"
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and activated his sword domain before using it to attack all those guards. With his current strength, it wasn’t difficult for him to kill them.
*Splurt... Splurt... Splurt...*
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their children were shocked by Zhang Fei’s act of killing all their guards in just one strike. "You—"
"Hand over my disciple to me this instant!" Zhang Fei immediately unleashed his killing intent and bloodlust to the maximum, suffocating all the Fei Clan members.
Meanwhile, Zhuxian Sheng, Luo Yunxiao, and Fei Yinglin were completely unaffected by Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust, as he only directed them at the Fei Clan members.
Fei Yinglin did not want Zhang Fei to become an enemy of her clan, but she was aware that she would not be able to stop him, and Luo Yunxiao also asked her not to do anything.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

An old man and an old woman instantly appeared in front of Fei Tianluo and the others, covering them with their auras. Although both of them appeared calm, they actually felt fear deep in their hearts, which stemmed from Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust.
’They are my grandparents, Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang.’ Fei Yinglin informed Zhang Fei and the others.
Fei Lianhe looked at Zhang Fei and the others before ordering one of them. "Juechen! Release You Shiyan and bring him here!"
"But, grandfather, he—"
"Bring him here now!" Fei Juechen didn’t argue with Fei Lianhe anymore and hurriedly went into the dungeon. "Who are you really, young man?"

"Zhang Fei, the leader of the Moonlit Passion Temple." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Fei Lianhe and the others, as they only knew that Qing Qiu’er was the leader of the sect, and they had never heard of his name before. "It’s up to you to believe it or not, and it’s none of my business."
"Are you—"

"I am not a member of the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain." Zhang Fei immediately denied Li Meixiang’s guess. "Even though I’m not a member of a big clan like you guys, I won’t be afraid of anyone, especially those who dare harm my family."

Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang exchanged glances for a moment, but Zhuxian Sheng immediately warned the old man. "Old Fei, you should inform your clan members not to touch members of the Moonlit Passion Sect ever again; otherwise, your Fei Clan will disappear from this realm."
"What do you mean by that, Zhuxian Sheng?"

Zhuxian Sheng patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "You don’t know anything about this kid, and he has enough strength to destroy your clan. Even if he can’t do it himself, the people behind him are more than enough to help him."
"Hmm?" Both Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang frowned at Zhuxian Sheng. "Does that mean you’ll also help him fight us?"
Zhuxian Sheng shook his head in response. "I don’t need to help him, he—"

"There’s no point in talking to them, Senior Zhuxian." Zhang Fei then looked away, and he was furious when he saw You Shiyan’s condition. He immediately vanished from their sight and reappeared in front of Fei Juechen, strangling him by the neck. "Were you the one who beat him like this?"
’Shit! How could he move this fast?’ Fei Juechen punched Zhang Fei’s arm several times. "Father! Mother! Help me!"
"Juechen!"
"Brother!"
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their other two children shouted frantically. All of them immediately moved towards Zhang Fei, but two women suddenly appeared and knocked them back.
It wasn’t just the four of them who were shocked by the appearance of the two women, but Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were also shocked by their sudden appearance.
Zhang Fei spoke straight away. "Qilin! Lian! Kill them if they dare move!"

"Yes, Master." Both Yao Qilin and Fei Lian immediately released their strength and aura, suppressing all members of the Fei Clan, including Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang. "You guys have heard our master’s words, right? You move; you die."

Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang looked at the two women in shock, recognizing their identities. ’How did that young man manage to subdue these two female evil beasts? Their cultivation is on par with ours, but their strength is still above us.’
Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes at Fei Juechen. "Since you dared to beat my disciple like this, you must bear the consequences."

Fei Juechen furrowed his brows as Fei Yinglin pointed at him, but he couldn’t recognize her because her appearance wasn’t her original.
"Father."
"Yeah." Fei Tianluo immediately released his aura to restrict their movement, but Luo Yunxiao swiftly dispelled it using the ability of her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, shocking all of them.
"Who are you three?
Why are you attacking our guards?"
"Why don’t you ask your cowardly son?" Zhang Fei responded by pointing at Fei Juechen.
"He captured my disciple, and I came here to free him."
Fei Tianluo turned to Fei Juechen.
"Who is he referring to?"
"I don’t know, Father." Fei Juechen did not know that Zhang Fei was a member of the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Who—"
"You Shiyan." Zhang Fei summoned the demon extermination sword directly, pointing it at them.
"Return him to me, or I will destroy this clan."
All the guards surrounding them laughed out loud when they heard that, mocking Zhang Fei’s ignorance.
"Aren’t you being too arrogant, young man?
Do you think you can fight all of us with your cultivation?" Mu Hanyan asked with disdain in her tone.
"Heh!
You’re so old, yet you’re naive and ignorant, old woman." Zhang Fei’s words infuriated Mu Hanyan, and she wanted to attack him.
However, she stopped as soon as he activated the soul link, which made his strength surpass theirs.
"Do you really think I would come here if I was afraid of you all?"
After saying this, Zhang Fei immediately suppressed those guards with his aura, causing all of them to fall to the floor without being able to move their bodies in the slightest.
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their children were completely shocked by the sudden increase in Zhang Fei’s strength.
"Hand You Shiyan over to me right now, or I will kill them."
"Hahaha." Fei Tianluo laughed at Zhang Fei’s threat.
"You are in our clan; do you really think you can act as you wish?
I don’t know how you can increase your strength, but such a technique is only temporary, and I just need to wait for time for your strength to return to normal."
On the other hand, Mu Hanyan instructed the members of his clan to activate their barrier, and a golden barrier slowly appeared around the area of the Fei Clan.
"Hahaha!" Fei Juechen laughed at Zhang Fei.
"You—"
*Bang*
A black spear pierced the floor between them, followed by the appearance of Zhuxian Sheng.
He had rushed to the Fei Clan after hearing from the Liao Clan about the commotion there, but he had come alone without Liao Hanxue.
"I thought you came here to look for some things, but you actually caused a commotion here, Zhang Fei."
Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan’s expressions changed slightly as soon as they heard the name. ’Is he a member of the Zhang Clan from the Starfall Martial Domain?’
"Senior Zhuxian, you’ve been living with us for a few months, so you should know my character, right?" Zhang Fei looked at the people from the Fei Clan again.
"Last night, they ganged up on You Shiyan and captured him, which is why I came here to bring him back."
Zhuxian Sheng was momentarily taken aback.
"As I recall, the You and Fei Clans had some enmity in the past, and they probably captured him because of that."
"I couldn’t care less about the enmity between their two clans, Senior Zhuxian.
You Shiyan is one of my disciples, and they are my family.
Since they dare to gang up and capture him, this clan is my enemy." Zhang Fei then spoke to the members of the Fei Clan again.
"Hand him over to me now, or you will suffer the consequences."
"Hahaha!" Fei Tianluo still underestimated Zhang Fei.
"Show me how far your balls go, brat!
My Fei Clan has been around for tens of thousands of years, and no one has ever dared to threaten us in the past.
If you kill our guards, then—"
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and activated his sword domain before using it to attack all those guards.
With his current strength, it wasn’t difficult for him to kill them.
*Splurt...
Splurt...
Splurt...*
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their children were shocked by Zhang Fei’s act of killing all their guards in just one strike.
"You—"
"Hand over my disciple to me this instant!" Zhang Fei immediately unleashed his killing intent and bloodlust to the maximum, suffocating all the Fei Clan members.
Meanwhile, Zhuxian Sheng, Luo Yunxiao, and Fei Yinglin were completely unaffected by Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust, as he only directed them at the Fei Clan members.
Fei Yinglin did not want Zhang Fei to become an enemy of her clan, but she was aware that she would not be able to stop him, and Luo Yunxiao also asked her not to do anything.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
An old man and an old woman instantly appeared in front of Fei Tianluo and the others, covering them with their auras.
Although both of them appeared calm, they actually felt fear deep in their hearts, which stemmed from Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust.
’They are my grandparents, Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang.’ Fei Yinglin informed Zhang Fei and the others.
Fei Lianhe looked at Zhang Fei and the others before ordering one of them.
"Juechen!
Release You Shiyan and bring him here!"
"But, grandfather, he—"
"Bring him here now!" Fei Juechen didn’t argue with Fei Lianhe anymore and hurriedly went into the dungeon.
"Who are you really, young man?"

"Zhang Fei, the leader of the Moonlit Passion Temple." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Fei Lianhe and the others, as they only knew that Qing Qiu’er was the leader of the sect, and they had never heard of his name before.
"It’s up to you to believe it or not, and it’s none of my business."
"Are you—"
"I am not a member of the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain." Zhang Fei immediately denied Li Meixiang’s guess.
"Even though I’m not a member of a big clan like you guys, I won’t be afraid of anyone, especially those who dare harm my family."
Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang exchanged glances for a moment, but Zhuxian Sheng immediately warned the old man.
"Old Fei, you should inform your clan members not to touch members of the Moonlit Passion Sect ever again; otherwise, your Fei Clan will disappear from this realm."
"What do you mean by that, Zhuxian Sheng?"
Zhuxian Sheng patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder.
"You don’t know anything about this kid, and he has enough strength to destroy your clan.
Even if he can’t do it himself, the people behind him are more than enough to help him."
"Hmm?" Both Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang frowned at Zhuxian Sheng.
"Does that mean you’ll also help him fight us?"
Zhuxian Sheng shook his head in response.
"I don’t need to help him, he—"
"There’s no point in talking to them, Senior Zhuxian." Zhang Fei then looked away, and he was furious when he saw You Shiyan’s condition.
He immediately vanished from their sight and reappeared in front of Fei Juechen, strangling him by the neck.
"Were you the one who beat him like this?"
’Shit!
How could he move this fast?’ Fei Juechen punched Zhang Fei’s arm several times.
"Father!
Mother!
Help me!"
"Juechen!"
"Brother!"
Fei Tianluo, Mu Hanyan, and their other two children shouted frantically.
All of them immediately moved towards Zhang Fei, but two women suddenly appeared and knocked them back.
It wasn’t just the four of them who were shocked by the appearance of the two women, but Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were also shocked by their sudden appearance.
Zhang Fei spoke straight away.
"Qilin!
Lian!
Kill them if they dare move!"
"Yes, Master." Both Yao Qilin and Fei Lian immediately released their strength and aura, suppressing all members of the Fei Clan, including Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang.
"You guys have heard our master’s words, right?
You move; you die."
Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang looked at the two women in shock, recognizing their identities. ’How did that young man manage to subdue these two female evil beasts?
Their cultivation is on par with ours, but their strength is still above us.’
Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes at Fei Juechen.
"Since you dared to beat my disciple like this, you must bear the consequences."

chapters.title: Chapter 1320: Punish Fei Juechen
paragraphs: Fei Juechen grabbed his hand, trying to release Zhang Fei’s grip on his neck. "If you kill me, my Fei Clan will hunt you down and destroy your sect!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "So, the first young master of this sect is just this kind of coward, huh? You only dare to gang up on others and hide under your seniors’ armpits."
"You—"
"Look at them." Zhang Fei pointed behind him. "Even your grandparents and parents don’t dare make a move in front of my two wives."

Fei Lianhe, Li Meixiang, and the others frowned at Zhang Fei’s mockery. However, they froze in their spots as soon as he summoned the War Devil Beast, Chi You, and the Evil Black Dragon, Xie Heilong, out of his beast space.
’What the hell is with this young man? These two male evil beasts are even stronger than the two female evil beasts.’ Fei Lianhe, Li Meixiang, and the others looked at the four beasts with fear.
’Fuck!’ Fei Juechen was even more frightened by the appearance of the two evil beasts.
"What should I do with these humans, Master?" Chi You asked Zhang Fei, glancing at those people.
Xie Heilong also looked at them. "Do you want us to kill them, Master?"
"Kill them if they move." Hearing Zhang Fei’s order, Chi You and Xie Heilong grinned evilly as they looked at those people.

Zhang Fei looked at Luo Yunxiao, who immediately brought Fei Yinglin to his side. He handed You Shiyan to his partner before sending both of them to his soul world. "What are you going to do to this man, husband? I think you shouldn’t kill him."
"Death is too easy for him." Zhang Fei grabbed Fei Juechen’s head and forcefully pulled his soul out of his body.

Seeing that, Fei Lianhe, Li Meixiang, and the others wanted to move to save Fei Juechen from Zhang Fei, but Yao Qilin immediately warned them, "If you don’t want to die and your clan wiped out, you guys should think twice before making a move. Our master never jokes with his words, and we will wipe you all out the moment you move."

Zhang Fei activated his soul domain, split Fei Juechen into two, and destroyed one of them. Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan’s faces turned pale after seeing that, as souls were an essential part of living beings, and their first son would no longer be the same with only half of his soul remaining.
Zhang Fei returned half of Fei Juechen’s soul into his body, but he didn’t stop there, and he used his lust manipulation to turn him into a lustful human.
Zhang Fei released Fei Juechen’s neck from his grip, causing him to fall to the floor. He looked like an idiot because his soul was only half, but his expression was extremely lustful.

Zhang Fei looked at those people. "This is my first and final warning! If any of you dare touch my family again, I will send them to wipe out this clan. Do you still want to stay in this domain, Senior Zhuxian?"
"Yes." Zhuxian Sheng nodded in response. "I still have some business in this domain, so I’ll stay here for a few days. If Jian Kuang and Su Shentian look for me, tell them to wait for my return."
"Alright." Zhang Fei hugged Luo Yunxiao’s waist and took her away from the Fei Clan, followed by the four evil beasts.

"Juechen!" Mu Hanyan screamed and ran towards her eldest son, but Fei Juechen immediately pounced on her like a horny beast. Fortunately, her cultivation was much higher than her son’s, and she could easily restrict his movements. "Husband! What happened to our son? Why is he acting like this?"
Fei Tianluo was also confused about Fei Juechen’s condition. "Do you know what Zhang Fei did to our eldest son, Zhuxian Sheng?"

"I don’t know." Zhuxian Sheng replied with a headshake. "I do know Zhang Fei, but he’s always secretive with everyone, so I don’t know the depth of his abilities. I think you guys should knock him unconscious first and lock him up somewhere else, or he’ll keep acting like that."
Fei Tianluo simply nodded to Zhuxian Sheng, and he moved to face Fei Juechen before knocking him out cold. He then took his first son away, followed by Mu Hanyan and their two children.

Zhuxian Sheng then spoke to Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang, who were still perplexed by the whole situation just now. "Old Fei, you have no other choice but to forget today’s events and never try to take revenge against Zhang Fei, or all of you will perish from it."
"Tell us the truth about him, Zhuxian Sheng." Li Meixiang said.

Zhuxian Sheng shook his head slightly. "I can’t elaborate much on Zhang Fei for some reason, but since you two have already witnessed his actions just now, you should understand that becoming his enemy is unwise. That kid is actually a chill person, but he will turn vicious if anyone touches those closest to him, and your eldest grandson made a fatal mistake with his actions against You Shiyan."
"How did he subdue those four evil beasts?"

"Four? He actually subdued nine of them, and he still has two other beasts that are no less powerful than them." Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang looked at Zhuxian Sheng in shock. "If you think those beasts are his only strength, then you two are wrong about him. He has many allies who are much stronger than those beasts, and you guys will probably die of fear if you hear one of them."
"Who?"
"Empress Huo Yanling."
"What?" Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang screamed in shock. "How—"

Zhuxian Sheng waved his hand to stop them. "The reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling was born in the Three Mortal Realms, and the two of them have known each other since Zhang Fei just started his path of cultivation. In fact, they are no different from lovers, especially since her parents have already approved their relationship. You may have never heard of this matter because of your hatred of dual cultivators, but she has already declared that the Moonlit Passion Sect is under her protection."
"Are you—"

"If you two are wise, you should forget about this matter. Even without the assistance of Empress Huo Yanling, Zhang Fei can destroy your clan, let alone if she helps him." Zhuxian Sheng pulled his black spear out, put it away, and left the Fei Clan directly.
Li Meixiang looked at her husband. "Do you think Zhuxian Sheng is telling us the truth about Zhang Fei’s relationship with Empress Huo Yanling?"

"Whether it is true or not, the fact is that Zhang Fei does have the power to destroy our clan." Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang suddenly felt a powerful aura from the sky, and immediately they looked up, where they found Feng Yao standing there with a faint smile. Both of them trembled strongly as they stared at her. "Empress... Empress Huo."
Feng Yao said nothing and immediately disappeared from their sight, but her brief presence was more than enough to instill fear in Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang.
Li Meixiang grabbed her husband’s hand. "Husband, it’s true, they do have a relationship with each other; otherwise, she wouldn’t have appeared here."
"Yes." Fei Lianhe immediately pulled his wife away. "Let’s meet the others."
Soon, they arrived at the room where Fei Tianluo chained Fei Juechen, who was still unconscious. "Father, we—"

"No need." Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan looked at Fei Lianhe in confusion. "Naturally, I want to take revenge on Zhang Fei after everything he did to our clan, but he is far beyond our reach. If we prolong this matter, our clan will surely be wiped out, so we have no choice but to swallow this humiliation."
"What do you mean by that, Father?" Mu Hanyan asked, disappointed with Fei Lianhe’s decision.

Li Meixiang released a soft sigh. "You guys have witnessed Zhang Fei’s strength just now, and those evil beasts are too strong for us. Additionally, Empress Huo is behind him, and she has just appeared in our clan."
"What... Are you—"

"Tianluo, your mother is telling the truth; Empress Huo really appeared in our clan just now." Feng Lianhe sighed heavily. "She didn’t say anything and left immediately, but her presence was enough to prove her relationship with Zhang Fei. I don’t like this situation either, but we have to think about the future of our clan, and I won’t let our clan be destroyed because of your son’s mistake."

Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan’s expressions were extremely awful after Fei Lianhe said all that, but they weren’t fools, and they were fully aware of Feng Yao’s character and strength. She hadn’t said anything to their parents or done anything to their clan, but her appearance made it clear that she wanted to deter them from attacking Zhang Fei or the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Fei Lianhe looked at his eldest grandson before turning to leave. "Forget all these problems, and call some doctors to check Juechen’s condition."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao had arrived at another city in the Sky Pillar Domain, but the four beasts were no longer with them. "What do you think the Fei Clan will do next, husband?"
"I don’t know," Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "If they’re smart, they shouldn’t trouble us again. If they can’t swallow their defeat, I’ll wipe them out for real."

chapters.title: Chapter 1321: Return To The Sect
paragraphs: A heated debate broke out within the Liao Clan, especially after Liao Hanxue expressed her desire to join the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Some members of the Liao Clan supported Liao Hanxue’s decision, especially after hearing about the commotion within the Fei Clan. However, many others opposed her decision, mainly because the Moonlit Passion Temple was a dual cultivation sect.
"Sheng."

Zhuxian Sheng took out a device similar to Zhang Fei’s memory extractor, and he displayed a few things about the Moonlit Passion Temple. "I understand your dislike and worry, but that sect has changed, and they are no longer just a dual cultivation sect. You guys can see my memories yourselves, and they can help you understand the situation in that sect a little."

All the members of the Liao Clan seriously watched Zhuxian Sheng’s memories, but the presence of many members of all races in the Moonlit Passion Sect shocked them again and again. They had never seen all races gathered in one place peacefully, and they could also see that those people mingled with each other without any significant problems.

Zhuxian Sheng pointed to the three women who appeared in his memories. "Tianshi Shengjie is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and Tian Huangjin is Tian Yizu’s daughter. Meanwhile, Nalan Wangzi is the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, and she is one of Zhang Fei’s wives now, so her demon race will always be on his side."
"What about those two demons?" An old man pointed to two other demons that appeared there. "They should be members of the Eternal Night Demon Race, right?"

Zhuxian Sheng nodded at the old man. "Old Liao Shengye, they are indeed members of the Eternal Night Demon Race; Ye Mingran sent them to the Moonlit Passion Temple as representatives of their race. In fact, Zhang Fei also had a favorable relationship with her demon race, as Ye Futian was his great-grandmaster in swordsmanship."
"How could the two of them have such a relationship if you both previously said that Zhang Fei hadn’t ascended to this realm for long?" This time, an old woman asked Zhuxian Sheng.

"Old Bai Yueqin, even though Zhang Fei hasn’t ascended to this realm for too long, that doesn’t mean he couldn’t have had a relationship with Ye Futian beforehand, right?" All of them looked at Zhuxian Sheng in confusion, prompting him to explain to them about the relationship between the two. "That was the beginning of the relationship between them, which made this universe feel truly vast but small at the same time. Therefore, I dare say to you that joining the Moonlit Passion Temple is your best choice because the sect will continue to develop in the future, and that kid has many much bigger plans, all of which I believe will bring peace to this realm. In fact, Jian Kuang and Su Shentian believe in him as well, and they currently live there too."
Liao Hanxue then spoke to them. "Instead of you guys continuing to doubt our stories, I think you all should try visiting the sect, and you guys can see everything for yourselves."
"What about the Fei Clan?"

"Why do you bother thinking about that clan, Old Liao?" Zhuxian Sheng returned the question. "Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were strong, but they wouldn’t dare do anything after Zhang Fei showed a little of his strength earlier. That kid usually behaves in a chill and easygoing manner, but he will turn vicious if people hurt the people closest to him. Fei Juechen acted foolishly by harming You Shiyan, and as a result, he has faced the consequences."
"What did Zhang Fei do to Fei Juechen?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1322: Welcome The Guests
paragraphs: "I didn’t expect that kid to move so quickly, and he managed to convince you to join him, Hanxue."
"Haha." Liao Hanxue replied to Qiao Yisheng with a soft laugh. "Zhang Fei’s ideas are interesting, but I decided to join him not just because of him."
"Your lover, right?" Tang Qingyan glanced at Zhuxian Sheng.
"Yes." Liao Hanxue looked in another direction, where two people flew toward them. "It seems like Zhang Fei managed to convince them too."
"You Ran and Tan Yuxin came to this sect yesterday and spoke with Jian Kuang and Su Shentian." Zhuxian Sheng said.
Soon, You Ran and Tan Yuxin arrived in front of them. "Will your Liao Clan join this sect, Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin?"

"We haven’t decided on that yet." Liao Shengye looked towards the sect. "Hanxue has already explained some things to us, but we want to see the situation inside first before making a decision. If the situation inside is indeed as she explained before, we might consider joining this sect."
"Have you two decided to join this sect?" Bai Yueqin asked them.

Tan Yuxin nodded slightly in response. "We’ve looked around this sect yesterday, and we’ve also been to all the halls. After thinking it over all night, we’ve decided to accept Zhang Fei’s offer. However, we won’t be directly involved in this sect, and we only want to cooperate with them."
"If—"

"Senior, you’ve arrived at my sect; why don’t you see everything for yourself?" They looked at Zhang Fei, who had just appeared along with Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, Nalan Wangzi, and Jia Yuyan. "Once you see everything, I’m sure you won’t have any more doubts about our sect."
Liao Shengye, Bai Yueqin, You Ran, and Tan Yuxin looked at the four women in surprise.

Zhang Fei smiled as he hugged the two of them. "Nalan Wangzi and Jia Yuyan are my wives, and Tianshi Shengjie is my future wife. Tian Huangjin is my old friend, and I knew her when she descended to the Three Mortal Realms to hunt a demon."
’Shameless! I haven’t even agreed to be his lover, but he introduced me to them as his future wife.’ Tianshi Shengjie inwardly grumbled.

"Hahaha!" Qiao Yisheng laughed as he cupped his hands at Zhang Fei. "I have to admit your skills when it comes to women, kid. You previously brought five beauties to my clan, but you still have several others by your side. Not to mention, Tianshi Shengjie is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and she is famous for being tough, but you managed to win her heart. Why don’t you take Tian Huangjin as your woman too? This way, you will have wives from all races, which no man will ever be able to do."
Tian Huangjin shook her head in response to that. "I was born specifically to eradicate evil, and I have no interest in romantic matters."
Tian Huang’s answer didn’t surprise them, as they knew that the Winged Race members were always like that.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "In fact, I have three wives from the Winged Race, Senior Qiao."
"Oh?" Qiao Yisheng and the others were taken aback upon hearing that. "Where are they?"
"They live together in that area." Zhang Fei pointed to the back of the mountain. "Let’s go in first, and I’ll take you all around my sect; you guys can see all the changes for yourselves."
"Zhang Fei, my husband and I already saw everything yesterday, so we won’t be joining you. We’ll be going to the blacksmith hall directly," Tan Yuxin said.
You Ran also spoke to Zhang Fei. "We’ve decided to cooperate with your sect, and I’d like to discuss the details with you later."
"Zhang Fei, my Liao Clan specializes in formation arrays and artifact crafting, so we would like to visit those two locations first." Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin agreed with Liao Hanxue.

"For now, artifact forging is included in the blacksmith hall, so we will go there first." Zhang Fei then asked Qiao Yisheng and Tang Qingyan. "Do you two want to go to the medical hall first? Elmyra and the others are our doctors, so they handle that hall."
Qiao Yisheng shook his head. "Even though my Qiao Clan’s primary focus is medical, I’m curious about the others, so we’ll join you to look at the other halls first."
When they arrived at the Sword Hall, they saw Jian Kuang and Han Ling training the disciples who had chosen the sword path as their cultivation path. "Hey, Sheng! Help us to train them!"
"I’ll join them, Hanxue." Zhuxian Sheng immediately ran towards them.

Although they had heard of Jian Kuang, they were still confused by his decision to join the Moonlit Passion Sect. After all, there were many better sword sects in the Paradise Realm, and they had once asked him to join them. He refused because he wanted to live unfettered, yet he decided to join the sect.
"Who’s the other man?"

Zhang Fei immediately explained to them. "His name is Han Ling, my master in swordsmanship. Additionally, he is Ye Futian’s grand disciple, so I am his great-grand disciple. My relationship with the Eternal Night Demon Race is excellent because of the connection between us, and there are two demons of that race in the sect now."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei took them to the Soul Hall, where Hun Di and his disciples trained the disciples of the Moonlit Passion Sect.

"Hun Di is my master in the Soul Cultivation Path, so they are my sisters and brothers." Zhang Fei then pointed to Shang Yingyue and Wu Xueming. "They are also my parents-in-law since their daughter is one of my wives."
"How high is your soul level?" Liao Shengye curiously asked.
Zhang Fei smiled at that. "Senior, my soul level is at the half-perfection stage of the Divine Soul level."

Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin’s jaws instantly dropped. "How is it possible for your soul level to have reached that stage at your current age? We are both much older than you, but our soul level still hasn’t reached that stage."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Senior, soul cultivation is no different from normal cultivation. Since there is a dual cultivation path, there naturally exists a dual soul cultivation path. I have many women by my side, and we always practice both at the same time. Additionally, I constantly search for various items related to soul cultivation for me and all my wives, which significantly increases our soul power."
"Soul items?"

Zhang Fei nodded at them. "The last time, I found many Phantom Soul Lotuses, and I allowed most of my wives to absorb them. The increase in their soul power naturally affected mine, similar to how dual cultivation affected my normal cultivation."
"I see." Liao Shengye then asked him again. "However, soul items are more difficult to find than normal cultivation items, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei gave him a light nod. "Mostly, the soul items exist in the demon domains, but not all humans can go to one, especially since the demon aura there will affect them and turn them into demons."
"Then?"

Zhang Fei showed them his light element, which was strengthened by the light elemental law. "As long as I use my light element, the demon aura there will never affect me, so I can freely search for soul items. The easiest way to increase our soul level is to absorb wandering evil souls, but we have to purify their souls first before we can absorb them; otherwise, their evil nature will affect us."
"Does that mean you frequently absorb wandering evil souls?"

"When I went to the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain last time, I absorbed tens of thousands of wandering evil souls there, and I spent a lot of time purifying them." Zhang Fei then led them to another hall while chatting.
Soon, they arrived at the body hall, where they saw Hong Quan, Hong Chong, Hong Xinxin, and several others training their disciples in the body cultivation path.
"Did you bring them from the Three Mortal Realms, kid?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at Qiao Yisheng. "Hong Xinxin is my master in name in the body cultivation path, but she is one of my wives now, and those two men are her father and grandfather."
"What is your body cultivation level?"

"The Diamond Body Stage." Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "Believe it or not, the body cultivation path is much more difficult than the other cultivation path. The sword path is difficult, but it is not as difficult as the body cultivation path."

"You’re right." Tang Qingyan nodded in agreement. "The sword path is indeed difficult, but it’s not difficult for those who have talent for the sword. On the contrary, we can’t rely on talent or anything else in the body cultivation path, and we must continuously temper our bodies with various methods to reach high in our body cultivation level. So, how did you forge your body so that you can reach this level?"

"There." Tang Qingyan and the others were confused because Zhang Fei pointed at the sky. "Lightning tribulations are the best way to forge our bodies, but not everyone can withstand them, and many of them die because of their lightning tribulations."
"Does that mean you faced lightning tribulations during your previous breakthroughs, kid?" Qiao Yisheng asked.
Zhang Fei simply nodded. "The Heavens have been trying to kill me since my cultivation broke through to the Earth Realm, but I’m still alive today."

"Mostly, the soul items exist in the demon domains, but not all humans can go to one, especially since the demon aura there will affect them and turn them into demons."
"Then?"
Zhang Fei showed them his light element, which was strengthened by the light elemental law.
"As long as I use my light element, the demon aura there will never affect me, so I can freely search for soul items.
The easiest way to increase our soul level is to absorb wandering evil souls, but we have to purify their souls first before we can absorb them; otherwise, their evil nature will affect us."
"Does that mean you frequently absorb wandering evil souls?"

"When I went to the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain last time, I absorbed tens of thousands of wandering evil souls there, and I spent a lot of time purifying them." Zhang Fei then led them to another hall while chatting.
Soon, they arrived at the body hall, where they saw Hong Quan, Hong Chong, Hong Xinxin, and several others training their disciples in the body cultivation path.
"Did you bring them from the Three Mortal Realms, kid?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at Qiao Yisheng.
"Hong Xinxin is my master in name in the body cultivation path, but she is one of my wives now, and those two men are her father and grandfather."
"What is your body cultivation level?"
"The Diamond Body Stage." Zhang Fei released a soft sigh.
"Believe it or not, the body cultivation path is much more difficult than the other cultivation path.
The sword path is difficult, but it is not as difficult as the body cultivation path."
"You’re right." Tang Qingyan nodded in agreement.
"The sword path is indeed difficult, but it’s not difficult for those who have talent for the sword.
On the contrary, we can’t rely on talent or anything else in the body cultivation path, and we must continuously temper our bodies with various methods to reach high in our body cultivation level.
So, how did you forge your body so that you can reach this level?"
"There." Tang Qingyan and the others were confused because Zhang Fei pointed at the sky.
"Lightning tribulations are the best way to forge our bodies, but not everyone can withstand them, and many of them die because of their lightning tribulations."
"Does that mean you faced lightning tribulations during your previous breakthroughs, kid?" Qiao Yisheng asked.
Zhang Fei simply nodded.
"The Heavens have been trying to kill me since my cultivation broke through to the Earth Realm, but I’m still alive today."

chapters.title: Chapter 1323: Introduce The Guests
paragraphs: Their next stop was the Speed Hall, but there wasn’t much to discover there, except for the presence of Yan Leibao and his Yan Clan.

After explaining a few things to them, Zhang Fei led his guests to the alchemy hall. However, the presence of another Zhang Fei there puzzled them. "He is one of my clones, and the woman who competed with him is Huo Lanyin, one of Empress Huo’s subordinates."
"So, it’s true that you have a relationship with Empress Huo, huh?"

Zhang Fei smiled at them. "Empress Huo’s current name is Feng Yao, and we have known each other since the lower realms. Actually, her parents already consider me their son-in-law, even though she herself is still not willing to accept me as her husband."
’This crazy kid! How could he have such a relationship with Empress Huo? No wonder he dared to fight the Zhi and Fei Clans before.’

"Lin Jingxia comes from the upper realms, and she’s a god-rank alchemist. Tian Shuixiang is also a god-rank alchemist. He looks like an ordinary human, but his true identity is an asura demon. He’s Shang Zhui’s son, and he is also Ye Futian’s son-in-law." Zhang Fei’s revelation of Tian Shuixiang’s true identity shocked them, but they could see that he was attentive in teaching those young alchemists. "Feng Shanxi is a female phoenix, and she is also a god-rank alchemist like them. Nanfeng Yunxi has not yet reached god-rank, but her abilities in alchemy are almost on par with her seniors. The other three are my servants, and they used to be the leaders of the alchemy union."
"Does that mean the three of them were once your enemies?"
"I would never do such things to innocents, but I would not hesitate to use any means to destroy my enemies." Zhang Fei then led them away.
Liao Hanxue and her grandparents were overjoyed when they arrived at the Blacksmith Hall, where they saw several blacksmiths seriously forging equipment.

"Gang Zhishou was the first person to introduce me to blacksmithing." Zhang Fei then pointed to the other four. "The old man is Duan Zhao, and the other three are his disciples: Ah Hu, Lu Zhong, and Xian Xian."
"Who are the young man and the old man?"
"Tie Xuan was the second person to guide me in blacksmithing, and the old man beside him was Ji Changlan." Zhang Fei brought them into one of the rooms in the Blacksmith Hall.

"Old Gong and Old Cheng, I have brought some guests with me." Both old men turned to Zhang Fei directly. "This young woman is Liao Hanxue, and the two people beside her are her grandparents, Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin. Their Liao Clan is one of the best artifact crafters in this realm, and I invite them to join our sect."
Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji cupped their hands. "Nice to know you, three seniors."
"Yes." Liao Shengye looked at the unfinished device on the table. "What kind of project are you two working on?"

"A teleportation device, seniors." Liao Shengye looked at them in confusion, prompting Gong Ren to explain. "This device is the teleportation device we normally use in the Three Mortal Realms, but Zhang Fei wanted to build a teleportation device that could connect this realm with the Three Mortal Realms, so we started re-examining it."
Bai Yueqin looked at Zhang Fei directly. "Are you really serious about building such a teleportation device? Have you considered the risks?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then explained it. "Senior, I’ve thought about the risks, so I want to build a one-way teleportation device. This way, people from the Three Mortal Realms can ascend here without having to wait for their cultivation to break through to the Five Celestial Realms first, especially since there is no Celestial Qi there. On the other hand, people from the Paradise Realm won’t be able to descend there, and they have to pass through those tunnels if they want to go there."
"I see." Bai Yueqin nodded in understanding.

Liao Hanxue then spoke to her grandmother. "Grandma, I already told Zhang Fei that our clan has repeatedly tried to make such a teleportation device, but we always hit a dead end because the barrier blocks the way out. However, he has an ability to connect the two realms that might be able to give us a solution to open the way out, and we might succeed in creating the device if we can analyze his ability."
"What kind of ability do you have to connect the two realms, Zhang Fei?"
"This." Zhang Fei immediately opened the gate, shocking Bai Yueqin and Liao Shengye. "If you two go through this gate, you will arrive at the Xianjin Realm directly."
Upon hearing that, Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin immediately jumped into the gate, but a few minutes later, they returned with expressions of astonishment.
"Who exactly are you? In my entire life, I’ve never heard of such an ability." Liao Shengye asked, still astonished by what he had seen earlier.
Bai Yueqin agreed with her husband. "If you really want to cooperate with us, I hope you are willing to explain to us the truth."
"Show them your sincerity, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Fei sighed softly before transforming into his demon form, but he immediately transformed into his heavenly fox form before returning to his human form, leaving Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin stunned for a long time.

Qiao Yisheng was also surprised by Zhang Fei’s two forms, especially since he had only shown his Calamity Dragon Form to him before. Tang Qingyan glanced at her husband, and she noticed that he didn’t know either of them yet, but she said nothing.
"Haha." Liao Hanxue laughed and embraced their shoulders. "Grandpa! Grandma! I was shocked like you two at first, but Zhang Fei is truly a human, a demon, and a fox beast."
"How could such a thing happen?"

"Long story short, I died once, and someone brought me back to life. However, that person revived me in an unusual way, and since then, I have had three identities." Zhang Fei pointed his finger at the gate. "This ability belongs to my beast identity, and I can travel to all the realms I’ve been to before whenever I want."
They were curious about the person’s identity, but Zhang Fei shook his head at them, indicating that he didn’t know anything.
"What do you think about this, husband?"

Liao Shengye pondered for a moment. "I’m still not sure if we’ll succeed in creating such a teleportation device, but I think we should stay here to analyze this gate for now. If we can find a solution after analyzing it, we might be able to make it happen. However, we can’t do it alone, and we need someone with void elements. Unfortunately, not many cultivators have those elements, but Kong Bai and Nu Liexi are the best void cultivators in this realm."
"What do you think if we invite them here, Zhang Fei?" Bai Yueqin asked.

"Senior, I don’t want too many people to know about me, especially now." Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqing understood Zhang Fei’s intention to hide himself from the public. "Actually, I know two other people with the void element, and one of them lives in this sect. The other one is my sister-in-law, and she lives in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."
"Your sister-in-law? Immortal Lotus Sanctuary?"
Liao Hanxue immediately told them. "I forgot to tell you two that one of Zhang Fei’s wives is Luo Yunxiao, and she is the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi."

Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqing nodded in understanding. "In that case, we will first analyze your gate, and if we succeed in finding a solution for the device, you can bring those two people to meet us. After all, a teleportation device uses the principle of space and void, so we need the help of a cultivator with one of those elements."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei led Liao Hanxue, Qiao Yisheng, and Tang Qingyan away from the Blacksmith Hall. However, he left the latter two in the medical hall after introducing them to Elmyra, Tian Yishen, Xiao Laoshu, and several others.
Zhang Fei then took Liao Hanxue to the Array Hall, but there weren’t many people there compared to the other halls. "Luolan."
"Hmm?" Duanmu Luolan turned to Zhang Fei directly. "Is she your new woman, husband?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "You’re mistaken about her, Luolan. Senior Liao Hanxue is Zhuxian Sheng’s woman, and she’s an expert in formation arrays, so I brought her here to meet you."
"Oh?"
Liao Hanxue smiled at her. "It seems your husband is too much of a womanizer, so you consider every woman by his side his potential wife."
"You’re right, senior. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have over a hundred wives, right?" Both Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan laughed as they glanced at Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei simply shook his head. "Luolan, I’ll go to the Floral Mirage Domain, and you can discuss the formation arrays with Senior Hanxue."
After that, Zhang Fei left the Array Hall, but he first picked up Jia Yuyan before leaving their sect.
Liao Hanxue pulled Duanmu Luolan to sit beside her. "So, what kind of array formation do you want to know?"

"I need a stronger protective array." Liao Hanxue looked at Duanmu Luolan in confusion. "Senior, this sect does have two powerful formations, but I feel that they are insufficient, and I want to build another protective formation as a backup."

chapters.title: Chapter 1324: Floral Mirage Domain
paragraphs: Liao Hanxue nodded understandingly at Duanmu Luolan. "Your idea is excellent, and I support your decision to install a backup barrier. So, what level are you in formation arrays?"
"Haha." Duanmu Luolan took out a formation array and showed it to Liao Hanxue, surprising her a bit. "I reached rank 10 array master a long time ago, Senior."

Liao Hanxue read the formation while nodding several times. "This formation array is indeed for a rank 10 array master, but the grade is too low, and it is too weak for this realm. I had never descended into the Three Mortal Realms before Zhang Fei took me there a few days ago, so I want you to tell me about the array grades that exist there."
"There are only five grade arrays in the Three Mortal Realms." Duanmu Luolan then mentioned them one by one.

"I see." Liao Hanxue nodded in understanding. "Unlike in the Three Mortal Realms, the formation arrays in this realm are not divided into grades like that. Instead, we divide them based on their uses, such as trap formations, protective formations, offensive and defensive formations, and several others. Each formation is divided into four: early, mid, high, and peak."
"Huh?" Duanmu Luolan was really surprised.

Liao Hanxue took out a formation and showed it to Duanmu Luolan. "In this realm, your protective formation is classified as a high-rank protective formation, so its strength is inferior to mine, which is a peak-grade."
"What grade is the defensive formation in this sect, Senior?"
"A high-rank protective formation, but its strength is stronger than yours."

Duanmu Luolan immediately took out the Sect Guardian Formation Array, showing it to Liao Yunxiao. "My husband gave me this formation, and he asked me to set it up in this sect. At first, I was confident I could set it up, but there were some materials I didn’t recognize, so I still haven’t set it up to this day."

"Hmm?" Liao Hanxue took the formation and read it carefully. "This formation is peak-grade, and its effects should be much better than mine. As for these materials, I have them all in my storage ring, so I can help you set it up. However, we need the help of a few people, so you must summon some people here, and we’ll set it up as soon as they arrive."
"Alright." Duanmu Luolan immediately contacted several elders, such as Rong Yuchen, Xue Ling, Shui Qianrou, and several others.
Once they had gathered, Liao Hanxue took out the materials and provided a detailed explanation. After everyone understood, they successfully began installing the formation.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the Divine Origin Main Domain. At first, he only wanted to take Jia Yuyan with him, but Tianshi Shengjie decided to join them because he wanted to see Long Wuzhao.

However, Zhang Fei sent Jia Yuyan into his soul world before he and Tianshi Shengjie left the Moonlite Passion Sect because Jia Zizhen could detect her presence, and he didn’t want the Fairy King to be alerted, as it would only cause him trouble.
Tianshi Shengjie immediately took Zhang Fei to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and she led him to the Dragon Tower in the center of the domain, where Long Wuzhao lived.

"Emperor! Father!" Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong looked at Tianshi Shengjie and the others. "Zhang Fei plans to go to the Flower Mirage Domain today, and he will face off against Jia Zizhen to settle everything. However, we need evidence of the Fairy King’s crimes to bring him down, so I brought them here to meet you two."

Long Wuzhao did not immediately provide the evidence to Zhang Fei. "Are you really ready to fight Jia Zizhen? If you face him now, you might expose yourself to Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu, especially since he conspired with those two demon gods to kill the previous Fairy King in the past. Moreover, their people should still be hiding in the Flower Mirage Domain, as they were tasked with helping him track your whereabouts."

"I’m ready." Zhang Fei immediately activated the soul link and borrowed the power of all the beasts living in his beast space for a few seconds. "With my current strength, I should be able to face Jia Zizhen, right? Jiu Mozu has seen me before in the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, but he still doesn’t know that I am their target. Moreover, I have a spy in his demon race, and she will directly inform me of his plans, so I don’t worry too much about him. As for Mo Shentian, he is indeed powerful, but I am not afraid of him, and I am confident that I can hide from him if he comes looking for me."
"Why are you so eager to challenge Jia Zizhen?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a frown.

"Shouldn’t you already know my reasons, father-in-law?" Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Shengjie’s lips twitched because of Zhang Fei’s shamelessness. "One of the souls of the ten-tailed fox lives in that domain, and I want to go to him as soon as possible to merge with him."

’I still find it difficult to believe that you fell for this shameless fox, Shengjie.’ Tianshi Shengjie responded to Tianshi Bailong with a bitter smile. ’Sigh! He’s a fox, and you’re a dragon, so I’m confused imagining your child with him in the future. Will my grandchild be a dragon-fox or a fox-dragon?’

Tianshi Shengjie stared at her father in a daze, as she hadn’t thought that far ahead about her relationship with Zhang Fei. Let alone marrying him, she hadn’t even accepted him yet, but Tianshi Bailong was already thinking about a grandchild. ’Do you want a grandchild that much, Father?’

’Does that even need to be questioned, Shengjie?’ Tianshi Bailong asked, sighing softly. ’Your mother and I have been waiting for you to choose your future husband for tens of thousands of years, but you always delay choosing your husband for this child.’
Tianshi Shengjie chose not to answer her father, as she still had not decided the future of her relationship with Zhang Fei.
"Have you found his other souls?" Long Wuzhao asked.

Zhang Fei nodded at Long Wuzhao. "Currently, one of my clones is with his bloodlust soul, but it takes me six months to a year to merge with him. His gluttony soul is with Dong Xuanyin in the Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and his wrath soul is in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain. As for his envy and greed souls, I don’t have any information on either of them yet. Therefore, I’ll focus on merging with his other souls first, and I’ll start with his sloth soul in the Floral Mirage Domain."

"I see." Long Wuzhao immediately handed the evidence to Zhang Fei. "Empress Huo gave it to me about four months ago, but she forbade me from taking action against Jia Zizhen, and she said that she wanted you to deal with him yourself. Even if you’re confident in your abilities, Brother Bailong and I will go with you to the Floral Mirage Domain, and we’ll only make a move if you can’t deal with him."
"Sometimes it’s hard for me to understand Feng Yao’s thoughts, especially since she’s always so secretive." Zhang Fei received the device and put it away. "Shall we set off now?"

"Wait a minute." Soon, Long Xukong appeared before them, and Long Wuzhao spoke to him. "Brother, it’s time we make our move on Jia Zizhen, but we will only make our move if Zhang Fei can’t defeat him."
"Hmm?" Long Xukong looked at Zhang Fei, who looked confident in defeating Jia Zizhen. "Let’s go then, and the three of us will hide in the void while watching them."
"Wait for a while."
*Tap... Tap...*
Two people walked into the room, who were Jia Yuyan’s grandparents, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun. "Is it really time to face Jia Zizhen?"
"Ask him." Long Wuzhao pointed at Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei shook his head at Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun. "Whether this is the right time or not, you two will see it once we arrive at the domain."
"Did you bring Yuyan with you?"

"Yes, Yuyan is in my soul world now." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were relieved to hear that, and Zhang Fei told them something else. "Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang are with her now, and I will summon them when we deal with Jia Zizhen so they can help us deal with him. Additionally, I’ve ordered Jia Fenglie to do something about his subordinates, but I don’t know if he will succeed."
Jia Shengyun shook his head at Zhang Fei. "I don’t know what you ordered Jia Fengli to do, but I’m sure he won’t succeed, so we shouldn’t have much hope for him."
"Alright." Zhang Fei then spoke to the three dragons. "The three of us will go along the usual route, and we will meet there."
After Long Wuzhao agreed, Long Xukong immediately took him and the two celestial dragons into the void, heading towards the Floral Mirage Domain through it.

"Are you two ready to face Jia Zizhen and his subordinates? After all, you all come from the same race, and you might feel uncomfortable fighting them." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun solemnly nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately enveloped them in his aura and led them away from the Dragon Palace.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Floral Mirage Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
