"This formation array is indeed for a rank 10 array master, but the grade is too low, and it is too weak for this realm.
I had never descended into the Three Mortal Realms before Zhang Fei took me there a few days ago, so I want you to tell me about the array grades that exist there."
"There are only five grade arrays in the Three Mortal Realms." Duanmu Luolan then mentioned them one by one.
"I see." Liao Hanxue nodded in understanding.
"Unlike in the Three Mortal Realms, the formation arrays in this realm are not divided into grades like that.
Instead, we divide them based on their uses, such as trap formations, protective formations, offensive and defensive formations, and several others.
Each formation is divided into four: early, mid, high, and peak."
"Huh?" Duanmu Luolan was really surprised.
Liao Hanxue took out a formation and showed it to Duanmu Luolan.
"In this realm, your protective formation is classified as a high-rank protective formation, so its strength is inferior to mine, which is a peak-grade."
"What grade is the defensive formation in this sect, Senior?"
"A high-rank protective formation, but its strength is stronger than yours."
Duanmu Luolan immediately took out the Sect Guardian Formation Array, showing it to Liao Yunxiao.
"My husband gave me this formation, and he asked me to set it up in this sect.
At first, I was confident I could set it up, but there were some materials I didn’t recognize, so I still haven’t set it up to this day."
"Hmm?" Liao Hanxue took the formation and read it carefully.
"This formation is peak-grade, and its effects should be much better than mine.
As for these materials, I have them all in my storage ring, so I can help you set it up.
However, we need the help of a few people, so you must summon some people here, and we’ll set it up as soon as they arrive."
"Alright." Duanmu Luolan immediately contacted several elders, such as Rong Yuchen, Xue Ling, Shui Qianrou, and several others.
Once they had gathered, Liao Hanxue took out the materials and provided a detailed explanation.
After everyone understood, they successfully began installing the formation.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the Divine Origin Main Domain.
At first, he only wanted to take Jia Yuyan with him, but Tianshi Shengjie decided to join them because he wanted to see Long Wuzhao.

However, Zhang Fei sent Jia Yuyan into his soul world before he and Tianshi Shengjie left the Moonlite Passion Sect because Jia Zizhen could detect her presence, and he didn’t want the Fairy King to be alerted, as it would only cause him trouble.
Tianshi Shengjie immediately took Zhang Fei to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and she led him to the Dragon Tower in the center of the domain, where Long Wuzhao lived.
"Emperor!
Father!" Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong looked at Tianshi Shengjie and the others.
"Zhang Fei plans to go to the Flower Mirage Domain today, and he will face off against Jia Zizhen to settle everything.
However, we need evidence of the Fairy King’s crimes to bring him down, so I brought them here to meet you two."
Long Wuzhao did not immediately provide the evidence to Zhang Fei.
"Are you really ready to fight Jia Zizhen?
If you face him now, you might expose yourself to Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu, especially since he conspired with those two demon gods to kill the previous Fairy King in the past.
Moreover, their people should still be hiding in the Flower Mirage Domain, as they were tasked with helping him track your whereabouts."
"I’m ready." Zhang Fei immediately activated the soul link and borrowed the power of all the beasts living in his beast space for a few seconds.
"With my current strength, I should be able to face Jia Zizhen, right?
Jiu Mozu has seen me before in the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, but he still doesn’t know that I am their target.
Moreover, I have a spy in his demon race, and she will directly inform me of his plans, so I don’t worry too much about him.
As for Mo Shentian, he is indeed powerful, but I am not afraid of him, and I am confident that I can hide from him if he comes looking for me."
"Why are you so eager to challenge Jia Zizhen?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a frown.
"Shouldn’t you already know my reasons, father-in-law?" Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Shengjie’s lips twitched because of Zhang Fei’s shamelessness.
"One of the souls of the ten-tailed fox lives in that domain, and I want to go to him as soon as possible to merge with him."
’I still find it difficult to believe that you fell for this shameless fox, Shengjie.’ Tianshi Shengjie responded to Tianshi Bailong with a bitter smile. ’Sigh!
He’s a fox, and you’re a dragon, so I’m confused imagining your child with him in the future.
Will my grandchild be a dragon-fox or a fox-dragon?’
Tianshi Shengjie stared at her father in a daze, as she hadn’t thought that far ahead about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Let alone marrying him, she hadn’t even accepted him yet, but Tianshi Bailong was already thinking about a grandchild. ’Do you want a grandchild that much, Father?’

’Does that even need to be questioned, Shengjie?’ Tianshi Bailong asked, sighing softly. ’Your mother and I have been waiting for you to choose your future husband for tens of thousands of years, but you always delay choosing your husband for this child.’
Tianshi Shengjie chose not to answer her father, as she still had not decided the future of her relationship with Zhang Fei.
"Have you found his other souls?" Long Wuzhao asked.
Zhang Fei nodded at Long Wuzhao.
"Currently, one of my clones is with his bloodlust soul, but it takes me six months to a year to merge with him.
His gluttony soul is with Dong Xuanyin in the Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and his wrath soul is in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain.
As for his envy and greed souls, I don’t have any information on either of them yet.
Therefore, I’ll focus on merging with his other souls first, and I’ll start with his sloth soul in the Floral Mirage Domain."
"I see." Long Wuzhao immediately handed the evidence to Zhang Fei.
"Empress Huo gave it to me about four months ago, but she forbade me from taking action against Jia Zizhen, and she said that she wanted you to deal with him yourself.
Even if you’re confident in your abilities, Brother Bailong and I will go with you to the Floral Mirage Domain, and we’ll only make a move if you can’t deal with him."
"Sometimes it’s hard for me to understand Feng Yao’s thoughts, especially since she’s always so secretive." Zhang Fei received the device and put it away.
"Shall we set off now?"
"Wait a minute." Soon, Long Xukong appeared before them, and Long Wuzhao spoke to him.
"Brother, it’s time we make our move on Jia Zizhen, but we will only make our move if Zhang Fei can’t defeat him."
"Hmm?" Long Xukong looked at Zhang Fei, who looked confident in defeating Jia Zizhen.
"Let’s go then, and the three of us will hide in the void while watching them."
"Wait for a while."
*Tap...
Tap...*
Two people walked into the room, who were Jia Yuyan’s grandparents, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun.
"Is it really time to face Jia Zizhen?"
"Ask him." Long Wuzhao pointed at Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei shook his head at Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun.
"Whether this is the right time or not, you two will see it once we arrive at the domain."
"Did you bring Yuyan with you?"
"Yes, Yuyan is in my soul world now." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were relieved to hear that, and Zhang Fei told them something else.
"Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang are with her now, and I will summon them when we deal with Jia Zizhen so they can help us deal with him.
Additionally, I’ve ordered Jia Fenglie to do something about his subordinates, but I don’t know if he will succeed."
Jia Shengyun shook his head at Zhang Fei.
"I don’t know what you ordered Jia Fengli to do, but I’m sure he won’t succeed, so we shouldn’t have much hope for him."
"Alright." Zhang Fei then spoke to the three dragons.
"The three of us will go along the usual route, and we will meet there."
After Long Wuzhao agreed, Long Xukong immediately took him and the two celestial dragons into the void, heading towards the Floral Mirage Domain through it.
"Are you two ready to face Jia Zizhen and his subordinates?

After all, you all come from the same race, and you might feel uncomfortable fighting them." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun solemnly nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately enveloped them in his aura and led them away from the Dragon Palace.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Floral Mirage Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1325: Reveal The Evidence
paragraphs: "Hmm?" Jia Zizhen abruptly looked into the distance, his expression turning vicious before speaking. "Mo Yunzhe and Jiu Hui, our target has appeared."
"Do you mean the heir of the ten-tailed fox?"
"Yes." Jia Zizhen pointed north. "The statue of the ten-tailed fox is in that area, and Zhang Fei is there now."
"Ordered your subordinates."
After Mo Yunzhe and Jiu Hui disappeared, Jia Zizhen ordered his subordinates to surround Zhang Fei at the location of the statue of the ten-tailed fox.
Jia Zizhen wanted to go to that area, but he suddenly sensed the presence of another Zhang Fei not far from his palace, causing him to frown.
Jia Zizhen hurriedly left his palace to chase after him, but the second Zhang Fei immediately flew toward another area.
As he followed the second Zhang Fei, Jia Zizhen detected the presence of the third Zhang Fei in the Floral Mirage Domain.

"What the hell is going on? I know he’s using a clone technique, but his aura and strength are too perfect for clones." Jia Zizhen became even more confused when he sensed the presence of the other two Zhang Feis. "What the fuck? How could he produce four perfect clones? What was his plan? Why did he do that?"

As he continued to chase the second Zhang Fei, Jia Zizhen ordered his subordinates to chase the other three. "His speed is absurd! His cultivation is only at the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, but he keeps getting away from me."
Inside the void, Long Wuzhao nodded in satisfaction as he watched Zhang Fei’s actions.
"It seems that kid has thought things through carefully, Brother Wuzhao." Long Xukong spoke.
"That’s true." Tianshi Bailong nodded in agreement. "How can his flying speed be so fast? No matter how fast Jia Zizhen flies after him, he keeps evading his pursuit."

"Father, Zhang Fei’s current speed is not his true speed, and he can still speed it up." Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong turned to Tianshi Shengjie with surprise. "He has been training for years under gravity that is sixty-four times heavier than normal. Even Su Shentian, dubbed ’the speed demon’ by other fellow cultivators, gave up competing for speed with him. Therefore, Jia Zizhen will never be able to catch up to his speed, let alone capture him."
"If he has such speed, why did he hold himself back for so long?"

Tianshi Shengjie shook her head. "Zhang Fei is used to working behind the scenes, and he prefers to do everything secretly. After his Cursed Demon Heart went out of control and almost took control of him, he was filled with fear of death and became more cautious. I don’t know what happened to him in the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, but he had regained his old self, and he no longer wanted to hold himself back."
"He—" Tianshi Bailong stopped speaking and looked in another direction, as did Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong.

Soon, two people appeared before them, none other than Kong Bai and Nu Liexi. Both of them looked outside the void, finding Zhang Fei and his four clones in the Floral Mirage Domain. They were surprised when they saw Jia Zizhen chasing one of them and two demons chasing the other two, making them immediately realize his identity. "Is he the heir of the ten-tailed fox, Dragon Emperor?"

"His name is Zhang Fei and he is the heir of the ten-tailed fox." Long Wuzhao then warned them. "I know they ordered you two to find him, but I forbid you from revealing anything about him, unless you are tired of living and want to die at the hands of Empress Huo."
Kong Bai and Nu Liexi shivered when Long Wuzhao mentioned Feng Yao’s past name. "What is Zhang Fei planning? Those two demons are Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu’s subordinates, right?"
"What else?" Long Wuzhao responded with a shake of his head. "You two have heard that Empress Huo wanted Zhang Fei to deal with Jia Zizhen himself, and he decided to do it today."
"Can he win against Jia Zizhen?" Nu Liexi doubtfully asked, even though Zhang Fei clearly outclassed Jia Zizhen in speed.
"Just wait and see; we will know the results soon."

Zhang Fei [1] stood right above the fairy race’s main city as he held the device containing evidence of Jia Zizhen’s crimes. However, many of the Fairy King’s subordinates immediately surrounded him, with their leaders’ cultivation being in the Celestial Venerable Realm.
"Surrender to us, or we will punish you on the spot!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that. "Do you guys think I’m afraid of you? Do you think I came here unprepared?"

Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated the soul link before activating his sword domain, and he expanded it as far as possible, covering the entire area of the main city. Jia Zizhen’s subordinates wanted to attack him, but millions of qi swords immediately surrounded them.
Zhang Fei [1] smirked at their expression, and he immediately restricted their movements, which shocked all of them. They realized that his strength had increased significantly, surpassing theirs.

"You guys are just old fools, you know?" Zhang Fei [1] moved some qi swords towards their necks and pressed them there, causing them to bleed. "I’m eager to kill all of you right here and now, but you’re lucky because I am not entitled to do so, and some people have far more right than I do."
Jia Zizhen’s subordinates were shocked as soon as the four people appeared in front of them, but what shocked them most was the appearance of Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang.
"Jia Xianzu! Jia You!"
Both of them ignored those people, and Jia Xianzu spoke to Zhang Fei [1]. "Activate the device now, kid. This problem has been going on for too long, so we want to end it today."
"The past Fairy King candidates, who have the same fate as the two of us, are already on their way here." Beiming Youhuang spoke.
"Alright." Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated the device, causing it to fly to the center of the main city, where several qi screens appeared in the sky above it.
All the fairy race members in that city, as well as those in other cities, immediately stopped their activities and stared at the qi screens.

Jia Xianzu took a deep breath before shouting as loudly as he could, "Listen up! I, Jia Xianzu, had no evidence of Jia Zizhen’s betrayal of our King and race in the past. I chose to exile myself after he accused me of murdering the previous fairy king. However, all the evidence is before your eyes now, and all of you can see for yourselves how he conspired with the Celestial Demon Race and the Nine-Nether Demon Race to kill our king! Some of you might think I’m fabricating all this evidence, but I assure you that everything you see on these screens is real because all of this evidence came from Empress Huo Yanling, and the presence of two demons from both races in our territory is further proof. If you’re having trouble finding those two demons, they are now at the location of the ten-tailed fox statue."

Hearing that, those loyal to the previous Fairy King immediately checked the location of the ten-tailed fox statue, where they found Feltia [2] and Zhang Xiaolong [3], who were already in their half-fox forms with nine tails, fighting with Mo Yunzhe and Jiu Hui.
Beiming Youhuang immediately spoke. "The fox fighting the two demons is the one we’ve been waiting for so long, and he is the sole heir of Hu Tianlang."
Beiming Youhuang’s words caused the entire Floral Mirage Domain to fall silent, but a few moments later, loud cheers coming from all corners of the domain broke the silence.

Unlike them, the members of the fairy race who had been loyal to Jia Zizhen since he became the fairy king were terrified after his conspiracy with the two demon races was revealed to the public. Some of them chose to put down their weapons and surrender, but many others decided to flee their domains, including those who were besieging Zhang Fei [1].
"Futile!" Jia Xianzu, Beiming Youhuang, Jia Shengyun, and Jia Lingzhu immediately moved to capture them.
Since his business was finished, Zhang Fei [1] immediately left the area, followed by Zhang Fei [5], chasing after Jia Zizhen, who was still playing cat and mouse with his original body.
Since all of the Fairy King’s crimes had been exposed to the public, Zhang Fei decided to stop flying and landed on a hill far outside the main city, waiting for Jia Zizhen to arrive.

A while later, Jia Zizhen landed in front of Zhang Fei with an expression so full of rage, and his veins were bulging from under his skin. He had worked so hard and used every means to rule the Fairy Race and become their king. His position had been secure for tens of thousands of years, but everything had collapsed in the blink of an eye.
Jia Zizhen frowned when Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [5] landed on both sides of Zhang Fei, who immediately summoned Jia Yuyan out of his soul world.

Zhang Fei hugged and kissed Jia Yuyan right before Jia Zizhen’s eyes. "Ever since I listened to the message you left for me, I already knew that you were not a good man, but I didn’t expect that your crimes were so extraordinary, including betraying and killing your former king."

chapters.title: Chapter 1326: Capture The Three
paragraphs: "I didn’t expect you to be such a person, Jia Zizhen," Jia Yuyan spoke with contempt. "In the past, I always trusted you and idolized you because you were always kind to me, but your kindness was just a deception, and you harbored a terrible dark side. Luckily, I met Senior Jia Xianzu, and he woke me up from your deception; otherwise, I would have fallen into the hands of a vile traitor like you."

"You bitch! I—Gah!" Jia Zizhen staggered backwards after Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [5] kicked his chest. "Tch! You act arrogant in front of me, but you’re just a coward who can only borrow other people’s power."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Where’s your proof that I borrowed someone else’s strength? Even if I use such a technique, it is normal in battle. Besides, aren’t you a hypocrite? Have you forgotten how you borrowed the power of Mo Shentian, Mo Zainan, and Jiu Mozu to gang up on and kill your king? Without their help, you would never have succeeded in killing him, remember?"

"You—" Jia Zizhen parried Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, causing him to stagger backwards again. Even though their strengths were equal, Zhang Fei’s two clones were superior to the fairy king thanks to the eight body techniques he had mastered, which boosted his raw attacks and body strength significantly.

Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [5] continued to attack Jia Zizhen with high-speed and accurate attacks, combined with the high speed of their movements, overwhelming the Fairy King to fend off their attacks.
"Yuyan, I will send you back to my soul world first." After he sent Jia Yuyan inside, Zhang Fei immediately joined his two clones to attack Jia Zizhen.

Feeling pressured by Zhang Fei and his two clones’ attacks, Jia Zizhen used his fastest speed to escape from them, and he used abilities similar to those of Jia Xianzu when he confronted the members of the Xing Clan.
In a few moments, thousands of figures made of wind, water, earth, fire, lightning, wood, light, and darkness appear to surround them.

"Hahaha!" Jia Zizhen laughed heartily after they appeared. "You might have defeated me if you had used your full power from the start, but you no longer have that chance, and my minions will kill you all here."

"No wonder the previous Fairy King never intended to choose you as his successor, especially since you were too much of an idiot to become a king." Jia Zizhen frowned at him, but his expression turned to shock when Zhang Fei and his clones activated all of their elemental domains. "Since the beginning, you have not been my opponent, and you will never become one because you are just a coward."
"Attack!" Those thousands of elemental figures moved to attack Zhang Fei and his two clones, but all of them disappeared as soon as they entered their domains.

"Tsk... Tsk..." Zhang Fei shook his head. "What a foolish and senile old brat! No matter how many you summon, they won’t be able to survive inside my domains. Back then, I was afraid of you, but it turned out my worries were unfounded because your abilities are limited to this."

Zhang Fei raised his hand toward the sky and shot some of his flames. His golden flames turned into the three-legged golden crow, his dark flames turned into a dark phoenix, his crimson flames turned into a fire phoenix, his bright red flame turned into a fire dragon, and his icy cold flame turned into an ice phoenix.
’What the hell? Where did he get so many different beast flames?’ Jia Zizhen was completely shocked after seeing all those flame figures.

"What do you think would happen if all my flames hit your body?" Throughout his life, Jia Zizhen had never felt death so close to him, and he realized that the source was Zhang Fei’s golden crow flames. "My golden flames can destroy even the strongest metal, let alone the skulls and flesh of living creatures. Long Xukong then spoke. "Even though that kid’s clones are extraordinary and his speed is impressive, his main advantage is the mysterious thing that helps him increase his strength to reach our levels."

chapters.title: Chapter 1327: Ten-Tailed Fox’s Sloth Soul
paragraphs: Long Wuzhao and others took Jia Zizhen and his subordinates back to the Fairy King Palace, summoning all members of the Fairy Race to gather to determine the punishment of their traitors.

The past Fairy King candidates, who have the same fate as Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang, have gathered there. Even though they had previously seen the evidence before, Long Wuzhao replayed everything, allowing them to see more clearly all the crimes committed by Jia Zizhen in the past.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the location of the statue of the ten-tailed fox, with Tianshi Shengjie behind him. He immediately summoned Jia Yuyan out of his soul world before approaching the statue. "Old fox, I know you are inside, so please come out now."

"Hahaha." The ten-tailed fox’s sloth soul came straight out of the statue as he laughed. "You should have been able to come here after you got the nine evil beasts, but you kept me waiting longer, kid."

"My fear after the incident with my Cursed Demon Heart prevented me from coming here sooner, old fox," Zhang Fei then asked Hu Tianlang. "Is it true that this soul of yours holds half of your memories?"

Hu Tianlang nodded at Zhang Fei. "My benevolent soul tells you the truth, and this soul does hold half of my memories. However, they are only minor memories, and the other half is stored within my greed and envy souls, and both are in a faraway place. If you succeed in finding and merging with them, you will get all my memories, including my memories from the Primordial Era."
"A faraway palace?"
"The Ancient Realm."
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei cursed directly. "When can I evolve into the ten tails?"

"Hahaha." Hu Tianlang laughed at Zhang Fei’s question. "Why are you in such a hurry to evolve to ten tails? With your current strength, you can’t defeat my wrath soul because he inherited most of my original’s strength. If you meet him now, he will beat you again like what he did in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and you will suffer even more serious injuries."

Zhang Fei’s expression turned gloomy after Hu Tianlang mentioned that incident, as that day was the first time he felt extreme fear in his life. "If your wrath soul doesn’t inherit all of your original strength, then where do you keep the rest?"
"Shouldn’t you already know the answer, kid?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "You divide the rest and store it in the hearts of Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."

"That’s right." Hu Tianlang confirmed it with a nod. "In the past, I was able to descend to this Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms because I had already divided most of my strength and stored it in my wrath soul. When I split myself into two, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian each inherited half of my remaining strength. If you evolve into ten tails and inherit my original strength in this realm, all domains in this realm will collapse, and all its inhabitants will die because of you."
Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "So, I can only evolve to ten tails in the Ancient Realm, right?"

"Yes." Hu Tianlang nodded at Zhang Fei. "You’ve already met Puyang Shangren of the Puyang Clan, so your path to the Ancient Realm is already open. Even if you can’t go there on your own, Feng Yao will definitely take you there, but she won’t be taking you there anytime soon. It’s true that you can increase your strength by borrowing the power of those beasts, but you’ve already witnessed the power of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, so you should already have an idea of the power of the ancients, right?"

Zhang Fei certainly couldn’t forget the day when the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu slaughtered those demons and evil beasts; even those mystical evil beasts couldn’t escape from his attack, and he slaughtered all of them with just one attack. "If he was really serious at that time, his attacks would have destroyed the Forbidden Land."

"The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu is incredibly powerful; not even Long Wuzhao or the four perils can defeat him." Zhang Fei agreed with Hu Tianlang. "Additionally, there are many other beasts that are much stronger than him there, even though they are not as strong as the Primordial Genesis Beast or the Primordial Nihility Beasts."

Zhang Fei looked at Hu Tianlang in disbelief, as the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was already too powerful, and he said there were still many beasts stronger than him. "How strong are the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast?"

"Don’t mention their real bodies; even if their avatars descend to this realm for too long, all the domains will be destroyed instantly. Once you go to the Ancient Realm, you will encounter their avatars, and they will definitely hunt you down, especially since you are the current Calamity Demon Dragon." Zhang Fei had already heard that from Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang, so he was no longer surprised to hear that from Hu Tianlang. "Alright, there’s no point thinking about them now, and you just have to take one step at a time."
"Grandpa Hun." Hu Tianlang looked at Jia Yuyan. "Are you leaving now?"

"Haha." Hu Tianlang softly laughed. "Little Yuyan, we have been together for a long time, so you already know that I have to leave one day, and today is the time. Thank you for bringing him here, and I hope you will always be happy with him."
Jia Yuyan nodded slightly. "Don’t worry, Grandpa Hun. I will always be happy with my husband."

"Yeah." Hu Tianlang looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "What are you hesitating for, Little Shengjie? As I said in the past, you and Little Yuyan are destined to be together with my successor. He is standing before you now, so it’s time for you to make a decision and fulfill your destiny."

Tianshi Shengjie shook her head at Hu Tianlang. "I’ve long accepted my destiny, but I’m different from Jia Yuyan, and I will wait for him to conquer my heart first. If he succeeds in conquering my heart, I will give myself completely to him."

"I see." Hu Tianlang then spoke to Zhang Fei again. "Kid, once our souls begin to merge, you must immediately return to your training space. You became more lustful after you acquired my lustful nature, and you became more arrogant after you acquired my proud nature, so you should already know what will happen if my lazy nature affects you. Once it affects you, you must not leave your training space until you can overcome its effects."

"I know." One of Zhang Fei’s clones went straight to the Moonlit Passion Temple and brought all his women back to the training space, except for Duanmu Luolan, who was still busy with Liao Hanxue. "How long will it take for me to overcome the effects?"

"It will depend on yourself." Hu Tianlang answered Zhang Fei with a shake of his head. "You will become really lazy after our souls fully merge, so you should use that time to enter seclusion again to help all your women increase their strength, especially since you will need a lot of help in the future. Additionally, time flows four times faster in that space, which will significantly aid you in overcoming the effects."

"Shengjie, I hope you will join us this time, so we will have more time together." Tianshi Shengjie agreed with Zhang Fei, who immediately opened a portal to the training space and released his soul. "Let’s do it, old fox."
Hu Tianlang looked at Tianshi Shengji and Jia Yuyan for a while before darting into Zhang Fei’s soul, starting the process of merging their souls.

In that instant, Zhang Fei felt an overwhelming laziness wash over him, forcing Tianshi Shengjie and Jia Yuyan to support him. They immediately took him into the training space, making the portal disappear by itself.
Shortly after they left, Kong Bai and Nu Liexi appeared at the scene. "Can you detect the entrance to that kid’s private space, Old Kong?"
"No." Kong Bai shook his head in response. "That kid’s private space uses the principles of space and void elements, but I think those two elements are slightly different from what we know so far."

"At least we’ve gathered enough information about that kid, but we can’t tell those old folks about him; otherwise, the Dragon Emperor and Empress Huo will punish us." Nu Liexi then looked at Kong Bai. "However, I’m curious about their discussion regarding the Ancient Realm; does that imply there are other realms beyond this Paradise Realm? Moreover, I’ve never heard of the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast before, and both beasts must be truly powerful because Hu Tianlang said that they could destroy this realm just using their avatars."

"Those two beasts must be truly powerful," Kong Bai uttered as he nodded. "Humans like us may not know about their existence, but I’m sure the Golden Dragon Emperor, the Golden Phoenix Emperor, and the others must already know about them. They’ve probably already realized that they can’t fight those two beasts, and they’re waiting for the return of the ten-tailed fox because only Hu Tianlang’s successor can fight them."
"Then—"

"No." Kong Bai stopped Nu Liexi with a shake of his head. "There are many things beyond our reach, and this matter is one of them, so we shouldn’t delve too deeply into it, or we’ll end up in trouble."

paragraphs: "I think you’re right about them." Mo Shentian narrowed his eyes outside his palace window. "Unfortunately, Jia Zizhen has fallen now, and I’m sure the Fairy Race will sentence him and his subordinates to death for their betrayal of Jia Xinghua. Even if we want to find Zhang Fei, we have no clue about his whereabouts, and we can’t possibly search for him randomly in the other 90 domains."

"Speaking of the Zhang surname, I’ve heard of that clan before." Mo Shentian returned his attention to Mo Zainan. "There is only one Zhang Clan in this realm, and they live in the Starfall Martial Domain. Although they are humans, they are one of the strongest in this realm, but their strength still cannot be compared with our demon race."
"But—"

"Jia Zizhen did say that Zhang Fei ascended from the Three Mortal Realms, but that doesn’t rule out the possibility that he will join the Zhang Clan because they share the same surname. If he joins that clan, his life as a new ascender in this realm will be much easier." Mo Shentian nodded in agreement with Mo Zainan. "Whether he joins that clan or not, we should send someone to investigate first, and we’ll find out later. However, we must do everything carefully so as not to alert Long Wuzhao, let alone Empress Huo Yabling."
"Yes." Mo Shentian immediately contacted someone to come to them.
Before long, Mo Taizi came to them, but he was not alone, and he brought the fake Nalan Wangzi with him. "Why did you call me, Father?"

"Taizi, your ability in disguising your demon aura is the best among your brothers and sisters, so I want you to go to the Starfall Martial Domain to investigate the Zhang Clan." Mo Shentian’s order surprised not only Mo Taizi but also the fake Nalan Wangzi. "I want you to find a man named Zhang Fei, and you must inform me if you find him in that clan."
"Who exactly is Zhang Fei, Father?"

Mo Shentian explained several things to Mo Taizi, especially regarding Zhang Fei’s identity as the chosen successor of the ten-tailed fox. "According to Jia Zizhen, the ten-tailed fox is the strongest beast that has ever existed in this Paradise Realm; the strength of Long Wuzhao and the four perils pales in comparison to him, but he suddenly disappeared. However, he left a writing known only to the natural and beast races, which stated that the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is not just a fox, but he is also a human and a demon, and he will bring peace back to this universe."
Mo Taizi looked at his parents in disbelief. "How is it possible for one living creature to have three identities in one body?"

"I don’t have an answer for you on that matter." Mo Shentian replied with a shake of his head. "However, Jia Zizhen said that the vast majority of members of the natural and beast races believe in the writing left behind by the ten-tailed fox, and they have long awaited the emergence of his successor. Unfortunately, that foolish fairy king failed to find him, and he has fallen from his throne now, so we have no other choice but to look for Zhang Fei ourselves."

"Jia Zizhen believes that Zhang Fei is the ten-tailed fox’s successor, and he will become a dangerous threat to our demon race if he succeeds in becoming a ten-tailed fox and inherits the power of his predecessor." Mo Taizi nodded in agreement to Mo Zainan. "Whatever happens, we must find Zhang Fei at all costs, and we must kill him before he becomes too strong."
"I know." Mo Taizi then asked. "Why don’t you two ask my brothers and sisters to look for Zhang Fei too? The more people who look for him, the faster we can find him."

"Naturally, I’ll send them to look for Zhang Fei, and I’ll also send some others to look for him in other domains." Mo Shentian then contacted his other sons, daughters, and some others. "You must leave for that domain now, but you must leave your wife in our domain, or she’ll burden your duties."
"Yes, Father." Mo Taizi immediately walked away, followed by the fake Nalan Wangzi, who smiled faintly as she sent a voice transmission to Nalan Shizhe, informing her of their conversation just now.

Not long after, Mo Zixiao, Mo Tianqi, and several others arrived at the throne room. Mo Shentian and Mo Zainan immediately explained several things to them. "Leave now and find Zhang Fei as quickly as possible no matter what."
"Yes, Father."
"Yes, Demon God."
After they left, Mo Zainan stepped down from her throne. "Husband, I think you should try to see Dong Xuanyin again, and I’ll go look for Zhang Fei myself."
"You can go look for Zhang Fei, and I will think about seeing Dong Xuanyin again." Mo Zainan said nothing and disappeared directly, and Mo Shentian hurriedly went elsewhere.
In the Nine Nethers Demon Domain, Jiu Mozu was also furious after receiving a report about Jia Zizhen’s situation from his subordinate.
Unlike Mo Shentian, who still forgave his subordinate, Jiu Mozu killed Jiu Hui because of his failure, thwarting Zhang Fei’s plan to spy on him.
Even so, Jiu Mozu was still unaware of Jiu Yaoming’s situation, and she was completely loyal to Zhang Fei now.

Jiu Mozu considered saving Jia Zizhen because he still needed the fallen fairy king, but his master forbade him from doing so. Just like Mo Shentian, he ordered someone to investigate the Zhang Clan in the Starfall Martial Domain, and he also sent many of his subordinates to search all domains in the Paradise Realm.

Since she was loyal to Zhang Fei, Jiu Yaoming reported the matter to him through his fifth clone. However, he didn’t respond to her because he was in an unusual situation, forcing her to wait for his order.
"Yaoming, what about Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu? Have they returned to this realm?"

Jiu Yaoming shook her head in response. "Demon God, you ordered me to search for the Ma Clan members with Sheng Yaohun and the others before, so I haven’t been monitoring the situation of the other two demon gods."
"I see." Jiu Mozu nodded in understanding. "Have you still not managed to find members of the Ma Clan’s branch clans?"
"Those people seemed to have disappeared into the earth, and we couldn’t find any trace of them at all."
Jiu Mozu thought for a while. "Send your minions to search for Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu in their domains now."

"Yes." Jiu Yaoming immediately carried out Jiu Mozu’s orders, and she reported to him some time later. "Demon God, I cannot send my minions to their domains because both are currently locked down from the inside. Therefore, Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu should have returned by now, as they are the only two capable of doing so."

’What happened to Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu? Why did they lock the domains down? Where did they go before? Is it possible that they were injured during their previous disappearance?’ Jiu Mozu fell into thought. "Jiu Yuan, lead the others to help them search for Zhang Fei, and you guys must find him as quickly as possible. If you manage to find him, kill him on the spot, or he will become a dangerous threat to us."

"Yes, Demon God." After his nine subordinates left, Jiu Mozu also left his throne to meet his master, where they discussed several things, mostly about Jia Zizhen, Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, and Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui had just arrived in front of the Blood Tree King, Shu Wang. "Is that kid still in there?"
"Yes." Shu Wang answered Shang Luohu. "He’s not alone, and I sensed three other presences there, but I didn’t dare check their locations because of the ten-tailed fox’s soul remnant.
"Three other presences?"

Shu Wang told Shang Luohu directly. "That kid has an unusual ability, and he can bring other people into this domain without our knowledge. Even though my roots can’t reach that place, I can still feel their presence, and all three are clearly women."
Shang Luohu turned to Shang Zhui. "Have you ever heard of a lust demon having such an ability?"
"No." Shang Zhui shook his head in response. "No lust demon has such an ability, Empress."

Shang Luohu suddenly remembered Xie Yao’s explanation of the prophecy left by the ten-tailed fox in the past. "If no lust demon possesses such an ability, I think he gained it from his beast identity, especially since no human techniques can do that."

"I think so." Shang Zhui then turned to leave. "I believe we should avoid talking about Zhang Xiaolong, as my emperor may become increasingly uneasy due to his presence, which could be harmful to him."

"Yeah, you’re right." Shang Luohu followed behind Shang Zhui. "I heard Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu have returned, but their domains are locked from the inside. Do you think their previous disappearances have something to do with Zhang Xiaolong?"

"I guess so." Shang Zhui nodded in reply. "Unfortunately, we haven’t seen Zhang Xiaolong’s abilities firsthand, so we can’t prove the truth yet. As for Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu, they’re probably injured now; otherwise, they wouldn’t have locked their domains from within."

Qi Qingxiu’s answer made Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran smile in amusement, especially because of the blush on her cheeks. She immediately sat in front of them and asked questions. "Is it true that the Fairy King has fallen? Aren’t Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu’s subordinates protecting him?"

"According to Nalan Qinghe, Long Wuzhao made a move against Jia Zizhen, and he revealed several recordings of his meetings with Mo Shentian, Mo Zainan, and Jiu Mozu." Qi Qingxiu looked at Nalan Shizhe in disbelief because she was quite familiar with the character of the dragon emperor. "He didn’t do it himself, but Zhang Fei exposed everything. In fact, he defeated the fairy king, and he also defeated Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu’s subordinates at the same time."
Qi Qingxiu herself didn’t know the details of Zhang Fei’s strength, so she didn’t know whether to believe that he managed to defeat them or not.

Nalan Shizhe spoke to Qi Qingxiu again. "It’s understandable that you doubt Zhang Fei’s ability to defeat them, as you are not yet familiar with him, but that’s the truth. Long Wuzhao acted as a shield to prevent Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu from pursuing him. Even though the two demon gods didn’t know about his involvement in the fall of the fairy king, they started hunting him now."
"Why are they hunting Zhang Fei?" Qi Qingxiu asked in confusion.
Ye Mingran looked at Nalan Shizhe. "I think it’s time to tell Qingxiu the truth about Zhang Fei."
"Truth? What kind of truth?" Qi Qingxiu asked them.
"Watch them for yourself." Nalan Shizhe created a few qi screens, all of which show her meeting with Zhang Fei and the others at the opening of the new Moonlit Passion Temple half a year ago.

Qi Qingxiu was seriously watching those qi screens, but her jaw dropped when she saw Zhang Fei transform into his demon and fox forms. She remained silent and listened to Long Wuzhao and Feng Yao explaining the writings left by the ten-tailed fox regarding him.
After the qi screens disappeared, Qi Qingxiu looked at Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran in shock and disbelief. "What—"

"Are you going to doubt Empress Huo Yanling’s words?" Qi Qingxiu’s lips twitched at Ye Mingran’s question. "Zhang Fei’s ability to shift realms comes from his beast identity, which is the Heavenly Fox Race. That fox race is not an ordinary one, and their two ancestors were born after Hu Tianlang split himself into two."

Nalan Shizhe then spoke to Qi Qingxiu. "All demon races have never known about Hu Tianlang’s existence or the writings he left behind, but the beast and natural races have known everything for a long time, and they have been waiting for the appearance of his successor. Therefore, they sent their subordinates to kill him before he became too powerful, as his existence would pose a threat to them."

"I see." Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "So, what do you two want to do? Do you want to help Zhang Fei fight Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu? Are you going to sacrifice both of your demon races for him?"

"Qingxiu, you still don’t seem to understand the situation." Qi Qingxiu wasn’t a stupid woman, and she was fully aware of the situation, but she felt that Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe were being too reckless if they wanted to help Zhang Fei fight them. "He defeated Jia Zizhen with his cultivation still at the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm; how strong do you think he would be if he reached our level?"
"Zhang Fei will definitely surpass all senior cultivators, including us, at that time."

"That’s right." Ye Mingran nodded and continued. "Not to mention, Long Wuzhao and Empress Huo Yanling are clearly on Zhang Fei’s side, and he has also begun to build his own force, which consists of all races. Do you still think that Shizhe and I will sacrifice our demon races by supporting him?"
Qi Qingxiu didn’t answer that and asked again, "So, you two want me to join Zhang Fei, right?"
"Yes." Both Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe nodded at Qi Qingxiu. "We’ve both joined Zhang Fei, and Wu Mian is the same as us because his real body is in his hands now."

"Moreover, Zhang Fei expressed his interest in you, and you can’t do anything to him anymore." Qi Qingxiu’s face darkened after Ye Mingran mentioned that matter. "If you remain neutral, Mo Shentian and the others will continue to oppress you." If you stand against him, he can capture you anytime he wants by imprisoning your subconscious in the dream; thus, joining him should be your best choice, right?"

Qi Qingxiu was angry every time she remembered that, but she had long realized that she was already under Zhang Fei’s clutches. "Alright, I’ll join him, and I’ll send two of my representatives to his sect."
"Why don’t you send yourself to him directly?"
Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Ye Mingran. "Why don’t you give yourself to him?"
"He’s not interested in me, and he’s only interested in you."
"Humph!" Qi Qingxiu snorted and immediately disappeared without saying goodbye to them.

Ye Mingran also rose from her seat. "Qingxiu and I can’t possibly evade them for long using our barrier, so I’ll return to my domain now. You can inform me immediately if there are any changes in the situation with Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu."
"Alright." After Ye Mingran left, Nalan Shizhe hurriedly returned to her room and sealed it to cultivate.

Just like Jia Xianzu, Beiming Youhuang also rejected their request because she already had another life, and she was completely satisfied with it.

In the end, the Fairy Race decided to appoint Jia Leixuan as their new king, and they immediately began preparing for his coronation. Since they lost so many powerful members in one day, Long Wuzhao immediately announced that the Fairy Race was under his protection for the time being, and he would punish anyone who attacked them while they were recovering.
After everything was settled, Long Wuzhao and the two dragons left the Floral Mirage Domain and returned to their own domain.

As the chosen king, Jia Leixuan immediately discussed with Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, and he agreed with their idea of bringing their race to join Zhang Fei. Once you recover, I will definitely be ready, and we will do it again after that, okay?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1334 1334: Qi Qingxiu's Visit
paragraphs: Qi Qingxiu arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, bringing two young demons with her.

Since Qi Qingxiu had already visited the sect twice, Serpentera and Tian Kui didn't stop her from entering. Despite this, the two ancient beasts continued to monitor her, especially in Zhang Fei's absence.

Even though she had come to the Moonlit Passion Temple before, Qi Qingxiu had never paid attention to those areas of the sect, and she only focused on Zhang Fei because those people were insignificant in her eyes. However, her opinion changed after Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe told her some things about him, especially his identity as the successor of the ten-tailed fox.

Qi Qingxiu looked around the areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the existence of four different races there really surprised her because their numbers were numerous, except for the winged race, which only had three representatives there.

Qi Qingxiu furrowed her brows when she detected the presence of Liao Hanxue, Liao Shengye, Bai Yueqin, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, You Ran, Tan Yuxin, Qiao Yisheng, and Tang Qingyan in different areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple.

'That brat has started building relationships with people from other domains, huh?' Qi Qingxiu frowned deeper when she saw Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang in the distance. 'Since that brat managed to take down Jia Zizhen, it's no surprise that the Fairy Race is willing to join him. Moreover, those two were no ordinary members, and they were former candidates to succeed the Fairy King in the past.'
You Feiling immediately appeared in front of Qi Qingxiu, accompanied by her direct disciple, Su Yao. "What brings you to our sect today, Demon God Qingxiu?"
"Where is Zhang Fei now? Why can't I find him anywhere?"

"Elder Zhang and my big sister entered seclusion again, and I don't know when they will come out." You Feiling's answer surprised Qi Qingxiu because Zhang Fei had previously caused chaos in the Fairy Race, but he had already entered seclusion again. "Have you decided to join us, Demon God Qingxiu?"

Qi Qingxiu nodded slightly and asked the two demons behind her to come forward. "Qi Zhihui and Qi Qingya are two of the best among the younger generation of my demon clan, and I brought them to this sect to join you."
"I see." You Feiling turned to Su Yao. "Yao'er, take them to Elder Chen Yuefeng, and you can bring them to the demon race's abode after they obtain their sect credentials."
"Yes, Big Sis." Su Yao immediately followed You Feiling's orders, taking Qi Zhihui and Qi Qingya to the mountain, where the registration hall was located.
"Do you want to stay in our sect for a while, Demon God Qingxiu?"
Qi Qingxiu thought about You Feiling's offer for a moment before agreeing. "I have no business in my domain for now, so I will stay in this sect for a while. Are there any interesting places here?"

"The Celestial Yin Lake is over there." Qi Qingxiu looked toward the back of the mountain that You Feiling pointed out. "The main advantage of this sect is that lake, where the concentration of Yin Qi is extremely high, especially during the night."
Qi Qingxiu swiftly directed her senses there, and her expression changed to surprise after she sensed Yin Qi's concentration there. "Please bring me there."
"Please follow me."

Soon, they arrived at the Celestial Yin Lake, where dozens of women were cultivating naked inside. Qi Qingxiu looked at the dense fog-covered barrier not far from their location, and she tried to peek inside but to no avail, which surprised her. "Why is there a barrier there? Who created that barrier?"

"Elder Zhang and one of his wives created the barrier to enclose and protect their private residence within." Qi Qingxiu returned her gaze to You Feiling. "Both of them are rank 10 array masters, and their families always live there when they are in the sect. However, the residence is empty now because they are in seclusion except for Duanmu Luolan, who is studying formation arrays with Liao Hanxue in more depth."

Qi Qingxiu knew that Zhang Fei was an array master because he snatched the Heavenly Jade Brush from her during the auction in the Forbidden Land, but she didn't expect that he had already reached rank 10. "Where is Duanmu Luolan now?"
"Duanmu Luolan should be in the Array Hall in the area in front of the mountain."
"In that case, I will go to the Array Hall now."
"Are you not interested in cultivating in this lake, Demon God Qingxiu?"
"Formation arrays are more interesting to me than this lake, especially with my current cultivation."

You Feiling could only shake her head as she watched Qi Qingxiu fly away, leaving the Celestial Yin Lake. "A demon god like her is indeed different, and her cultivation has reached the peak stage of the Five Celestial Realms."
You Feiling did not follow Qi Qingxiu; Instead, she took off her dress and joined the others, cultivating within the Celestial Yin Lake.
Liao Hanxue was shocked by Qi Qingxiu's sudden appearance, but Duanmu Luolan immediately calmed her down by speaking to her through voice transmission.
Duanmu Luolan then asked Qi Qingxiu. "Did you come here to look for my husband?"

"No." Qi Qingxiu immediately approached them. "I heard you two discussing formation arrays, and I'm an array master myself, so I decided to come here to take a look. So, what kind of formation are you two discussing?"

"A teleportation formation." Qi Qingxiu looked at Duanmu Luolan in confusion. "Indeed, we can use a teleportation device for that, but creating one is too expensive and takes time. Therefore, we want to create a teleportation formation to be used in various areas within a single domain, so we don't waste time flying back and forth. We aim to interconnect each formation, enabling us to select our destination without switching between them."

Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "Normally, other people wouldn't think of such an idea, including me. After all, the cultivation world is too dangerous, and there are many foxes in sheep's clothing in it. If we create such teleportation formation arrays, others will be able to find us easily, which will only be detrimental to us."
"I agree with you, Demon God Qingxiu." Liao Hanxue spoke, nodding her head. "Actually, we wanted to create it specifically for this domain, at least for now."
"Why is that?"

"The answer lies in the changes in this sect." Qi Qingxiu seemed confused by that, prompting Duanmu Luolan to explain to her. "As you have seen in this sect, my husband wants to transform this domain into an ideal place where all races live together side by side in harmony, and—"

"Isn't Zhang Fei's ambition too high?" Qi Qingxiu interrupted Duanmu Luolan. "He did manage to gather all the races in this sect, and they seem to have accepted each other's presence well. However, you two must remember that their numbers are too small when compared to the population of this realm, and you cannot ignore the enmity between all the races that has existed for millions of years. If you gather them in large numbers in one domain, I'm sure the situation will not be as peaceful as it is in this sect, and new problems will surely arise among them. If that occurs, chaos will ensue in this domain, and the native inhabitants will suffer due to their presence."

Duanmu Luolan nodded in agreement with Qi Qingxiu. "Naturally, we've already considered the possibility of such a situation occurring, and my husband wouldn't be so crazy as to immediately relocate a large number of people from all four races into this domain. He will select people from the four races who are truly worthy of moving to this domain, and he will relocate them gradually, starting on a small scale. He will bring several new groups of people here once they can accept each other like those who live in this sect, so they can adapt more quickly with the help of the previous groups."

"Still, I think Zhang Fei's idea is too crazy." Qi Qingxiu said this with a headshake. "In my opinion, it would be much better if he conquered all of those domains and appointed several people to lead each one afterward."
Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue were momentarily stunned before exchanging strange glances, especially since Qi Qingxiu's idea was much more ambitious than Zhang Fei's.

Liao Hanxue directly spoke to Qi Qingxiu. "Demon God Qingxiu, isn't your idea too absurd? There are a hundred domains in this Paradise Realm, and many powerful old cultivators inhabit each domain. Do you think those people will be willing to submit to Zhang Fei? Many of them have indeed decided to join him, like you. However, there are still countless powerful cultivators out there, and they will definitely give him a fierce fight if he wants to conquer their domains."

"I'm not saying that Zhang Fei has to do it right now, okay?" Qi Qingxiu responded with a shake of her head. "You may not be aware that he has already overthrown the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen, from his throne. Therefore—"
"What?" Liao Hanxue exclaimed in shock before looking at Duanmu Luolan. "Is that true? Has Zhang Fei really succeeded in topping the Fairy King?"

"Hehe." Duanmu Luolan giggled. "Didn't you already know about my husband's actions against the Fei Clan? So, you shouldn't be surprised to hear that he succeeded in overthrowing the Fairy King, right?"

"As you have seen in this sect, my husband wants to transform this domain into an ideal place where all races live together side by side in harmony, and—"
"Isn't Zhang Fei's ambition too high?" Qi Qingxiu interrupted Duanmu Luolan.
"He did manage to gather all the races in this sect, and they seem to have accepted each other's presence well.

However, you two must remember that their numbers are too small when compared to the population of this realm, and you cannot ignore the enmity between all the races that has existed for millions of years.
If you gather them in large numbers in one domain, I'm sure the situation will not be as peaceful as it is in this sect, and new problems will surely arise among them.
If that occurs, chaos will ensue in this domain, and the native inhabitants will suffer due to their presence."
Duanmu Luolan nodded in agreement with Qi Qingxiu.

"Naturally, we've already considered the possibility of such a situation occurring, and my husband wouldn't be so crazy as to immediately relocate a large number of people from all four races into this domain.
He will select people from the four races who are truly worthy of moving to this domain, and he will relocate them gradually, starting on a small scale.
He will bring several new groups of people here once they can accept each other like those who live in this sect, so they can adapt more quickly with the help of the previous groups."
"Still, I think Zhang Fei's idea is too crazy." Qi Qingxiu said this with a headshake.
"In my opinion, it would be much better if he conquered all of those domains and appointed several people to lead each one afterward."
Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue were momentarily stunned before exchanging strange glances, especially since Qi Qingxiu's idea was much more ambitious than Zhang Fei's.
Liao Hanxue directly spoke to Qi Qingxiu.
"Demon God Qingxiu, isn't your idea too absurd?
There are a hundred domains in this Paradise Realm, and many powerful old cultivators inhabit each domain.
Do you think those people will be willing to submit to Zhang Fei?
Many of them have indeed decided to join him, like you.
However, there are still countless powerful cultivators out there, and they will definitely give him a fierce fight if he wants to conquer their domains."
"I'm not saying that Zhang Fei has to do it right now, okay?" Qi Qingxiu responded with a shake of her head.
"You may not be aware that he has already overthrown the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen, from his throne.
Therefore—"
"What?" Liao Hanxue exclaimed in shock before looking at Duanmu Luolan.
"Is that true?
Has Zhang Fei really succeeded in topping the Fairy King?"
"Hehe." Duanmu Luolan giggled.
"Didn't you already know about my husband's actions against the Fei Clan?
So, you shouldn't be surprised to hear that he succeeded in overthrowing the Fairy King, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1335 1335: Qi Qingxiu's Ideas
paragraphs: Liao Hanxue nodded in response. "The Fei Clan is stronger than my Liao Clan, but Zhang Fei managed to suppress them to that extent."

"That's why I think it would be better if Zhang Fei subdued those domains one by one, rather than him destroying the order in this domain." Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan redirected their gazes to Qi Qingxiu. "This domain is considered the weakest among all domains in the Paradise Realm because other cultivators always look down on dual cultivators, and they don't know any interesting places in this domain, except for the Endless Night Dungeon and the Zenith Solar Sanctum. Even if there are cultivators trying to invade this domain, I'm sure there won't be many of them, and most of them will be ordinary cultivators without high status. This way, this domain will remain safe, and you guys can do other things to strengthen it, just like what I've done in my domain."
"What have you done with your domain?" Both Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue asked curiously.
"See everything for yourselves." Qi Qingxiu created several qi screens showing the situation in her domain.

For quite some time, Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue watched the entire area of the Seven Emotions Demon Domain that appeared on those qi screens until Qi Qingxiu removed them. "You have installed so many formations in your domain, and most of them are illusion formations."

"Yes." Qi Qingxiu gave them a light nod. "Not all cultivators can overcome the illusion formations, let alone peak-grade ones. Therefore, I installed quite a lot of illusion formations in my domain, and each formation has a different effect. I also installed many attack and defense formations, both land and air, just in case they managed to escape those illusions."
Duanmu Luolan nodded in understanding. "It's useless if we set up multiple illusion formations with the same effect, and the intruders can easily pass through the others once they pass through one."
"That's right."
"What kind of defensive and offensive formations have you installed in your domain, Demon God Qingxiu?" Liao Hanxue asked.

Qi Qingxiu took out several formation papers and handed them to both women. "My Dark Lightning Formation covers half of my domain, and it will activate once my enemy enters the area of that formation. Additionally, I also set up several attack formations in several areas, and those formations will use different attacks on my enemies."
"What about your defensive formations?" Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue asked this while reading those formation papers seriously.

"My first defensive formation covers my entire domain, but I only activate it in certain situations." Qi Qingxiu pointed to one of the formation papers before pointing at another. "The second formation is spread across several areas of my domain, especially important areas such as rice fields and others. The third formation is specifically for protecting my main city and palace, but it is not an ordinary defensive formation, and I mixed it with illusion and offensive formations."
After she and Liao Hanxue had read them and returned them to Qi Qingxiu, Duanmu Luolan immediately asked her, "What kind of formations do you think are most suitable for this domain?"

"I haven't inspected the areas of this domain, so I can't give my opinion yet." Qi Qingxiu thought for a minute before continuing. "I remember there are hundreds of dual cultivation sects in this domain, and each of them must have their own formations. If you want to install additional formations for this domain, I suggest you check theirs first. However, you don't need to give those first-grade to third-grade sects much thought, especially since their formations are not that strong. On the other hand, those supreme-grade sects should have excellent formations, so you must be able to integrate your new formations with theirs. Additionally, I see that there are hundreds of dryads in this sect; I think you could ask them to build natural defenses using their abilities."

"Actually, they have helped us do that, but it is still limited to this sect." Duanmu Luolan led Liao Hanxue and Qi Qingxiu out of the hall. "If you two look closely, many of the trees in this sect are their creations. They look ordinary because they are mingled with those ordinary trees, but many of them serve as our defense mechanisms."
"This sect is fortunate that Zhang Fei chose it as his base."

"Haha." Duanmu Luolan laughed at Liao Hanxue's words. "You're wrong about that, Senior Hanxue. My husband didn't choose this sect personally, but Qing Qiu'er chose him as her dual cultivation partner when he was still living in the Middle Realms."
"Oh?" Liao Hanxue and Qi Qingxiu were surprised to hear that.

Duanmu Luolan smiled at their expressions. "It happened several years ago, and my husband's cultivation was still at the Earth Realm when he first challenged the Star Tower. Qing Qiu'er sent her avatar to the tower, and she chose him after witnessing some of his actions. They met for the first time after he brought us to this realm, in the Forbidden Land to be exact."
"Tch!" Qi Qingxiu suddenly clenched her teeth. "You shouldn't have mentioned the Forbidden Land in front of me, especially since it made me angry."
"Hahaha." Duanmu Luolan laughed because she knew what had made Qi Qingxiu angry, and she took out the Heavenly Jade Brush. "This thing, right?"

Qi Qingxiu's expression turned furious after she saw the brush. "You are deliberately provoking me by taking out this damn brush! If it weren't for that scoundrel husband of yours, I would definitely use my abilities on you!"
"I had no such intentions." Duanmu Luolan rebutted Qi Qingxiu with a headshake. "If you like, you can use this brush to create your formations here, and I think my husband won't mind if you use it."
"No need." Qi Qingxiu then asked them. "So, what do you guys want to do now?"

Duanmu Luolan stored the brush in her storage ring again before answering Qi Qingxiu. "I plan to go to the Liao Clan in the Sky Pillar Domain to get some materials there so we can create the formations we've been planning."

"You two can go, and I'll look around the other areas of this sect." After Duanmuo Luolan and Liao Hanxue left, Qi Qingxiu immediately flew to one of the areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple, where several demons were gathered.
Qi Qingxiu's arrival shocked the demons, especially those Zhang Fei had brought from the Three Mortal Realms.

"A witch demon and a celestial demon?" Qi Qingxiu was surprised after she saw Morgana and Oz the First. "How did you two end up in this sect? Moreover, it's incredibly strange for a witch demon and a celestial demon to get married."
"What do you mean by that, Senior?" Morgana asked Qi Qingxiu in confusion.
"Do you really not know anything?"

Morgana shook her head at Qi Qingxiu. "My husband and I came from the Three Mortal Realms, and I'm the only witch demon there, so I don't know anything about the situation of the witch demon race in this realm."
"I see." Qi Qingxiu observed Oz the First for a moment. "You don't remember your true identity, huh?"
Oz the First stared at Qi Qingxiu in confusion. "What do you mean by that, Senior?"

"Let me show you." Qi Qingxiu pressed her palm against Oz the First's chest, pulling the black shadow out of his body, shocking him and Morgana. "This black shadow is your true identity, but someone deliberately sealed it. I don't know that person's reasons for sealing it, but your true identity seems unusual because I can sense an aura similar to Mo Shentian's from it. If my guess is correct, you should have a relationship with him, but someone deliberately got rid of you and sent you to the Three Mortal Realms."

"Mo Shentian? Isn't he the demon god of the Celestial Demon Race, Senior?" Qi Qingxiu nodded to Morgana. "Since he and my husband came from the same demon race, it should be natural that they share the same aura, right?"

"Yes and no." Qi Qingxiu's answer confused Oz the First and Morgana. "The Celestial Demon Race is different from the other demon races, and only the same descendants have similar auras. Since your husband's demon aura is similar to Mo Shentian's, I'm sure they are related to each other. However, I don't know how close the relationship between them is, and you have to open this seal to be sure."
"Husband."

"No." Oz the First rejected Morgana directly. "Wife, I also want to know my true identity, but if this senior's words are true that I have a relationship with Mo Shentian, he might notice my presence if I open this seal, and it will bring trouble to this sect. Moreover, Zhang Fei is in seclusion now, so we should wait for his return and discuss this matter with him first."

"Alright, we'll wait for Zhang Fei to come out of his seclusion first, and we will immediately discuss this matter with him." Morgana looked at Qi Qingxiu again. "Senior, what do you mean by it being strange for a witch demon and a celestial demon to get married?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1336: Qi Qingxiu - Morgana - Oz
paragraphs: "The witch demon race and the celestial demon race are mortal enemies." Qi Qingxiu’s answer shocked Oz the First and Morgana. "The number of the witch demon race in the realm was once large, but the ancestors of the celestial demon race slaughtered most of them. Not to mention, their birth rate is very low, and they have the shortest lifespan of all demon races, causing their numbers to continue to decline every year. I don’t know their exact number, but I estimate that there are no more than a hundred of them."
"That small?"

"Yes." Qi Qingxiu nodded at Morgana. "That’s why I was surprised to see you two married, but it turns out you don’t know anything about the history between the two demon races. By the way, you should not leave this sect as long as your cultivation is still at this level; otherwise, you will die."
Morgana took a deep breath and firmly nodded. "Are you the location of one of them?"

"If I recall correctly, Wu Zu lives in the Nightshade Domain, and she is the strongest among the witch demons." Morgana looked delighted to hear that, but Qi Qingxiu immediately warned her. "Forget your desire to meet her because she will never be willing to meet you or help you."
"Why?"

Qi Qingxiu sighed softly, feeling that Morgana was too clueless. "Wu Zu was born during the era of the witch race’s downfall, and she had no one to rely on. She struggled herself to stay alive because the celestial demon race kept hunting down her remaining race, and she had to live in hiding to avoid being hunted by them. Worse yet, some of her kin betrayed her because of their jealousy of her talent, which almost led to her death. Since then, she has never trusted anyone, including her race members. She distanced herself from them and cut off all contact with them, so there’s no point in you seeing her."
"I see." Morgana nodded in understanding. "Do you know the other witch demons?"

"I’m not sure where they live now." Qi Qingxiu thought about it for a while before continuing. "If my guess is correct, they’re probably living in the Endless Domain now, especially since that domain is the safest for non-demon fighters like them. In fact, there are many demon races living in that domain, including the lust demon race."
"The lust demon race can be categorized as fighting demons, but why did they choose to live in that domain?"

Qi Qingxiu shook her head slightly. "Actually, Xie Yao and Xie Yan are quite powerful, and their abilities are truly troublesome, even for me. Moreover, they are demon gods of their race, so I don’t know their reasons for choosing to stay in the Endless Domain. Instead of going to see Wu Zu, you can ask Zhang Fei to help you go to that domain and look for the other witch demons, but you should never trust them because they aren’t trustworthy, and they only care about their benefits."
"I understand."
Qi Qingxiu then looked at another demon. "An abyssal rift demon, huh? How did she get here?"

"Her name is Ju Yingzhi, and Zhang Fei met her in the Nine Stars Realm years ago. Back then, she was seriously injured due to an enemy attack, and he offered her to become his subordinate in exchange for healing her." Qi Qingxiu then pointed to several other female demons, prompting Morgana to explain. "Xin Yanluo is Ju Yingzhi’s servant, and she follows her master’s decisions. The woman in thin clothes is Qian Ying, and she used to be an ordinary human, but a demon kidnapped her and transformed her into a demon. The woman next to her was Ximen Yueliang, the former princess of the Ximen Demon Kingdom in the Nine Stars Realm."
"Zhang Fei still had many other demons under his command, but he left them in the Three Mortal Realms because they were ordinary demons." Oz the First added.

Among the four female demons, the Seven Emotions Demon God was only interested in Ju Yingzhi, primarily because of her abilities as an abyssal rift demon. Unfortunately, she was still too young and too weak, but her presence gave Qi Qingxiu some ideas. "How many female demons are on Zhang Fei’s side now?"
"Around 38."
"Tch! What a lustful demon!" Qi Qingxiu cursed irritably, especially since Zhang Fei had repeatedly taken her into dreams and done indecent things to her.
"Haha." Morgana chuckled at that. "Senior, Zhang Fei is a lust demon monarch, so it is natural that he is too lustful, and he became even more lustful after inheriting Hu Tianlang’s lustful soul."
Qi Qingxiu simply nodded and spoke to Oz the First again. "I don’t know if you’ve found the key to the seal, but you shouldn’t be afraid to open it."

"We already have the key, Senior," Qi Qingxiu responded to Oz the First with a raised eyebrow. "Honestly, I feel an incredible closeness to the black shadow, but I’ve always been afraid to open the seal. I don’t remember anything about it, and I’m afraid it will turn me into another person."

"The black shadow won’t affect your character because it’s a part of you, and whatever memories it holds will be yours. Once Zhang Fei comes out of his seclusion, you should discuss this matter with him because it will bring you many benefits." Oz the First himself had long wanted to open the seal, but many other things prevented him from doing so. "If you’re afraid of bringing disaster to him and this sect, you can open the seal in my domain. However, I’m sure that you have a connection with Mo Shentian, either directly or indirectly. If that’s true, you won’t be able to return to this sect again because that bastard will definitely find you here, so you and your wife will have to find another place to live."
After hearing all that, Oz the First felt even more conflicted, and Morgana asked Qi Qingxiu. "Do you know any suitable places for us, Senior?"

"Yes." Qi Qingxiu immediately told them. "Your first choice is the Endless Domain, where you will be safe, particularly due to the presence of endless illusions. However, some demon races in that area dislike the celestial demon race, particularly the witch race. Your second choice is the Wailing Soul Forest, and I think you won’t have any problems staying there since Zhang Fei is Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law. Additionally, you can use the wandering evil souls there to strengthen yourselves."

Morgan looked directly at her husband. "Zhang Fei once took us to the Wailing Soul Forest to absorb those phantom soul lotuses, so I think that place is our best choice rather than us going to the Endless Domain."
"We’ll stay in that forest if we can’t return to this sect." Oz the First looked and spoke to Qi Qingxiu. "Thank you for all your information, Senior."
"Don’t mind it." Qi Qingxiu turned to leave. "I will go to the Celestial Yin Lake and wait there until Zhang Fei returns, and you can find me there if you have any other questions for me."
Morgana smiled as she watched Qi Qingxiu leave. "It seems she’s already starting to fall for Zhang Fei, and she might fall for him completely soon."
"Yeah."

After taking a large amount of materials from the Liao Clan, Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple. They hurriedly set up the formations they had prepared in advance in several areas of the sect, which had a significant impact on the residents.

Since they had stayed at the Moonlit Passion Temple for two days and witnessed many things in the sect firsthand, Qiao Yisheng decided to take his wife back to the Qiao Clan in the Sky Pillar Domain to discuss everything with their clan members.
Upon arriving at their domain, Qiao Yisheng asked his wife, Tang Qingyan, to return to her Tang Clan and persuade them to join Zhang Fei.

You Ran and Tan Yunxi also decided to return to the You Clan. Since they had already decided to join Zhang Fei, they selected two members of their clan to become their liaison with the Moonlit Passion Sect. However, they were surprised by You Feng’s decision to go to the sect, and he did it for the sake of his son, You Shiyan.
You Ran and Tan Yunxi did not stop You Feng from going to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and they asked him to bring their two clan members to the sect.

Meanwhile, Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin decided to stay at the Moonlit Passion Sect, as they still had many things to discuss with Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji in building the one-way teleportation portal that Zhang Fei wanted.
News of the You, Qiao, and Liao Clans joining the Moonlit Passion Sect reached the ears of the people from the Fei and Zhi Clans.

Fei Tianluo was eager to join the Moonlit Passion Sect, but Fei Lianhe and Mu Hanyan opposed his decision because of their conflict with Zhang Fei two days ago, which resulted in a deleterious outcome for their eldest son.

From the Zhi Clan, Zhi Yongbo decided to go alone to the Moonlit Passion Sect, but Serpentera and Tian Kui did not allow him to enter the sect according to Zhang Fei’s orders. They asked him to wait for their master to come out of his seclusion, forcing him to return in disappointment.
