Instead of going to see Wu Zu, you can ask Zhang Fei to help you go to that domain and look for the other witch demons, but you should never trust them because they aren’t trustworthy, and they only care about their benefits."
"I understand."
Qi Qingxiu then looked at another demon.
"An abyssal rift demon, huh?
How did she get here?"
"Her name is Ju Yingzhi, and Zhang Fei met her in the Nine Stars Realm years ago.

Back then, she was seriously injured due to an enemy attack, and he offered her to become his subordinate in exchange for healing her." Qi Qingxiu then pointed to several other female demons, prompting Morgana to explain.
"Xin Yanluo is Ju Yingzhi’s servant, and she follows her master’s decisions.
The woman in thin clothes is Qian Ying, and she used to be an ordinary human, but a demon kidnapped her and transformed her into a demon.
The woman next to her was Ximen Yueliang, the former princess of the Ximen Demon Kingdom in the Nine Stars Realm."
"Zhang Fei still had many other demons under his command, but he left them in the Three Mortal Realms because they were ordinary demons." Oz the First added.
Among the four female demons, the Seven Emotions Demon God was only interested in Ju Yingzhi, primarily because of her abilities as an abyssal rift demon.
Unfortunately, she was still too young and too weak, but her presence gave Qi Qingxiu some ideas.
"How many female demons are on Zhang Fei’s side now?"
"Around 38."
"Tch!
What a lustful demon!" Qi Qingxiu cursed irritably, especially since Zhang Fei had repeatedly taken her into dreams and done indecent things to her.
"Haha." Morgana chuckled at that.
"Senior, Zhang Fei is a lust demon monarch, so it is natural that he is too lustful, and he became even more lustful after inheriting Hu Tianlang’s lustful soul."
Qi Qingxiu simply nodded and spoke to Oz the First again.
"I don’t know if you’ve found the key to the seal, but you shouldn’t be afraid to open it."
"We already have the key, Senior," Qi Qingxiu responded to Oz the First with a raised eyebrow.
"Honestly, I feel an incredible closeness to the black shadow, but I’ve always been afraid to open the seal.
I don’t remember anything about it, and I’m afraid it will turn me into another person."
"The black shadow won’t affect your character because it’s a part of you, and whatever memories it holds will be yours.

Once Zhang Fei comes out of his seclusion, you should discuss this matter with him because it will bring you many benefits." Oz the First himself had long wanted to open the seal, but many other things prevented him from doing so.
"If you’re afraid of bringing disaster to him and this sect, you can open the seal in my domain.
However, I’m sure that you have a connection with Mo Shentian, either directly or indirectly.
If that’s true, you won’t be able to return to this sect again because that bastard will definitely find you here, so you and your wife will have to find another place to live."
After hearing all that, Oz the First felt even more conflicted, and Morgana asked Qi Qingxiu.
"Do you know any suitable places for us, Senior?"
"Yes." Qi Qingxiu immediately told them.
"Your first choice is the Endless Domain, where you will be safe, particularly due to the presence of endless illusions.
However, some demon races in that area dislike the celestial demon race, particularly the witch race.
Your second choice is the Wailing Soul Forest, and I think you won’t have any problems staying there since Zhang Fei is Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law.
Additionally, you can use the wandering evil souls there to strengthen yourselves."
Morgan looked directly at her husband.
"Zhang Fei once took us to the Wailing Soul Forest to absorb those phantom soul lotuses, so I think that place is our best choice rather than us going to the Endless Domain."
"We’ll stay in that forest if we can’t return to this sect." Oz the First looked and spoke to Qi Qingxiu.
"Thank you for all your information, Senior."
"Don’t mind it." Qi Qingxiu turned to leave.
"I will go to the Celestial Yin Lake and wait there until Zhang Fei returns, and you can find me there if you have any other questions for me."
Morgana smiled as she watched Qi Qingxiu leave.
"It seems she’s already starting to fall for Zhang Fei, and she might fall for him completely soon."
"Yeah."
After taking a large amount of materials from the Liao Clan, Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
They hurriedly set up the formations they had prepared in advance in several areas of the sect, which had a significant impact on the residents.

Since they had stayed at the Moonlit Passion Temple for two days and witnessed many things in the sect firsthand, Qiao Yisheng decided to take his wife back to the Qiao Clan in the Sky Pillar Domain to discuss everything with their clan members.
Upon arriving at their domain, Qiao Yisheng asked his wife, Tang Qingyan, to return to her Tang Clan and persuade them to join Zhang Fei.
You Ran and Tan Yunxi also decided to return to the You Clan.
Since they had already decided to join Zhang Fei, they selected two members of their clan to become their liaison with the Moonlit Passion Sect.
However, they were surprised by You Feng’s decision to go to the sect, and he did it for the sake of his son, You Shiyan.
You Ran and Tan Yunxi did not stop You Feng from going to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and they asked him to bring their two clan members to the sect.

Meanwhile, Liao Shengye and Bai Yueqin decided to stay at the Moonlit Passion Sect, as they still had many things to discuss with Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji in building the one-way teleportation portal that Zhang Fei wanted.
News of the You, Qiao, and Liao Clans joining the Moonlit Passion Sect reached the ears of the people from the Fei and Zhi Clans.

Fei Tianluo was eager to join the Moonlit Passion Sect, but Fei Lianhe and Mu Hanyan opposed his decision because of their conflict with Zhang Fei two days ago, which resulted in a deleterious outcome for their eldest son.
From the Zhi Clan, Zhi Yongbo decided to go alone to the Moonlit Passion Sect, but Serpentera and Tian Kui did not allow him to enter the sect according to Zhang Fei’s orders.
They asked him to wait for their master to come out of his seclusion, forcing him to return in disappointment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1337: Zhang Clan (Starfall Martial Domain)
paragraphs: "Yao’er." Feng Yao, who was standing on the balcony of her palace, turned to Feng Jiu. "Did you think of something?"
Feng Yao nodded slightly. "The Celestial Demon God and the Nine Nether Demon God have already begun to hunt down Zhang Fei."
"Huh?" Feng Jiu was shocked. "Why are they hunting my son-in-law? How do they know about him?"

"Zhang Fei has overthrown the Fairy King, and two demon gods learned about him from the fallen fairy king because he was in cahoots with them in the past." Feng Yao took a device like the one she gave Long Wuzhao and activated it, showing Feng Jiu the events of the Fairy Race in the past. "After my announcement half a year ago, they didn’t dare to come to the Moonlit Passion Temple. They thought that he joined the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain, and they sent spies to that clan to look for him. They will be safe for now, but that safety won’t last forever, and some of them might ignore my warning and disturb the sect soon."
"Will my son-in-law be okay? Will he be able to face them?"

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at Feng Jiu’s reaction. "Zhang Fei will be fine, but it’s not yet time for him to face those demon gods, especially Mo Shentian. Jiu Mozu isn’t that strong, but he must separate him from his nine subordinates first; otherwise, he will never be able to defeat him. Not to mention, he still has to face the other demon gods, such as Shang Zhanluo, Ku Shenzu, and Sha Mo."
"What about the other demon gods, Yao’er?"

"Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Wu Mian are already on Zhang Fei’s side." Feng Jiu had already met the first two demon gods, so she wasn’t surprised to hear that. However, she was surprised to hear that the last two demon gods had joined Zhang Fei. Feng Yao looked far away again before continuing. "The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, Qian Yan, is still passive to this day, so I don’t know his decision yet."
"Is the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God strong, Yao’er?"

Feng Yao nodded at her mother. "The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God is the only demon beast among the ten demon gods. Although he is not as strong as Mo Shentian and the others, he has extraordinary eye abilities, especially his middle eye, which can penetrate space, including the void. If Zhang Fei opens his private spaces in front of him, he will never be able to hide from him anymore, and Qian Yan can hunt him down whenever he wants."

"Such a terrifying ability!" Feng Jiu then questioned her daughter. "How exactly did you manage to know all their movements and plans so easily, Yao’er? Did you leave something behind in their domains in the past? You never left this palace, yet you were able to know everything that happened in this Paradise Realm."

"I never leave anything in their domains." Feng Jiu was puzzled by Feng Yao’s answer, but a woman suddenly appeared beside them. "She was a part of my past self, and I saw and heard everything through her."
Feng Jiu observed the woman up and down. "Does she not have consciousness?"
"She is me, and I am her, so my consciousness is her consciousness."
Feng Jiu looked at Feng Yao again. "Has my son-in-law ever met this woman before?"
"Zhang Fei has met her several times, but he didn’t notice anything." After the woman disappeared, Feng Yao spoke to Feng Jiu again. "Don’t mention anything about her to him, mother."
Feng Jiu inwardly sighed. "How many secrets are you really hiding from us, Yao’er? When are you going to tell us all?"

"I don’t need to tell you anything, and you’ll learn everything once Zhang Fei evolves into the ten-tailed fox." After that, Feng Yao contacted one of her subordinates and ordered her to go to the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain. "Mother, you must go back and cultivate again, or he will leave you far behind."

"No matter how diligently I cultivate, my son-in-law will still leave me far behind, right?" Feng Jiu spoke with a bitter smile, but she immediately turned to leave, leaving Feng Yao alone on the balcony. ’Yao’er, I don’t know what your true purpose is for doing all this, and I realize that your father and I are not as strong as you, but I hope you will be willing to be honest with us about everything.’
A while later, Feng Yao disappeared from the balcony, but no one knew her thoughts and destination.
Meanwhile, a young woman walked into a clan, and everyone who saw her attire hurriedly moved away from her, especially since she was a member of the Blazing Nirvana Domain.

When the young man arrived at the front of the clan’s main hall, the expressions of those gathered there turned to shock, and an old man sitting at the head immediately came down to greet him. "What brings you to my Zhang Clan, Young Lady?"

"Ancestor Zhang Zetian, my name is Huo Xiaoyu, and I come on my empress’s orders." The old man and the people there held their breath upon hearing that, but Huo Xiaoyu immediately handed him something. "My empress asked me to inform you that the Celestial Demon Race and the Nine Nether Demon Race are monitoring your clan, but she didn’t explain their purpose to you. She asked me to hand this item to you, and you can use it if people from either demon race try to invade your clan."

Zhang Zetian received the item while looking at Huo Xiaoyu in confusion because his clan had never had any problems with the two demon races in the past, but they were suddenly monitoring his clan. "What actually happened, Young Miss Xiaoyu?"

"I don’t know." Huo Xiaoyu paused for a moment and listened to the incoming voice transmission. "My empress just contacted me, and she asked me to inform you that someone will be coming to you in the near future. You just need to wait for that person to come, and you will get the answers to your questions at that time."

"Who is the person you are referring to?" Huo Xiaoyu just shook her head and hurriedly left the place, confusing Zhang Zetian and his clan members. "What actually happened? Could that person have something to do with the actions of the two demon races?"
"Father." A middle-aged man approached Zhang Zetian. "What should we do now?"

"What else?" Zhang Zetian turned to the middle-aged man. "Yuzhen, alert our clan members and ask them to increase security inside and outside our clan. Additionally, activate our barrier now; we must prevent those demons from entering our clan."
"Yes, Father."
In a few minutes, the situation in the Zhang Clan became quite chaotic, and all of their members wondered about the sudden change in the situation within their clan.

Zhang Zetian jumped to the tallest building in his clan, observing the area around the Zhang Clan to look for the whereabouts of the two demon races. He looked at the item that Huo Xiaoyu gave him as he wondered about its function, but he believed that Feng Yao would not possibly give him a useless item. "Who is that person’s identity? Why are the two demon races looking for that person in my clan?"
In two different areas, Mo Taizi and Jiu Yuan, who had just arrived at the city where the Zhang Clan resided, were shocked by the sudden appearance of the barrier that enveloped the clan.
The sudden appearance of the barrier left Mo Taizi and Jiu Yuan wondering about the Zhang Clan’s decision to activate it, and they informed Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu about the clan’s situation.

The sudden change in the situation within the Zhang Clan convinced Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu that Zhang Fei had joined the clan. They ordered Mo Taizi and Jiu Yuan to remain in the city and find a way to infiltrate the clan.
Mo Taizi and Jiu Yuan helplessly followed their orders, and both of them looked for an inn for temporary accommodation while continuing to monitor the situation at the Zhang Clan.

A week passed quickly, and Zhang Fei had completed the process of merging his soul with the ten-tailed fox’s sloth soul. Although he still felt a sense of laziness due to the ten-tailed fox’s lazy nature, he felt much better than before.

Zhang Fei decided to bring all his wives back to the Moonlit Passion Temple, including his clones’ wives. Upon arrival, he discovered that Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue had already set up the Sect Guardian Formation Array and several other formations.
"Big Brother, can we go to the other domains to have a look?"
Zhang Fei turned to Xu Ling’er and nodded at her. "You guys can go wherever you like, but you all have to always be careful when I’m not by your side."

Upon hearing his words, some of Zhang Fei’s wives, particularly the junior ones, quickly left their residences within the sect. He couldn’t possibly let them leave without an escort, and he asked several sect elders to accompany them. Meanwhile, his senior wives went to several different places, including Zhang Chen, who went straight to the medical hall.
"Husband, she’s been waiting for you for a long time." Luo Yunxiao spoke as she glanced at Qi Qingxiu, who was already standing in front of the barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 1338: New Defense
paragraphs: Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Zhang Fei as soon as she entered the barrier, making him chuckle. "Why are you looking at me like this? Don’t you always enjoy yourself when we are together in the dream?"
"You—" Qi Qingxiu was furious, but she hurriedly suppressed it. "Did you know that Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu started hunting you a week ago?"

"My mother-in-law has already informed me about the matter." Zhang Fei’s answer took Qi Qingxiu aback, as she couldn’t find him for the past week. "I’m in seclusion, but I have several clones, and one of them is in the Slaughter Blood Domain. All my clones are connected to my real body, and my mother-in-law told me about Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu’s plans through my clone."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "So, what are your plans next? Are you going to face them directly?"

"Do you think I’m that crazy?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head. "I did defeat Jia Zizhen, but those two demon gods are on a different level, especially Mo Shentian. Even if I use all the advantages in my possession, I can’t defeat him with my current strength, and I will die at his hands. As for Jiu Mozu, he is not as strong as the former, but he has the support of his nine subordinates. Additionally, Jiu Moze is still alive, and he will certainly assist his disciple if I attack him now. Since I won’t be able to win a fight against them, I won’t make a move on them now, and I will wait for the right time to deal with them."

Qi Qingxiu naturally knew the strength of Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu, and she would have faced them long ago if she were confident in defeating them. Unfortunately, they were both far stronger than her, even though their cultivation and demon rank were at the same level.

"Moreover, I still have one important matter, but I’m still hesitant to go to that domain." Qi Qingxiu looked curious after hearing Zhang Fei’s statement. "Haha! You don’t have to be this curious, you know? My next business is in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, but the four perils are much stronger than Mo Shentian. Their beast rank is a level above mine, and they can suppress me with their bloodline power, so I will not act rashly to go to their domain."
"What do you want to do in their domain?"
Zhang Fei released a soft sigh before telling Qi Qingxiu. "One of the ten-tailed fox’s souls lives in their domain, so I must go there to meet him."
"I see." Qi Qingxiu then gave Zhang Fei an idea. "Why don’t you ask Long Xukong for help? He’s a void dragon, so I’m sure he should be able to take you into their domain without alerting them."

"I’ve asked Long Xukong about that before, but the Four Perils will still notice our presence, and it will cause a major issue between the beast and evil beast races." Zhang Fei immediately changed their conversation. "Luolan shared your ideas with me; what do you think I should do next?"
"Turn this domain into a forest domain." Qi Qingxiu directly grabbed Zhang Fei’s hand and flew out of the sect with him, and Luo Yunxiao followed behind.

Qi Qingxiu pointed in several directions within the Twin Flames Domain. "The areas in this domain are too open, so it will be difficult for you to set up illusion formations. You have hundreds of dryads by your side, so you can utilize their abilities to transform this domain into a forest domain."
"Isn’t that not very useful? Other cultivators can attack us from the air, right?"
"You’re not wrong about that." Qi Qingxiu nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "What do you think will happen if you set up aerial formations?"
"Aerial formations?"

"Yes." Qi Qingxiu explained directly. "I don’t know the extent of the knowledge of the array masters in the Three Mortal Realms, but there are many aerial formations in this Paradise Realm, and Liao Hanxue knows a lot about them. I installed several aerial formations in my domain, and I also installed many ground formations, such as illusion formations and trap formations. Unlike me, those dryads can create natural formations from trees, so you can use them and illusion formations as multiple defenses."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei pondered some things before asking. "There should be aerial formations to restrict flying ability, right?"

Qi Qingxiu nodded at Zhang Fei. "If you use such formations, flying artifacts will not be able to enter this domain, and all cultivators will have to walk from the outermost area, which will consume a lot of time to get in and out of it."

"Husband, such a situation is indeed troublesome, but I think it is much better to protect this domain from attacks by other cultivators." Luo Yunxiao turned to the floating plateau. "What about this plateau? Will that formation affect it? If that formation affects it, this plateau will fall down, and it will no longer be special."

"Why should you care about this plateau?" Qi Qingxiu responded with a shake of her head. "This floating plateau wasn’t created by living beings, and it naturally existed alongside this domain, so such a formation won’t affect it."
"Are you sure about that, Qingxiu?"
"A hundred percent!"

Zhang Fei nodded slightly before leading the two women to land outside the city below the floating plateau. Then, he used his forest manipulation ability and plant manipulation ability to create an artificial forest in that area, and he planned to spread it around the entire city, which shocked Qi Qingxiu.
Since Zhang Fei was still concentrating on creating the forest, Qi Qingxiu didn’t interrupt him; instead, she asked Luo Yunxiao, "How did your husband acquire the abilities of the dryads?"

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "My husband is different from other lust demons, and he has a special ability to mimic the abilities of other demons, so he mimicked these abilities of one of his wives and his subordinates."
Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow before looking up at the sky, sensing four people flying towards them. "Are the four of them his wives?"

"Not all of them." After the four women landed beside them, Luo Yunxiao introduced them to Qi Qingxiu. "Janette and Lillea are my husband’s wives, and they come from the Diyu Realm. Sabina leads the dryads of the Sky Jade Realm, and Jing Shenlin leads the dryads of the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding and spoke to them. "You guys have to help Zhang Fei."
"Yes." Janette, Lillea, Sabina, and Jing Shenlin immediately used their abilities to help Zhang Fei.

Within an hour, dense forest had surrounded the entire city; the sudden appearance of the forest shocked the city’s residents. Not to mention, those trees were incredibly tall, forcing the city’s officials to come out to investigate.
When they arrived outside, they saw Zhang Fei and the four dryads continuing to expand the forest into all areas for several miles, leaving them wondering about their goals.

Luo Yunxiao immediately met them, and she asked them to announce to the residents that the forest would serve as additional protection for their city, but she did not explain too much detail and asked them to wait for Zhang Fei to make another announcement.

After they returned to the city, Luo Yunxiao returned to Qi Qingxiu’s side, waiting for Zhang Fei and the four dryads to finish everything. The forest wasn’t just filled with tall, large trees but also many other types of smaller trees and swamps.
Zhang Fei didn’t cover the entire area with forest; he left some spaces to be used as roads for the city’s residents to enter and exit and to connect the city with other cities within the domain.

’Sister Qingxiu.’ Qi Qingxiu turned to Luo Yunxiao with a raised eyebrow. ’You should prepare yourself because my husband will make a move on you soon.’
’Tch!’ Qi Qingxiu gnashed her teeth. ’You should tell your husband to stay away from me! I’m not interested in him!’

Moreover, you two have spent a lot of time together in the dream, and you should be used to his presence; otherwise, you wouldn’t have come to our sect and waited for him for a week, right?’

Lillea also spoke to Zhang Fei. "Since you also want to create other things in the forest, we’ll probably need more time than that to finish everything."

"Why are you looking at me like this?
Don’t you always enjoy yourself when we are together in the dream?"
"You—" Qi Qingxiu was furious, but she hurriedly suppressed it.
"Did you know that Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu started hunting you a week ago?"
"My mother-in-law has already informed me about the matter." Zhang Fei’s answer took Qi Qingxiu aback, as she couldn’t find him for the past week.
"I’m in seclusion, but I have several clones, and one of them is in the Slaughter Blood Domain.
All my clones are connected to my real body, and my mother-in-law told me about Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu’s plans through my clone."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding.
"So, what are your plans next?
Are you going to face them directly?"
"Do you think I’m that crazy?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head.
"I did defeat Jia Zizhen, but those two demon gods are on a different level, especially Mo Shentian.
Even if I use all the advantages in my possession, I can’t defeat him with my current strength, and I will die at his hands.
As for Jiu Mozu, he is not as strong as the former, but he has the support of his nine subordinates.
Additionally, Jiu Moze is still alive, and he will certainly assist his disciple if I attack him now.
Since I won’t be able to win a fight against them, I won’t make a move on them now, and I will wait for the right time to deal with them."
Qi Qingxiu naturally knew the strength of Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu, and she would have faced them long ago if she were confident in defeating them.
Unfortunately, they were both far stronger than her, even though their cultivation and demon rank were at the same level.
"Moreover, I still have one important matter, but I’m still hesitant to go to that domain." Qi Qingxiu looked curious after hearing Zhang Fei’s statement.
"Haha!
You don’t have to be this curious, you know?
My next business is in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, but the four perils are much stronger than Mo Shentian.
Their beast rank is a level above mine, and they can suppress me with their bloodline power, so I will not act rashly to go to their domain."
"What do you want to do in their domain?"
Zhang Fei released a soft sigh before telling Qi Qingxiu.
"One of the ten-tailed fox’s souls lives in their domain, so I must go there to meet him."
"I see." Qi Qingxiu then gave Zhang Fei an idea.
"Why don’t you ask Long Xukong for help?
He’s a void dragon, so I’m sure he should be able to take you into their domain without alerting them."

"I’ve asked Long Xukong about that before, but the Four Perils will still notice our presence, and it will cause a major issue between the beast and evil beast races." Zhang Fei immediately changed their conversation.
"Luolan shared your ideas with me; what do you think I should do next?"
"Turn this domain into a forest domain." Qi Qingxiu directly grabbed Zhang Fei’s hand and flew out of the sect with him, and Luo Yunxiao followed behind.
Qi Qingxiu pointed in several directions within the Twin Flames Domain.
"The areas in this domain are too open, so it will be difficult for you to set up illusion formations.
You have hundreds of dryads by your side, so you can utilize their abilities to transform this domain into a forest domain."
"Isn’t that not very useful?
Other cultivators can attack us from the air, right?"
"You’re not wrong about that." Qi Qingxiu nodded to Luo Yunxiao.
"What do you think will happen if you set up aerial formations?"
"Aerial formations?"
"Yes." Qi Qingxiu explained directly.
"I don’t know the extent of the knowledge of the array masters in the Three Mortal Realms, but there are many aerial formations in this Paradise Realm, and Liao Hanxue knows a lot about them.
I installed several aerial formations in my domain, and I also installed many ground formations, such as illusion formations and trap formations.
Unlike me, those dryads can create natural formations from trees, so you can use them and illusion formations as multiple defenses."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei pondered some things before asking.
"There should be aerial formations to restrict flying ability, right?"
Qi Qingxiu nodded at Zhang Fei.

"If you use such formations, flying artifacts will not be able to enter this domain, and all cultivators will have to walk from the outermost area, which will consume a lot of time to get in and out of it."
"Husband, such a situation is indeed troublesome, but I think it is much better to protect this domain from attacks by other cultivators." Luo Yunxiao turned to the floating plateau.
"What about this plateau?
Will that formation affect it?
If that formation affects it, this plateau will fall down, and it will no longer be special."
"Why should you care about this plateau?" Qi Qingxiu responded with a shake of her head.
"This floating plateau wasn’t created by living beings, and it naturally existed alongside this domain, so such a formation won’t affect it."
"Are you sure about that, Qingxiu?"
"A hundred percent!"
Zhang Fei nodded slightly before leading the two women to land outside the city below the floating plateau.

Since Zhang Fei was still concentrating on creating the forest, Qi Qingxiu didn’t interrupt him; instead, she asked Luo Yunxiao, "How did your husband acquire the abilities of the dryads?"
"Haha." Luo Yunxiao giggled.
"My husband is different from other lust demons, and he has a special ability to mimic the abilities of other demons, so he mimicked these abilities of one of his wives and his subordinates."
Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow before looking up at the sky, sensing four people flying towards them.

"Janette and Lillea are my husband’s wives, and they come from the Diyu Realm.
Sabina leads the dryads of the Sky Jade Realm, and Jing Shenlin leads the dryads of the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding and spoke to them.
"You guys have to help Zhang Fei."

chapters.title: Chapter 1339: Meet The Gluttony Soul
paragraphs: "Hey, Feng Yao! Can you come out?"
*Swoosh*
A lump of crimson flame shot out from Zhang Fei’s body and transformed into Feng Yao, causing Qi Qingxiu to subconsciously take a few steps back from them.
Feng Yao briefly glanced at Qi Qingxiu before asking Zhang Fei, "Do you want to know my opinion on whether it’s worth transforming this domain?"
"What do you think about it?"

"Let me show you something first." After Feng Yao waved her hand, a few qi screens appeared in front of them. "All of these are my memories regarding the Ancient Realm, so you should be able to decide after you watch them."

Zhang Fei said nothing, and they watched all of Feng Yao’s memories. However, the memories that appeared on those screens shocked them because the ancient realm was different from their previous imagination, and the situation there was much more chaotic than in the Paradise Realm; even many areas were ruined.

"Do you understand now?" They nodded to Feng Yao, who immediately removed the screen. "The ancient realm is different from what you previously imagined, and survival there is much more difficult. Furthermore, the two realms are not that different, and the cultivators of both realms cultivate using celestial qi, so it makes no difference wherever you live. It’s just that the civilization there is much older than this realm, and they have many resources that are not available here, so they are better than the people of this realm in some ways. If I wanted to, I could have brought Huo Lanyin and the others to that realm long ago, but I never brought them there because of the harsh conditions there. Additionally, a lot of time has passed since I last went there, and I’m sure the situation there is much worse than before."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll use this domain as my main base, just as you used the Blazing Nirvana Domain as yours."

"This domain is indeed the best choice for all of you, especially with the existence of the Celestial Yang Lake and the Celestial Yin Lake. Other domains lack both of them, and you control them now." Feng Yao looked around the domain first before continuing. "Additionally, you have many advantages that other cultivators don’t have, and you can utilize them to improve the quality of this domain. This way, this domain will be much better than the others, and it will be a perfect sanctuary for you and everyone around you."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao. "What do you think if I install aerial formations to restrict the ability to fly in this domain?"

Feng Yao momentarily raised an eyebrow. "It doesn’t matter if you want to install such formations, but you must compensate the sects and cities in this domain; otherwise, your decision will backfire on you. You can build a place in the outermost area of this domain to place several teleportation devices or formations for them to travel as usual, and you can protect that place with some other formations."
"Phew." Zhang Fei exhaled heavily. "All of that costs a lot of money."

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed at that. "There’s no such thing as a free lunch, okay? Unlike you, I can protect all my people with my strength, and no one dares to challenge me, so I don’t need such things to protect them. If you would rather not waste money, you should think of a way to reach the Celestial God Realm and evolve into the ten-tailed fox as soon as possible, and no one will dare to challenge you at that time, including the four perils."

"Tch!" Zhang Fei gritted his teeth. "You already know that I’ve spent two decades in seclusion, but I’ve only managed to reach this stage. If I want to reach the Celestial God Realm, I’ll probably have to be in seclusion for several hundred years."

"You should be grateful that you’ve reached this stage in less than three decades." Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei. "No one has managed to do it in the past, and no one will ever be able to do it in the future."
"Do I look ungrateful?" Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "Hey, I need your help to go to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and I’ll meet the ten-tailed fox’s gluttonous soul there."
"When do you want to go there?"
"Today."

"Alright." Feng Yao’s approval delighted Zhang Fei. "After you meet and fuse with the ten-tailed fox’s gluttonous soul, I want you to go to the Zhang Clan in the Starfall Martial Domain, and they will become valuable allies for you."

"The Zhang Clan, huh? Alright, I will go to that clan after the ten-tailed fox’s gluttonous soul merges with my soul." After Feng Yao turned into crimson flame and re-entered his body, Zhang Fei spoke to the four female dryads. "Summon your subordinates to come, and we will start everything today."
"Okay." The three dryads immediately contacted their subordinates to meet them.
Zhang Fei summoned his four clones from the training sect, and the four immediately went to the other supreme sects in the domain to inform them of his plans.

"Yunxiao, please return to the sect and tell Luolan to prepare those formations." Luo Yunxiao immediately flew back to the sect to meet Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue, and Zhang Fei contacted several other people and asked them to bring their subordinates to see him.
A while later, hundreds of dryads landed there, followed by several races from the natural and beast races.
Oliver, Tanbar, Persix, Gravir, and the others led the natural races of the Sky Jade Realm.
Xian Linghua, Xue Jingling, Xian Jinglan, Lei Ting, and the others led the natural races of the Nine Stars Realm.
Qian Chaoying, Ju Xing, Ju Tan, and Ren Shou led the natural races of the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
Long Huang, Long Baiyun, Long Chen, and Long Tian led the beast races from the Nine Stars Realm.
The beasts’ ancestors, such as Zhu Hong, Feng Zhen, Fu Yin, Nu Ying, and others, led the beast races from the upper realms.

After they gathered, Zhang Fei immediately explained his grand plan for the Twin Flames Domain to them in as much detail as possible, and he also assigned them several tasks according to their respective abilities.

All of them were shocked by Zhang Fei’s sudden decision and plan, but they could understand his determination to make the domain the perfect shelter for them. After all, they were still too weak compared to the natives of the Paradise Realm, so they agreed to follow his plan, and they immediately dispersed to various areas after he divided them into several groups.
Zhang Fei asked Tian Kui and Serpentera to meet him, and he instructed the two ancient beasts to suppress anyone who dared to disturb their work.
A few minutes later, Feng Yao’s real body arrived in front of Zhang Fei, and she immediately took him away from the Twin Flames Domain.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
Before they entered the domain, Feng Yao had already used a special artifact to hide their presence and aura, preventing the four perils from detecting them.
Feng Yao immediately took Zhang Fei to a remote area in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, where Dong Xuanyin’s pond was located.
"How did you know they were here?" Feng Yao simply smiled at Zhang Fei before leading him into the pond.

Dong Xuanyin, who was sleeping on her coral, immediately opened her eyes as soon as she sensed their arrival. After a moment of being stunned, she jumped down and hid behind the coral, especially since she was naked. ’Tch! This woman must be the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling; otherwise, this kid wouldn’t be able to enter my place.’
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "It’s useless for you to hide because he has already seen your naked body clearly, Dong Xuanyin."
Dong Xuanyin’s lips twitched in response. "He wouldn’t have seen me naked if you hadn’t led him to break into my residence."
"Too late." Feng Yao looked at the statue behind Dong Xuanyin. "Hey! Come out now, Hu Tianlang."
Soon, Hu Tianlang’s gluttony soul appeared before them, looking at Zhang Fei. "You moved faster than I expected, kid."
"If Feng Yao hadn’t helped me, I wouldn’t have been able to come to this domain today, old fox." Zhang Fei sat cross-legged and released his soul. "Can we start now?"

"Why are you in such a hurry?" Hu Tianlang replied with a shake of his head. "Have you prepared a large amount of food? This soul contains my gluttonous nature, remember? Once we start the process, you will feel extreme hunger, and you will need a lot of food to satisfy your hunger; otherwise, your beast instincts will take over, and you will eat whatever or whoever is next to you."

"Naturally, I wouldn’t come here unprepared, old fox." Zhang Fei immediately took out some large, neatly cut, and cleaned beast meat from the system’s inventory. "I don’t know how strong your gluttonous nature is, but I’ve prepared far more than this. Moreover, my four clones are out there right now, and they can search for beasts anywhere, so I think all my preparations should be enough."
Hu Tianlang looked at the pile of beast meat. "Let’s do it then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1340: Extreme Hunger
paragraphs: Before they began the process of merging their souls, Zhang Fei first transformed into his complete fox form because he would rather not eat raw beast meat in his human form. The moment Hu Tianlang’s soul entered his and initiated the process, he was overwhelmed by extreme hunger.

In the Slaughter Blood Domain and the Twin Flames Domain, Zhang Fei’s clones also experienced the same thing, and all of them immediately ate a large amount of beast meat that they had prepared beforehand.
"Hahaha!" Feng Yao laughed out loud while clutching her stomach, watching Zhang Fei act like a beast. She moved to his side and rubbed his head. "You look cute when you’re like this."

Zhang Fei gave Feng Yao a vicious side glance, but he ignored her again and continued devouring the beast meat as if he hadn’t eaten in years. ’If I can defeat you, I will devour you right here and now!’
Feng Yao smiled in amusement because she could perceive Zhang Fei’s thoughts, primarily due to her flame residing within her body.

"If you’re eager to eat me, you should quickly reach my level, and I’ll let you eat me then." Zhang Fei was irritated after hearing that, and he moved some of his tails towards Feng Yao, but she slapped them away. "I will never let you touch me again before you reach my level."
Feng Yao glanced at Dong Xuanyin, who was still naked. She pulled the fish demon beast toward her before throwing her at Zhang Fei.
"Hey!" Dong Xuanyin wanted to escape, but Feng Yao swiftly restricted her movements. "What are you doing?"
"Just stay there and enjoy yourself." Feng Yao ignored Dong Xuanyin’s furious look and sat on the coral.
"Release—Mhmm." Dong Xuanyin was shocked when Zhang Fei stuffed one of his tails into her mouth. ’Damn it! How dare this brat treat me like this! This happened because of this damn Empress Huo!’
Feng Yao simply smiled as she looked at Dong Xuanyin, but she said nothing and lay down on the coral, waiting for Zhang Fei to finish.
Dong Xuanyin was lucky that Zhang Fei wasn’t in a lustful mood, so he didn’t do anything to her, and he stuffed his tail into her mouth just because her earlier screams had deafened him.
Dong Xuanyin glanced at Zhang Fei and felt relieved that he didn’t do anything to her, as he was fully focused on satisfying his extreme hunger.

paragraphs: Time passed quickly, and night fell again. Mo Taizi, Mo Zixiao, Mo Tianqi, and the others decided to infiltrate the Zhang Clan again. However, they were surprised by the sudden appearance of Mo Zainan.
"Mother, why did you suddenly come here?" Mo Zixiao asked Mo Zainan.

"Your father lost his patience because you all haven’t succeeded in infiltrating the Zhang Clan, so he asked me to come here." Mo Zainan walked to the side of the window, looking at the clan a little far away from their location. "Their barrier is strong because it is a peak-grade array, but it shouldn’t be able to stop the five of you. What exactly has been stopping you guys from infiltrating the clan for the past week?"

"Mother, it wasn’t the barrier that stopped us but something else." Mo Zainan turned into one of his two daughters, who had an oval-shaped face with smooth skin and a narrow jawline. She has narrow eyes with a striking golden hue and a slender nose. Her lips are thick at the bottom, covered in a pale red color. Her silver-white hair is long and straight down to her waist. Her black and silver dress covers her medium-sized breasts, curvy waist, wide hips, and plump buttocks. "We couldn’t be certain what attacked us because we couldn’t detect it, but the attack was truly powerful, and we would have been seriously injured if we hadn’t avoided it."
"Is that true, Yousha?" Mo Zainan asked skeptically.

Mo Yousha wanted to answer her mother, but her sister answered her first. "Mother, my big sister didn’t lie to you, and the strange attack was truly powerful, so we didn’t dare force our way into that clan."

The woman’s face is angular with a narrow chin and high cheekbones. Her long hair is jet-black, wavy, and thick. Her eyes are slanted like an eagle’s, with glowing dark red pupils. She wears a tight full-body black dress, combined with a red hooded robe. Her figure is taller and fuller than Mo Yousha’s, and her breasts are two times bigger, but her curves and buttocks are barely visible.
"Show me that attack, Anqi." Mo Anqi touched Mo Zainan’s forehead, sharing her memories of that mysterious attack with her. "Hmm?"
Mo Zainan’s expression turned serious after she saw Mo Anqi’s memories, confusing them.
"Do you know anything about that attack, Mother?"

"I’m certain that the attack came from Empress Huo." Mo Taizi and the others were shocked to hear that name from Mo Zainan. "Your father and I have fought with her in the past, and she repeatedly used the same attack back then, so I wouldn’t have mistaken it."
"Then—"

"If Empress Huo is the one behind the clan, your father’s guess that Zhang Fei joined them was accurate." Mo Zainan looked at the Zhang Clan again. "She has never had a relationship with any man in the past, let alone gotten married. If she is protecting him to this extent, I’m sure their relationship is not an ordinary relationship, and we will face serious problems if that is true."
"Does that mean we have to retreat?"

"I’ll contact your father first." Mo Zainan hurriedly contacted Mo Shentian and informed him of the matter. "Zixiao and Taizi, your father wants you two to return to our domain, and he wants you two to impregnate Shang Xueli and Nalan Wangzi as soon as possible."
Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi exchanged glances for a moment before hurriedly leaving the inn to return to their domain, and Mo Tianqi asked their mother. "What about us, Mother?"

"Your father asked us to wait here, and he has gone to see Wu Mian to ask for his help in disguising one of you." Mo Zainan’s answer surprised her three children. "If he’s willing to help us, we can infiltrate the Zhang Clan more easily, and Empress Huo will never find out about it, so we have to wait for the results of their meeting for now."
"Alright." The three of them agreed.
Mo Yousha and Mo Anqi immediately pulled Mo Zhainan to sit between them and questioned her about several things, including Zhang Fei’s true identity.
Unfortunately, Mo Zainan and her three children were unaware that Huo Xiaoyu was eavesdropping on their conversation, and she immediately reported their plan to Feng Yao.
In another inn, Jiu Mozu’s nine subordinates were also having a serious discussion, especially after their attempts to infiltrate the Zhang Clan over the past week had failed.
However, an old man suddenly appeared in their room, shocking them all. Jiu Yuan and the others knelt before him, their bodies trembling, and they dared not look at him.

The old man walked to the side of the window and looked towards the Zhang Clan, narrowing his reddish-black eyes and examining the barrier. "How powerful was the mysterious attack that previously stopped you?"
"Grand... Grand Elder Moze, that attack was truly powerful." Jiu Yuan stuttered his answer.

Jiu Yaoming secretly reported to Zhang Fei about the appearance of the old man, who was none other than the Jiu Mozu’s master, Jiu Moze. "Grand... Grand Elder Moze, that attack was stronger than the power of our demon god’s attack when he borrowed our strength."

Jiu Moze furrowed his brows after hearing that. "If what you say is true, the owner of that attack should be Empress Huo because I was struck by her attack in the past, and it took me a thousand years to fully recover. If it’s true, Zhang Fei has indeed joined this clan, but I can’t understand the reason behind her decision to protect him and this clan, especially since she is famous for her antipathy towards men."
"So, what should we do now, Grand Elder? Will you lead us to attack the Zhang Clan?" A female corpse demon who had taken Ma Youling’s place asked.

"I haven’t met Empress Huo, so I don’t know anything about her strength. However, we can’t underestimate her, even though she’s died before." Jiu Moze contacted his disciple before speaking to them again. "Go back to our domain; my disciple needs your help, and I will take care of this matter."
"We will return now, Grand Elder Moze." The nine people immediately left the inn.

After they left, Jiu Moze took out his right arm from under his clothes, and he visibly trembled as he looked at the heavy burn marks on it. He clenched his fist and looked at the Zhang Clan with his reddish-black eyes glowing. "Huo Yanling, I have been waiting for you to come back for a long time; I will come to you soon to settle old grudges. In the past, you were indeed much stronger than me, but you have already died once, and I have been preparing myself for so long. I am confident that I can defeat you this time, and I will turn you into my puppet."

Hearing Jiu Moze’s words, Huo Xiaoyu immediately reported the matter to Feng Yao. However, she asked Huo Xiaoyu not to take any action for now, especially since she still needed to protect Zhang Fei from the four perils.

Instead, Feng Yao ordered Huo Xiaoyu to inform Zhang Zetian about the appearance of the Jiu Mozu, which she immediately did. ’What a foolish old man! In the past, you were no match for my empress, and you will never be her match this time or in the future.’

Within the Zhang Clan, Zhang Zetian had already gathered the seniors of his clan. After informing them of Jiu Moze’s appearance in their city, he immediately ordered them to tighten security around their clan, as he was familiar with the old man’s strength.

Zhang Zetian left the main hall and carefully examined Jiu Moze’s location. ’Sigh! This matter is becoming increasingly troublesome! Who exactly is the person they are looking for? Why are they looking for that person in my clan? Why doesn’t Empress Huo want to tell us the truth? Could it be that the person who will come to see me is the same person the two demon races are targeting?’
"What brings you to my domain this time, Mo Shentian?"

Mo Shentian frowned at the man in front of him. He couldn’t recognize him, but he knew it was Wu Mian. "I need your help disguising one of my children, and I will send my child to infiltrate one of the human clans."

"Oh?" Wu Mian pretended to be surprised to hear that, as he already knew about the reason for Mo Zhentian’s arrival. Feng Yao previously informed Zhang Fei about the conversation between Mo Zainan and her children, and he immediately relayed this information to the Faceless Demon God. "Tell me which clan, or I won’t help you."
"The Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain."
"Huh?" Wu Mian put on a shocked expression again. "Why are you suddenly targeting that clan?"
"That’s none of your business."
’Heh!’ Wu Mian inwardly snorted. "I’ll help you, but I need a few things from you in return."
"Tell me."

"I need the five demon items required to upgrade the demon rank to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks." Mo Shentian’s face darkened because Wu Mian’s request was too excessive. "I don’t know what you were looking for in the Zhang Clan, but I’m sure you’ve found something useful there, and it’s definitely more valuable than the five demon items. Moreover, I know that you have them in large quantities, so it’s not a big deal for you to sacrifice a set, right?"

Instead, Feng Yao ordered Huo Xiaoyu to inform Zhang Zetian about the appearance of the Jiu Mozu, which she immediately did. ’What a foolish old man!
In the past, you were no match for my empress, and you will never be her match this time or in the future.’
Within the Zhang Clan, Zhang Zetian had already gathered the seniors of his clan.
After informing them of Jiu Moze’s appearance in their city, he immediately ordered them to tighten security around their clan, as he was familiar with the old man’s strength.
Zhang Zetian left the main hall and carefully examined Jiu Moze’s location. ’Sigh!
This matter is becoming increasingly troublesome!
Who exactly is the person they are looking for?
Why are they looking for that person in my clan?
Why doesn’t Empress Huo want to tell us the truth?
Could it be that the person who will come to see me is the same person the two demon races are targeting?’
"What brings you to my domain this time, Mo Shentian?"
Mo Shentian frowned at the man in front of him.
He couldn’t recognize him, but he knew it was Wu Mian.
"I need your help disguising one of my children, and I will send my child to infiltrate one of the human clans."
"Oh?" Wu Mian pretended to be surprised to hear that, as he already knew about the reason for Mo Zhentian’s arrival.
Feng Yao previously informed Zhang Fei about the conversation between Mo Zainan and her children, and he immediately relayed this information to the Faceless Demon God.
"Tell me which clan, or I won’t help you."
"The Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain."
"Huh?" Wu Mian put on a shocked expression again.
"Why are you suddenly targeting that clan?"
"That’s none of your business."
’Heh!’ Wu Mian inwardly snorted.
"I’ll help you, but I need a few things from you in return."
"Tell me."
"I need the five demon items required to upgrade the demon rank to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks." Mo Shentian’s face darkened because Wu Mian’s request was too excessive.
"I don’t know what you were looking for in the Zhang Clan, but I’m sure you’ve found something useful there, and it’s definitely more valuable than the five demon items.
Moreover, I know that you have them in large quantities, so it’s not a big deal for you to sacrifice a set, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1342: Go To The Zhang Clan
paragraphs: Mo Shentian eventually agreed and handed the five demon items to Wu Mian, who hurriedly stored them in his storage ring. "Where are they now? Are they in the Starfall Martial Domain?"
"My wife is also in that domain right now, so you should go there to meet them."
"Alright." Wu Mian disappeared instantly.
Mo Shentian was pleased and hurriedly left Wu Mian’s place, and he informed his wife of his success, asking her to wait for the Faceless Demon God at their location.
Sometime later, Wu Mian arrived at the inn room, where Mo Zainan and her three children were waiting for him. "Which of them will infiltrate the Zhang Clan?"
"Tianqi and Yousha will infiltrate the clan."
Wu Mian looked at Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha before approaching them, and he used his disguise technique on them, transforming them into two different people.

"Your disguise technique is marvelous as always, Wu Mian," Mo Zainan spoke with a satisfied smile. "This way, the people from the Zhang Clan won’t be able to recognize them, and they can infiltrate the clan to carry out their tasks."

Wu Mian informed Zhang Fei about the matter before asking Mo Zainan with feigned curiosity. "What exactly are you looking for in the Zhang Clan? Why are you so bothered to deal with those pathetic humans? Even your husband is willing to pay me handsomely for this."
"This is none of your business." Mo Zainan coldly replied.

’Foolish people! You don’t even realize you’ve walked into a trap set by Empress Huo.’ Wu Mian then spoke again. "You guys can do whatever you like! At least I’ve got the items I need, so I’ll be leaving now."
After Wu Mian left, Mo Zainan spoke to them. "Tianqi and Yousha, you two must make the best use of this opportunity, and you two must try to infiltrate the Zhang Clan as soon as possible."
"Yes, Mother."
Thereafter, Mo Zainan took her second daughter, Mo Anqi, leaving the domain and returning to their own.
"What should we do now, Big Sis?"

"What else?" Mo Yousha sat by the window. "Even though we’ve disguised ourselves as humans and our demon aura has disappeared, we can’t infiltrate the clan right away. We have to wait for them to lower their guard and open the barrier first."
Mo Tianqi nodded in agreement and sat across from Mo Yousha. "Sigh! I hope they’ll open their barrier soon, so we can finish our task and return to our domain."
"Yeah."
"Feng Yao, Wu Mian told me that he disguised Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha as humans."

"My subordinate has already informed me of the matter." Feng Yao glanced at Zhang Fei. "I’ll ask her to stall for time until your situation returns to normal, and you should go to the Zhang Clan afterward."

’What are these two actually planning? Are they planning to attack the Celestial Demon Race? As I recall, Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha are Mo Shentian’s children.’ Dong Xuanyin could only silently express her thoughts, as Feng Yao continued to restrict her movements and Zhang Fei’s furry tail remained in her mouth.
Feng Yao climbed down from the coral and walked to Zhang Fei’s side. "This is your best opportunity to plant another spy in the Celestial Demon Race, so you must not fail."

"As long as my enemy is not Mo Shentian or Mo Zainan directly, I will definitely not fail." Zhang Fei was full of confidence in that matter, and he had already made several plans for Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha. He inwardly sighed because his appetite still hadn’t subsided, even though he had eaten large amounts of beast meat since morning. "What about Jiu Moze?"
"I will handle Jiu Moze myself, so you don’t need to worry about him." Feng Yao looked down at Dong Xuanyin. "You’re enjoying yourself sucking his tail, huh?"
Dong Xuanyin looked at Feng Yao with embarrassment, but she didn’t stop her actions and continued to play with Zhang Fei’s furry tail in her mouth.

Feng Yao squatted down beside Dong Xuanyin, pulled Zhang Fei’s tail out of her mouth, and turned her to face him. "Instead of his tail, you should be sucking that one, and you will enjoy yourself even more."
Zhang Fei looked sideways at the two women. ’I’m more interested in seeing you suck my cock than this female fish demon.’
"No!" Dong Xuanyin immediately refused. "Empress Huo, please release me from your restriction."
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei with a mischievous smile before looking at Dong Xuanyin again, but she took out a bottle and poured the contents into her mouth.

Dong Xuanyin was shocked by this, and she immediately realized that the contents of the bottle were Zhang Fei’s yang qi. Despite her initial shock, she enjoyed drinking his yang qi, but she felt a strange feeling as she drank it, and her body heated up from within. ’Shit! His yang qi is strong because of his heavenly fox bloodline, but it also contains some kind of aphrodisiac because he’s a lust demon.’
"Did you like it?" Feng Yao took out another bottle and shook it in front of Dong Xuanyin’s face. "Do you want to drink it again?"

’Why is Empress Huo being shameless like this? People said that she was cold and indifferent in the past, but she has become different from her former self.’ Dong Xuanyin inwardly grumbled. "Give it to me, Empress Huo."

"Sure." Feng Yao once again poured Zhang Fei’s yang qi into Dong Xuanyin’s mouth, which she swallowed in one go. "If you want more, you can drink it directly from the source, as it’s right before your eyes."
Dong Xuanyin chose not to say anything and closed her eyes. ’Sigh! I hope his hunger will disappear soon, and I can live peacefully again after they’re gone.’

Three days passed quickly; Zhang Fei’s hunger finally disappeared completely after Hu Tianlang’s slothful soul perfectly fused with his. He hurriedly returned to his human form and stood up. "It’s time for you to free her, Feng Yao."
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled and withdrew her restriction from Dong Xuanyin.
Dong Xuanyin was relieved after her body could move again, and she hurriedly stood up. However, Zhang Fei suddenly pulled her into his arms and kissed her, startling her.
Dong Xuanyin did not return Zhang Fei’s kiss and pushed him backwards, causing him to stumble backwards. She wiped her lips, hurriedly got dressed, and shouted at him. "Despicable!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "Old fox is your master, right? Since I am his heir, I am your master now."
"Humph!" Dong Xuanyin snorted at Zhang Fei. "Although you are my master’s heir, you are not my master, and I will never submit to you."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei asked with a smirk, causing Dong Xuanyin to shiver and take an involuntary step back. "Unfortunately, I still have other matters, so I must leave now. However, I will return here soon, and I will claim you then."
"Shameless!" Dong Xuanyin furiously shouted.
Zhang Fei simply smiled and opened the gate to another domain. "Let’s go now; I can’t wait to do something for Mo Shentian’s two children."
"Let’s go."

Dong Xuanyin breathed a sigh of relief once they disappeared from her residence, but she was surprised when she looked at the coral, as Feng Yao left many bottles containing Zhang Fei’s yang qi there.

"Tch! Empress Huo got me addicted to that brat’s yang qi!" Dong Xuanyin hurriedly took one and downed it in one go. "Hmm? What exactly are they planning to do to Mo Shentian’s two children? Should I follow them to the Starfall Martial Domain?"

Dong Xuanyin shook her head slightly and abandoned her intention, as she did not want to meet Zhang Fei. She placed all the bottles in her storage ring before lying down on the coral. "Master, your heir is such a pervert, and I want to chop him alive."
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Starfall Martial Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
Upon their arrival at the domain, Feng Yao took Zhang Fei to the city where the Zhang Clan resided. Huo Xiaoyu immediately appeared before them and reported everything to her.
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "I want you to take Zhang Fei to the Zhang Clan, and I will deal with Jiu Moze."
"Yes, Empress."

Zhang Fei casually walked behind Huo Xiaoyu, looked at the map, and read the status of the three demons. ’As expected, Jiu Moze is truly powerful! His cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable, and his demon rank has also reached the Demon God Rank. If I can get him as my slave, I can face the Jiu Mozu more easily.’
Feng Yao glanced toward Jiu Moze’s inn, revealed her presence to him, and flew away from the city to lure him to follow her.
As Feng Yao wished, Jiu Moze hurriedly left the inn and flew after her. "Huo Yanling! I will definitely defeat you today!"
Zhang Zetian and his clan members weren’t surprised by Huo Xiaoyu’s arrival, but Zhang Fei’s presence by her side surprised them.

"Ancestor Zetian, his name is Zhang Fei, and the two demon races are searching for him in this clan." Huo Xiaoyu’s introduction finally made Zhang Zetian and his clan members understand the reason behind the demons’ repeated attempts to infiltrate their clan. "He is my empress’s fiancé, and he will take care of the demons for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1343: Zhang Fei - Zhang Zetian
paragraphs: Zhang Zetian and his clan members froze in place and stared at Zhang Fei in a mixture of shock and disbelief, especially after Hua Xiaoyu introduced him as Feng Yao’s fiancé.

Most of them, including Zhang Zetian, were cultivators who had lived for a long time. They even lived during the time when Empress Huo Yanling was still alive, so they were familiar with her past character, including her antipathy towards men. Today, Huo Xiaoyu suddenly told them that Feng Yao had a fiancé, let alone a younger and weak one, which shocked them.
Zhang Zetian took a deep breath. "Is this young man really Empress Huo’s fiancé, Young Miss Xiaoyu?"

"If you don’t believe my words, my empress is in this domain now, so you can ask her directly." Huo Xiaoyu’s response caused Zhang Zetian to twitch his lips, as he lacked the courage to ask Feng Yao about the matter. "Anyways, my empress asked me to inform you that you can turn off the barrier now, and you must let Mo Shentian’s two children infiltrate this clan so that her fiancé can do something about them."

Zhang Zetian returned his gaze to Zhang Fei, doubting his ability to deal with Mo Shentian’s two children. The old man’s expression changed as he activated the soul link, which brought their cultivations on par.
"How... How is this possible?" Not only was Zhang Zetian shocked by Zhang Fei’s sudden improvement, but also his son, family, and clan members.

Zhang Fei deactivated the soul link and spoke to them. "Senior, I didn’t mean to show off, and I came here specifically to take care of the two demons. Since you seemed to doubt my abilities, I showed you a little of my abilities. Anyways, they knew about me from Jia Zizhen, and they misunderstood that I was a member of your clan because we have the same surname."
"Jia Zizhen? The Fairy King?"

"Jia Zizhen has fallen, and his position has been replaced by Jia Leixuan." Zhang Fei’s revelation shocked them again because the news of the fall of the Fairy King had not yet spread to the public. "The Dragon Emperor found evidence of his conspiracy with Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu to assassinate his predecessor, so the Dragon Emperor and the others immediately moved to eliminate him."

Naturally, Zhang Zetian and his clan members had heard rumors about the conspiracy between Jia Zizhen and the two demon races, but no one had ever succeeded in proving the truth of those rumors before.

"The situation in the Fairy Race has stabilized now that Jia Leixuan has ascended the throne as the new Fairy King." Huo Xiaoyu spoke in support of Zhang Fei’s words. "My task is done, and I will take my leave now. My empress will visit you guys after she gets rid of Jiu Moze, so you should prepare to welcome her."
After Huo Xiaoyu left, Zhang Zetian ordered his son and family to prepare to welcome Feng Yao. He then got off his chair and led Zhang Fei to another area.
"Did you just ascend to this realm, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei nodded at Zhang Zetian. "I ascended to this realm about six years ago, and I immediately went into seclusion. If you want to ask about my relationship with Empress Huo, I met her reincarnation in the lower realms of the Three Immortal Realms. At that time, I had not been a cultivator for long, and she helped me a lot in my cultivation path."
"I see." Zhang Zetian nodded in understanding. "Did you join a sect or clan in another domain? Or did you follow Empress Huo in the Blazing Nirvana Domain?"

"I am an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, but also their current leader." Zhang Zetian suddenly stopped walking and looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief. "Feng Yao already knew from the start that I was a dual cultivator, and she didn’t care about my status."

Zhang Zetian led Zhang Fei to walk again. "I heard about your sect’s changes from one of my clan members who happened to attend your opening ceremony a few months ago, and the Moonlit Passion Sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one. At first, I didn’t believe it because I knew quite a lot about Qing Qiu’er, but I finally understood the reason behind your sect’s changes, and you were the one who brought about that change."

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "I first met Qing Qiu’er at the Star Tower, shortly after I had broken through to the Earth Realm, and she chose me as her dual cultivation partner. As soon as I came out of my seclusion in this domain, I immediately joined her sect. Although I am a dual cultivator, I didn’t like the fact that her sect was exclusively for dual cultivators because I had many acquaintances who weren’t dual cultivators, so I decided to revamp the sect and rebuild it into a universal sect. Many clans and sects have joined us, and the latest were the Liao, You, and Qiao Clans from the Sky Pillar Domain."

"You’re lucky that those three clans are willing to join you." Zhang Fei simply smiled at Zhang Zetian. "The Liao Clan is second best in formation arrays and artifact crafting. The You Clan is highly experienced in blacksmithing, but unfortunately, they can only forge swords. The Qiao Clan is not as powerful as the Zhi Clan, but Qiao Yisheng’s medical abilities are top-notch, and I always send my injured clan members to him for treatment."

Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Zetian. "How about you bring your clan to join us, Senior? You don’t need to join directly, and you can send two of your best young generation to my sect as your representatives, just as the other clans have done."

"How about you bring your clan to join us, Senior?" Zhang Fei’s question surprised Zheng Zetian. "You don’t need to join us directly; instead, you can send two of your best young generation to my sect as your representatives, just as the other clans have done. If you are willing to join us, your clan members will gain many benefits that will be useful for their future."
"For example?"
"This." Zhang Fei took out a pill bottle and handed it to Zhang Zetian. "Don’t be shy; just open it and take a peek inside."

Intrigued by that, Zhang Zetian immediately opened the pill bottle, but his eyes and body trembled after he saw the five superior-grade pills inside. Before he could ask, Zhang Fei already showed him his alchemy badge, making him sigh softly.

Zhang Zetian wanted to return the pill bottle to him, but Zhang Fei asked him to keep it because it was just a set of his basic pills. "No wonder you managed to win Empress Hua’s heart, as you yourself have extraordinary talent. A god-rank alchemist under fifty is an extraordinary achievement, and I think you are the second person to achieve it after her. Please tell me more about your sect, and I will consider your offer. Besides, please tell me about your plans regarding Mo Shentian’s two children, and I will prepare appropriate plans to deal with the aftereffects."

"Since you already know about my sect’s changes, I won’t talk too much about the details." Zhang Zetian nodded to Zhang Fei. "Currently, I have eight god-rank alchemists, two supreme-rank blacksmiths, one supreme-rank artifact crafter, two god-rank swordmasters, one rank 10 array master, two domain masters, and many more."

Zhang Zetian didn’t say anything, but Zhang Fei’s statement shocked him greatly. There were so many sects and clans in the Heavenly Realm, but none had so many experts in a single clan or sect, including his Zhang Clan.

Zhang Fei continued. "Not to mention, several experts in several fields have joined my sect, and we will never stop developing ourselves to achieve our ambition of becoming the strongest in this Paradise Realm."
"The strongest, huh?" Zhang Zetian mumbled under his breath. "You have such a lofty ambition, young man."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response. "Senior, ambition is a part of life for all living beings, whether they are ordinary humans or cultivators. If we don’t have ambition, we will never strive to develop ourselves, and our progress will stagnate at a certain stage. My ambition is indeed too big for most people, but I believe in my abilities, and I am confident that I will succeed in achieving my ambitions in the future. When I’m the strongest, no one can threaten my loved ones, and they will live in peace."

"So, what are your plans for Mo Shentian’s two children, young man?" Zhang Fei immediately explained to Zhang Zetian some of his plans for Mo Taiqi and Mo Yousha, but he didn’t go into too much detail and kept most of the details to himself. "Are you sure you won’t need my help?"

Zhang Fei replied with a slight shake of his head. "They’re still stronger than me, but I’m confident I can handle them both. However, I need your clansmen to lure them to my room tonight, and I’ll take care of them then. As for Mo Shentian, you don’t need to worry about him; I guarantee he and his wife won’t notice the changes in their two children."
"Alright." Zhang Zetian immediately agreed with Zhang Fei’s plans. "I will take you to the guest room now, and I will order my clan members to follow your plan."
"Let’s go then.
