"Anyways, my empress asked me to inform you that you can turn off the barrier now, and you must let Mo Shentian’s two children infiltrate this clan so that her fiancé can do something about them."
Zhang Zetian returned his gaze to Zhang Fei, doubting his ability to deal with Mo Shentian’s two children.
The old man’s expression changed as he activated the soul link, which brought their cultivations on par.
"How...
How is this possible?" Not only was Zhang Zetian shocked by Zhang Fei’s sudden improvement, but also his son, family, and clan members.
Zhang Fei deactivated the soul link and spoke to them.
"Senior, I didn’t mean to show off, and I came here specifically to take care of the two demons.
Since you seemed to doubt my abilities, I showed you a little of my abilities.
Anyways, they knew about me from Jia Zizhen, and they misunderstood that I was a member of your clan because we have the same surname."
"Jia Zizhen?
The Fairy King?"
"Jia Zizhen has fallen, and his position has been replaced by Jia Leixuan." Zhang Fei’s revelation shocked them again because the news of the fall of the Fairy King had not yet spread to the public.
"The Dragon Emperor found evidence of his conspiracy with Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu to assassinate his predecessor, so the Dragon Emperor and the others immediately moved to eliminate him."

Naturally, Zhang Zetian and his clan members had heard rumors about the conspiracy between Jia Zizhen and the two demon races, but no one had ever succeeded in proving the truth of those rumors before.
"The situation in the Fairy Race has stabilized now that Jia Leixuan has ascended the throne as the new Fairy King." Huo Xiaoyu spoke in support of Zhang Fei’s words.
"My task is done, and I will take my leave now.
My empress will visit you guys after she gets rid of Jiu Moze, so you should prepare to welcome her."
After Huo Xiaoyu left, Zhang Zetian ordered his son and family to prepare to welcome Feng Yao.
He then got off his chair and led Zhang Fei to another area.
"Did you just ascend to this realm, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei nodded at Zhang Zetian.
"I ascended to this realm about six years ago, and I immediately went into seclusion.
If you want to ask about my relationship with Empress Huo, I met her reincarnation in the lower realms of the Three Immortal Realms.
At that time, I had not been a cultivator for long, and she helped me a lot in my cultivation path."
"I see." Zhang Zetian nodded in understanding.
"Did you join a sect or clan in another domain?
Or did you follow Empress Huo in the Blazing Nirvana Domain?"
"I am an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, but also their current leader." Zhang Zetian suddenly stopped walking and looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief.
"Feng Yao already knew from the start that I was a dual cultivator, and she didn’t care about my status."
Zhang Zetian led Zhang Fei to walk again.

"I heard about your sect’s changes from one of my clan members who happened to attend your opening ceremony a few months ago, and the Moonlit Passion Sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one.
At first, I didn’t believe it because I knew quite a lot about Qing Qiu’er, but I finally understood the reason behind your sect’s changes, and you were the one who brought about that change."
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed.
"I first met Qing Qiu’er at the Star Tower, shortly after I had broken through to the Earth Realm, and she chose me as her dual cultivation partner.
As soon as I came out of my seclusion in this domain, I immediately joined her sect.

Although I am a dual cultivator, I didn’t like the fact that her sect was exclusively for dual cultivators because I had many acquaintances who weren’t dual cultivators, so I decided to revamp the sect and rebuild it into a universal sect.
Many clans and sects have joined us, and the latest were the Liao, You, and Qiao Clans from the Sky Pillar Domain."
"You’re lucky that those three clans are willing to join you." Zhang Fei simply smiled at Zhang Zetian.
"The Liao Clan is second best in formation arrays and artifact crafting.
The You Clan is highly experienced in blacksmithing, but unfortunately, they can only forge swords.
The Qiao Clan is not as powerful as the Zhi Clan, but Qiao Yisheng’s medical abilities are top-notch, and I always send my injured clan members to him for treatment."
Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Zetian.
"How about you bring your clan to join us, Senior?
You don’t need to join directly, and you can send two of your best young generation to my sect as your representatives, just as the other clans have done."
"How about you bring your clan to join us, Senior?" Zhang Fei’s question surprised Zheng Zetian.
"You don’t need to join us directly; instead, you can send two of your best young generation to my sect as your representatives, just as the other clans have done.
If you are willing to join us, your clan members will gain many benefits that will be useful for their future."
"For example?"
"This." Zhang Fei took out a pill bottle and handed it to Zhang Zetian.
"Don’t be shy; just open it and take a peek inside."
Intrigued by that, Zhang Zetian immediately opened the pill bottle, but his eyes and body trembled after he saw the five superior-grade pills inside.
Before he could ask, Zhang Fei already showed him his alchemy badge, making him sigh softly.
Zhang Zetian wanted to return the pill bottle to him, but Zhang Fei asked him to keep it because it was just a set of his basic pills.
"No wonder you managed to win Empress Hua’s heart, as you yourself have extraordinary talent.
A god-rank alchemist under fifty is an extraordinary achievement, and I think you are the second person to achieve it after her.
Please tell me more about your sect, and I will consider your offer.
Besides, please tell me about your plans regarding Mo Shentian’s two children, and I will prepare appropriate plans to deal with the aftereffects."
"Since you already know about my sect’s changes, I won’t talk too much about the details." Zhang Zetian nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Currently, I have eight god-rank alchemists, two supreme-rank blacksmiths, one supreme-rank artifact crafter, two god-rank swordmasters, one rank 10 array master, two domain masters, and many more."
Zhang Zetian didn’t say anything, but Zhang Fei’s statement shocked him greatly.
There were so many sects and clans in the Heavenly Realm, but none had so many experts in a single clan or sect, including his Zhang Clan.
Zhang Fei continued.
"Not to mention, several experts in several fields have joined my sect, and we will never stop developing ourselves to achieve our ambition of becoming the strongest in this Paradise Realm."
"The strongest, huh?" Zhang Zetian mumbled under his breath.
"You have such a lofty ambition, young man."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response.
"Senior, ambition is a part of life for all living beings, whether they are ordinary humans or cultivators.
If we don’t have ambition, we will never strive to develop ourselves, and our progress will stagnate at a certain stage.
My ambition is indeed too big for most people, but I believe in my abilities, and I am confident that I will succeed in achieving my ambitions in the future.
When I’m the strongest, no one can threaten my loved ones, and they will live in peace."

"So, what are your plans for Mo Shentian’s two children, young man?" Zhang Fei immediately explained to Zhang Zetian some of his plans for Mo Taiqi and Mo Yousha, but he didn’t go into too much detail and kept most of the details to himself.
"Are you sure you won’t need my help?"
Zhang Fei replied with a slight shake of his head.
"They’re still stronger than me, but I’m confident I can handle them both.
However, I need your clansmen to lure them to my room tonight, and I’ll take care of them then.
As for Mo Shentian, you don’t need to worry about him; I guarantee he and his wife won’t notice the changes in their two children."
"Alright." Zhang Zetian immediately agreed with Zhang Fei’s plans.
"I will take you to the guest room now, and I will order my clan members to follow your plan."
"Let’s go then.

chapters.title: Chapter 1344: Two Fish Enter The Trap
paragraphs: Feng Yao and Jiu Moze were already standing face-to-face with each other, but the old demon was quite shocked after detecting her cultivation. He initially thought his cultivation would be several levels lower than his since he had died before, but it turned out their cultivations were at the same level.
Feng Yao smiled slightly. "How about the injury on your hand? Is it still itchy?"

Jiu Moze didn’t say anything and took out nine talismans. Once he activated them, nine coffins immediately appeared behind him. He hurriedly opened the lids of the coffins, revealing nine corpses inside.

Without having to examine the nine corpses, Feng Yao could tell that their strength was still at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, even though they were dead. "They were cultivators who disappeared in the past, and I had long suspected that they fell into your hands."
After the nine corpses opened their eyes and walked out of those coffins, Jiu Moze used a certain technique to borrow their strength, enhancing his own strength.
"Haha." Feng Yao casually laughed. "Even if you borrow their power to enhance yours, you will never be my opponent."
Jiu Moze still didn’t say anything and disappeared from Feng Yao’s sight, but the nine corpses immediately moved to attack her.

Feng Yao simply shook her head, flicked her fingers, and shot nine crimson flames toward them. Before they got close to her, their bodies were already covered in her crimson flames, and she burned them to ashes.
Feng Yao looked in another direction, smirked slightly, and disappeared from her spot. In just a matter of seconds, she had grabbed Jiu Moze’s neck, causing his face to turn deathly pale.

Jiu Mozu exerted his full strength to break free, but his strength disappeared by itself. He punched Feng Yao repeatedly, but her crimson flames blocked his attacks. "How... how could you do that? I’ve been preparing those corpses for so long to deal with you."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "Like I said, you were not my opponent in the past, and you will never be my opponent in the present or the future. In the past, I kept you alive for a future purpose, and the day has come."
"You—" Feng Yao immediately knocked Jiu Moze unconscious.
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Feng Yao’s body. "Are you really going to hand this demon over to Zhang Fei, Master?"

"Isn’t that obvious, Ling’er?" Feng Yao lifted Jiu Moze with her aura. "Zhang Fei needs strength to help me, and this foolish demon will be useful to him. If he absorbs this foolish demon’s cultivation and demon power, his strength will increase significantly, and he will be even more prepared to face his next enemy."
Huo Ling could only shake her head upon hearing that, and she re-entered Feng Yao’s body without saying anything to her master.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei, who had been pondering on the bed, raised his eyebrows as soon as Feng Yao appeared in his room, especially when he saw the unconscious Jiu Moze. "At first, I thought you were going to kill him, but you brought him to me."
"Why should I kill this foolish demon?" Feng Yao threw Jiu Moze to the floor. "Absorb his strength and demon power as much as you want, but you must not kill him and use him to control Jiu Mozu."
Zhang Fei hurriedly jumped down from the bed, squatted beside Jiu Moze, and touched his chest. "How much will my cultivation and demon rank increase if I absorb his cultivation and demon power?"

"I’ve never been a demon, so I can’t estimate the increase in your demon rank." Feng Yao thought for a while. "According to my calculations, your cultivation will at least break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm if you absorb a quarter of his cultivation, and you can help all your wives faster by then."

Zhang Fei nodded at Feng Yao. "However, I can’t absorb his cultivation in this domain, let alone if I want to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm. The heavens will surely strike me, and my lightning tribulations will bring chaos to this domain."
"Yeah." Feng Yao agreed with Zhang Fei. "Keep him in one of your spaces first, and you can absorb his cultivation after you deal with Mo Shentian’s two children."

Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space and threw Jiu Moze into it. "Let’s wait for the night, then. Anyways, your subordinate asked them to prepare a banquet for you, and everything should be almost ready by now, so let’s meet them first."
"Let’s go."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei led Feng Yao to leave the guest room, but her sudden arrival caused the situation in the Zhang Clan to become tense.
While waiting for the dishes to be prepared, Zhang Fei and Feng Yao chatted with Zhang Zetian and his clan members.

Thanks to Feng Yao’s help, Zhang Zetian decided to bring the Zhang Clan into the Moonlit Passion Temple. Just like other clans and sects, he selected two of the best members from their younger generation to join the sect.

After all the dishes were ready, Zhang Zetian and his family immediately began the banquet to entertain them while discussing several things, including Zhang Fei’s plans for the Moonlite Passion Sect, the Twin Stars Domain, and future matters.
After the banquet was over, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei returned to the room, and they asked Zhang Zetian to deactivate the clan’s barrier.
As they originally planned, they waited for Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha in the room, and the Zhang Clan members made arrangements for the two demons to go there.
Zhang Zetian sent several members of the Zhang Clan out of the clan, and they deliberately talked about Zhang Fei as a new recruit.
Naturally, their conversation reached Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha, and the two immediately informed their parents of Zhang Fei’s presence in the Zhang Clan.
Mo Shentian ordered Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha to infiltrate the Zhang Clan once the barrier was gone, specifically to kill Zhang Fei.
Since Feng Yao had ordered her to keep an eye on Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha, Huo Xiaoyu naturally heard their conversation, and she immediately relayed it to her master.
After receiving information from Huo Xiaoyu, Feng Yao decided to leave the Zhang Clan. However, she wasn’t gone for long, and she returned with a dead man some time later.
Zhang Fei used his body modification ability on the man’s corpse, transforming its appearance to resemble his own in his half-fox form.
Since their conditions had returned to normal, Zhang Fei’s four clones helped the natural and beast races transform the Twin Flames Domain into a forest domain.

The natural and beast races had been working on the area for four days, turning most of the domain into forest. However, they didn’t cover the entire area with trees, but they also built connecting roads between the cities and the sects. Additionally, they also built a building in the outer area of the domain, which Zhang Fei would use for teleportation portals connecting the cities and the sects, allowing them to move freely if he installed aerial restriction formation arrays later.

At first, the people from the sects and cities objected to Zhang Fei’s decision, especially his plans to install aerial restriction formation arrays. However, they eventually gave in, especially after his four clones explained the details of his plans for their domain. Moreover, the Moonlit Passion Temple was no longer the old one, and the sect had already become the strongest in their domain, replacing the Sun-Moon Sect.

With the help of Zhang Fei’s four clones, their work became much easier, and the Twin Flames Domain became a forest domain in just four days. After everything was completed, they immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple to rest and recuperate.

In the Moonlit Passion Temple, Liao Hanxue, Duanmu Luolan, and Qi Qingxiu worked together to create several formation arrays, especially the teleportation formation array and the aerial restriction formation array. Even though they were rank 10 array masters, it was quite difficult to create so many peak-grade formation arrays at once. Moreover, the materials they needed to create them were quite numerous, and not all of them were available even in the Liao Clan, so they still needed a lot of time to create them all.
As they expected, Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha infiltrated the Zhang Clan in the middle of the night, and they immediately moved toward Zhang Fei’s room.
Unfortunately, Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha were too naive, and they were completely unaware that everything was a trap from the start.

As soon as Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha entered Zhang Fei’s room, Feng Yao immediately moved to restrict their movements. As usual, Zhang Fei used his soul manipulation ability on them, replicated their souls, and merged them with his.

After he was done with their souls, Zhang Fei used his memory manipulation ability on Mo Tianqi and Mo Yousha to alter some of their memories, making both of them completely loyal to him without alerting Mo Shentian and Mo Zainan.
Feng Yao teased Zhang Fei about Mo Yousha, but he didn’t have the slightest interest in her, even though the female demon’s cultivation and demon power were much higher than his.
After he gave them something, Zhang Fei ordered the them to bring the male corpse back to the Celestial Demon Domain. He and Feng Yao bid farewell to Zhang Zetian and left the Zhang Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1345: Mo Shentian’s Doubt
paragraphs: Upon arrival at the Moon Illusion Domain, Zhang Fei took Jiu Moze out of the Yin-Yang Space, and he also summoned Luo Yunxiao out of the training space because her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique would be useful in dealing with his lightning tribulations.
"Husband, I find this strange because you haven’t faced your lightning tribulations after you broke through to the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm." Luo Yunxiao spoke.

"I also feel strange about that." Zhang Fei agreed with Luo Yunxiao. "I broke through to that stage when I was in the process of my evolution, but my lightning tribulations didn’t appear when I went to the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain."
Luo Yunxiao looked at Feng Yao. "Do you know anything about this matter?"
"No." Feng Yao looked up to the sky. "I don’t understand why the heavens didn’t send down his lightning tribulations after Zhang Fei broke through to that stage, but I have a guess about it."
"What’s your guess?" Both Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao asked.

"The heavens have been trying to kill you from the time you broke through to the Earth Realm until you broke through to the Five Celestial Realms, but all their efforts have always ended in vain." Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao nodded to Feng Yao, who immediately continued. "If my guess is correct, the heavens are deliberately holding back your lightning tribulations, and they probably intend to accumulate them from all your subsequent breakthroughs and strike them down all at once."
Luo Yunxiao frowned at that. "If that’s true, his lightning tribulations will be too powerful when the heavens bring them down all at once, and he probably won’t be able to face them."

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "Zhang Fei once faced multiple lightning tribulations simultaneously, but the heavens were unable to kill him. He has grown rapidly since that day, and he has also mastered many body cultivation techniques. The heavens are always watching over us, and they are aware of his current body strength. They are aware that a single lightning tribulation will not be enough to kill him, so they deliberately delayed his lightning tribulations to attack him all at once after his lightning tribulations had accumulated a lot."
"Will he be able to face such powerful lightning tribulations?"

"No." Feng Yao looked at Luo Yunxiao. "Back then, Zhang Fei was able to face multiple lightning tribulations at once because his cultivation was still at the Ten Mortal Realms, and his body was much stronger than that of other cultivators at that level. However, he has now reached the Five Celestial Realms, and the power of lightning tribulations at each stage in the Five Celestial Realms is much more powerful. If the heavens truly intend to accumulate his lightning tribulations with each of his breakthroughs, he will face the deadliest attack he has ever faced in the future."
Luo Yunxiao let out a heavy sigh and looked at Zhang Fei. "Husband."

"I know how you feel, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei looked up at the sky. "Regardless of what happens, I have no choice but to face what comes my way. I don’t know if I can withstand such a powerful strike, but I won’t let the heavens do as they please, and I will face their wrath with my full strength."

"Why are you so worried about that?" Luo Yunxiao returned her gaze to Feng Yao. "Zhang Fei will not be able to face such a powerful strike with his current strength, but his path is still long ahead, and he will continue to become strong. Moreover, he has you by his side, and your Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique is truly overpowered, so I’m sure you can help him deal with it. If you have any doubts about that, you can ask Hu Tianlang, and he will enlighten you about the true abilities of your special physique."

"I’ll meet Hu Tianlang in his soul world after this." Luo Yunxiao suddenly had an idea. "What if he doesn’t force himself to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm and stops at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm? After all, breaking through from the Celestial King Realm to the Celestial Emperor Realm will take a much longer time, right? Even with my sisters’ help, I am sure he won’t be able to break through in the next ten years unless he absorbs other people’s cultivation again. This way, he has a lot of time to strengthen himself, especially his body cultivation level."

"I think that’s the best solution." Feng Yao nodded in agreement. "Since I’ve been monitoring Zhang Fei all this time, I can say for certain that he’ll need at least five years to break through to the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, even with all of you helping him. If he takes the normal path, he will need a minimum of ten years to break through to the Celestial King Realm from that stage, and he will need several decades to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm."

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly when he heard that, especially since breaking through each stage of the Five Celestial Realms took a very long time. He sighed softly, squatted beside Jiu Moze, and touched his chest. "Everything that’s destined to happen will eventually happen someday, so there’s no point in dwelling on this matter now. I just need to keep improving myself, and I’ll face whatever comes my way."

"Yes." Both Feng Yao and Luo Yunxiao nodded at him. "Absorb Jiu Moze’s cultivation now, and you can stop once your cultivation breaks through to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm. However, you must do it gradually and stop after each breakthrough, and we will see what the heavens will do to you."

"Hmm?" Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul squinted his eyes as he sensed the change in Zhang Fei [4]’s cultivation. "You absorbed someone else’s cultivation, huh?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] gave a light nod. "My real body is absorbing Jiu Moze’s cultivation and demon power now."

"You’re such a crazy kid." Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul shook his head. "If other cultivators tried to use the same method as you to increase their cultivation, they would definitely become cripples, and at worst, the heavens would sentence them to death."

Even though my original self had predicted your birth, your birth was still an anomaly because you had multiple identities."

Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul nodded at Zhang Fei [4]. "Whatever the reason, you were destined to have multiple identities, and that young girl was destined to turn you into who you are now."

"Destiny, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] clenched both his fists. "I am a cultivator, and I cultivate to defy the heavens and destiny. "Hahaha!" Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul laughed heartily after hearing that. "Such an arrogant kid! My original self is the strongest; not even the primordial genesis beast and the primordial nihility beast dare to fight him. Once you evolve into the ten tails and inherit his true strength, you will become unstoppable, and you will be able to defy the heavens at that time."
Zhang Fei [4] smiled faintly. "Whatever the result is, let’s see in the future."

Since they had never met Zhang Fei before, and Jia Zizhen had never told them about him, they couldn’t confirm whether the corpse in front of them was the real him or not.

Mo Shentian nodded in agreement with her. "Jia Zizhen said that the ten-tailed fox was the strongest living being, so I found it hard to believe that his heir would be this weak; even our children could kill him so easily. Unfortunately, he is dead now, and we can’t prove whether he is the real one or not."

chapters.title: Chapter 1346: Celestial King Realm
paragraphs: "If you have any doubts about whether this corpse is Zhang Fei or not, I think we should continue searching for him to confirm the truth."

"Let Mo Yewei and the others continue searching for him." Mo Shentian destroyed the corpse as he rose to his feet. "With Nalan Wangzi and Shang Xueli in our hands, we already have control over the Asura Demon Race and the Soul-Devouring Race. Unfortunately, we still don’t have the keys to controlling the other demon races, so we must accelerate our plans, and we must use force if necessary."
"Have you decided to go see Dong Xuanyin again?"

"I went straight to Dong Xuanyin’s place after I met Wu Mian a few days ago, but she didn’t give me any response, so we can forget about asking her for help." Mo Shentian looked at his two daughters. "Yousha and Anqi, I want you two to move against the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, and one of you must succeed in getting Sha Huo’s heart. Whichever of you two succeeds in getting him as your husband, I will give you the best reward."
"Yes, Father."
"Leave now."
After Mo Yousha and Mo Anqi left, Mo Zainan asked Mo Shentian. "What about Ku Shenzu and his Torture Demon Race?"

"I still haven’t found a way to control him." Mo Shentian replied with a soft sigh. "That man doesn’t have any children, and his hobby of torturing people is too horrible. If I send our daughters to him, I’m sure he will torture them cruelly, so I prefer sending them to Sha Huo."

Mo Zainan smiled and hugged Mo Shentian’s arm. "I’m glad you still care about our children, husband. I always thought you didn’t care about them and that you always treated them as your tools, but it turned out I was wrong."
"Defective tools will no longer be useful, right?" Mo Shentian pushed Mo Zainan’s hands down and walked away, leaving her speechless.

Mo Zainan massaged her forehead as she looked at her husband; Mo Shentian’s attitude made her truly helpless. "Sigh! What actually happened to him? He wasn’t like this in the past, but his character changed completely after he completed his final evolution and became our demon god, and he’s always treated us all as his tools since then."
"Mother." Mo Zainan was startled when Mo Tianqi hugged her from behind, and she looked at him directly. "Do you think there is a possibility that my father will return to his old self?"

Mo Zainan pushed Mo Tianqi back before answering him. "I’ve always harbored hopes that he’ll return to his old self, but I don’t know if my hopes will ever come true. We can’t do anything to change him, and we can only follow his wishes, or he will punish us."

"Honestly, I’m tired of this situation, Mom." Mo Zainan frowned at Tianqi. "He wasn’t like that before, and he treated us fairly, but he changed after he became a demon god. He gave Shang Xueli to my eldest brother, even though he knew I wanted her. I’m angry about it, but I know I can’t fight him, and he might kill me even though I’m his son. I’m not inferior to my two brothers, but he always treats me like a burden."

"I understand your feelings, but we can’t do anything, so you have to accept the situation. If you go against your father, he will definitely kill you." Mo Tianqi hung his head down, making Mo Zainan feel guilty towards him. She stepped forward, hugged him, and coaxed him. "Be patient, okay? I’m sure your father will return to his old self one day, and we just need to wait for the time to come."
"I hope so, Mother." Mo Tianqi hugged Mo Zainan back, took out an item, and slipped it to the back of her dress. "I’ll go back to my room, Mother."

"Yeah." Mo Zainan watched her third son leave with a heavy heart, especially since her husband continued to treat him unfairly. "I’m sorry, Tianqi. If only I were stronger, I could have protected you all from your father. Unfortunately, I haven’t evolved to my final form, and he is much stronger than me even though our strengths are equal."
After that, Mo Zainan walked out of the throne room, unaware of the item that Mo Tianqi had tucked behind her dress earlier.
[Congratulations! The host’s cultivation broke through to the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm.]

’Sigh! The seven supreme demon ranks are indeed troublesome, and increasing them is much harder than increasing my cultivation. I’ve absorbed quite a bit of his demon power, but my demon rank still hasn’t risen to the Demon Overlord Rank.’ Zhang Fei looked up at the sky, but there was no sign that his lightning tribulations were about to descend. "It seems that your previous guess was correct, and the heavens deliberately held back my lightning tribulations."
Feng Yao nodded at Zhang Fei. "Stabilize your cultivation first before you continue to absorb his cultivation."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei swallowed true foundation pills, as cultivation in the Five Celestial Realms was more difficult to stabilize. "Is there a foundation pill that is better than my true foundation pill?"

"Here." Feng Yao took out a pill bottle and gave it to Zhang Fei. "Your True Foundation Pill can indeed help you stabilize your cultivation, but you need to take several pills at once with your current cultivation. This Flame Consolidation Pill has a much better effect than your pill, and you only need to take one pill to break through three times."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei peeked directly at the bottle and discovered three pills inside it. "Do you still have the ingredients to concoct this pill?"

Feng Yao immediately explained. "The ingredients for concocting the pill don’t exist in this Paradise Realm, but you can find them in the Ancient Realm. Unfortunately, I don’t have much in stock, and they are remnants I left for my subordinates in the past."
"It’s okay." Zhang Fei stored the bottle in his inventory. "I won’t be breaking through multiple stages at once after this, so these pills are enough for now."
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded slightly.
Zhang Fei looked at Jiu Moze again. "A cultivator of the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable is indeed extraordinary; he hasn’t experienced the slightest change, even though I have absorbed so much of his qi."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "You know how difficult it is to break through one minor stage at your level, so you should be aware that the qi you absorbed previously was less than 1% of his total qi." Once you break through to the Celestial King Realm, you will increasingly understand how difficult it is to break through each stage."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei agreed with that.

After waiting for a few hours and his cultivation had completely stabilized, Zhang Fei began to absorb Jiu Moze’s qi and demon power again. He did it for several full hours until his cultivation reached his target, and his demon rank also rose to the next stage.
[Congratulations! The host’s cultivation has broken through to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm.]
[Congratulations! The host’s demon rank has been upgraded to Demon Overlord Rank.]

After two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei immediately stopped absorbing Jiu Moze’s qi and demon power. He was astonished by the condition of the old demon because he still looked fresh, even though he had absorbed so much of his qi and demon power.

When he was still living in the Three Mortal Realms in the past, Zhang Fei had often absorbed the qi and demon power of many cultivators and demons, and they would immediately die from it, but Jiu Moze was on a whole different level when compared to those weak cultivators.

Afterwards, Zhang Fei activated his soul domain and forced Jiu Moze’s soul out of his body using his soul manipulation ability. However, he and the two women frowned when they saw his soul, especially since it was pitch-black.
"Have you ever seen the soul of a living creature this pitch-black?" Luo Yunxiao asked Feng Yao.

"No." Feng Yao tried to touch Jiu Moze’s soul, but something inside tried to absorb her soul power, forcing her to pull her hand back. "Zhang Fei, you must not replicate his soul, let alone merge it with yours. This darkness is not an ordinary one, and it comes from something sinister. If you do that, this darkness will affect your cursed demon heart, and it will also strengthen Hu Tianlang’s evil soul. If that happens, his evil soul will take over your soul, and you will turn truly evil because of the influence of your cursed demon heart."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "Where did the darkness in his soul come from?"

"The darkness comes from the Lotus Limbo World." Feng Yao’s answer shocked Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao. "I don’t have an answer about how the darkness from that place came to be in his soul, but I’m sure that he’s never died before. If my guess is correct, he met someone who had entered that place and managed to get out safely, but I’ve never heard of such a person before."

Zhang Fei felt that there was something odd about that. "Didn’t you say before that the Lotus Limbo World is a prison for cultivators who defy the wheel of reincarnation? How could that person enter there and then come back out again? Is it possible that he or she is a reincarnator like you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1347: Visit Immortal Lotus Sanctuary
paragraphs: "I don’t know how that person got in there and came out alive, but one thing is for sure: that person is a reincarnator like me. There are only two ways to get in there, and you already have one of the keys. The second way is by dying and defying the wheel of reincarnation, but almost no one can do that, and I’ve only met a few people who could do it in the past." Feng Yao crouched beside Jiu Moze and touched his chest. "I can’t confirm the identity of that reincarnator yet, but I’m sure this demon still has a connection to that person. If you do something to him, that person will probably find out about your actions, and it will bring you trouble. Therefore, I will enslave him for you, and he will still follow your orders."
"Alright." Since Zhang Fei knew nothing about reincarnators and their past strength, he had to agree with Feng Yao, and he returned Jiu Moze’s soul into his body. "You can do it now."

Soon, a small crimson flame symbol appeared on Jiu Moze’s forehead, and Feng Yao injected a bit of Huo Ling’s eternal flame into his body in preparation to confront the mysterious reincarnator behind him.

Not long after Feng Yao withdrew her hand, Jiu Moze slowly opened his eyes, but he froze as soon as he saw her. He felt his body weaken before stealing a glance at Zhang Fei, realizing that the young man before him had absorbed his qi and demon power. ’Fuck! This brat must be the heir of the ten-tailed fox.’

"You’re correct; he is indeed the heir of the ten-tailed fox, but unfortunately, you will not be able to retain any memories of him." The moment Feng Yao said that, Jiu Moze experienced a sharp headache, and some of his memories disappeared by themselves. "For now, he is your master, and you must follow all his orders."
Hearing that, Jiu Moze hurriedly got up and knelt down on one knee. "Please give me your order, Master."
"Did you use some kind of memory manipulation on this old demon?" Zhang Fei asked Feng Yao.
"Kind of." Feng Yao simply smiled and didn’t elaborate further. "You can order him now, and I’ll return to my domain."

Zhang Fei could only shake his head as Feng Yao disappeared, and he looked at Jiu Moze again. "First, I want you to strip the Jiu Mozu of its power. Second, I want you to control the Nine Nethers Demon Race."
"Consider it done, Master."

"Who was the one who put the darkness inside your soul?" Jiu Moze looked up at Zhang Fei, but his expression showed confusion. ’Could that mysterious reincarnator have injected the darkness into his soul without his knowledge?’
"Master?"
"Go back to your domain and carry out my orders."
"Yes, Master."
After Jiu Moze left, Zhang Fei hugged Luo Yunxiao’s waist and brought her back to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"What are you going to do now, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked once they arrived inside their residence at the back of the mountain.

Zhang Fei rubbed his chin in thought. "My cultivation has broken through again, so I think I should restock my yang qi. This way, the female elders and disciples in our sect can use it for their cultivation, and they will become stronger than other cultivators, especially in their body strength. However, I won’t handle it personally; instead, I will let my four clones take care of it while I go somewhere else."
"Where do you want to go?"

"The Empyrean Main Domain." Luo Yunxiao looked at Zhang Fei in surprise. "The darkness within Jiu Moze’s soul left me with many questions, and Qing Qiu’er found the Forbidden Lotus Codex in the Ashen Lotus Monastery, so I wanted to search for the entrance portal to that place."
"Are you planning to look for the giant Yin-Yang Lotus?"

Zhang Fei nodded in response. "I am confident that there is a connection between the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, the Lotus Forbidden Codex, and the Lotus Limbo World. If my guess is correct, the lotus might connect me to the safest path to that place. If that’s true, I’ll go there, but I won’t do it in a hurry, and I’ll make some plans first."

"How are you going to find the Ashen Lotus Monastery?" Luo Yunxiao asked again. "That place disappeared long ago, and my ancestors never saw it again after they entered it once. The only person who ever entered was Qing Qiu’er, but she did so unknowingly, and the portal disappeared after she left."

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "I have no way of finding that place, but I know someone who can help me find it. However, I need my sister-in-law’s help to find that place, so we’ll meet her at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary first."
Luo Yunxiao understood who Zhang Fei was referring to. "Let’s go then! I haven’t been back to my sect in a long time, and I miss my room there."

"Hey!" Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao turned to Qi Qingxiu, who had just landed in front of them. "Eh? How did your cultivation break through from the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm in a day?"

"I absorbed Jiu Moze’s qi and demon power." Zhang Fei’s answer shocked Qi Qingxiu. "Naturally, I couldn’t fight him myself, and Feng Yao captured him for me. She enslaved him, but I have control over him, and I will use him to control Jiu Mozu."

Qi Qingxiu’s smile bloomed as she was truly satisfied upon hearing that. "That bastard is the most annoying demon among all the demon gods, and he is only a coward who can rely on the power of his nine subordinates. Therefore, I’m pleased if you can control him, and he will be useful to you in dealing with Mo Shentian. So, where are you two going now?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed before pulling Qi Qingxiu into his embrace, and he didn’t give her a chance to escape by hugging and kissing her.

Qi Qingxiu was helpless because her body reacted on its own, especially after Zhang Fei had repeatedly brought her subconscious into the dream, where they spent too much time together with him always doing such things to her.
Qi Qingxiu eventually closed her eyes, embraced Zhang Fei’s neck, and returned his kiss. He guided her to kiss in a constantly changing rhythm, sometimes slow, sometimes fast.
Luo Yunxiao smiled seeing them like that, but then he looked at the three women who walked into their residence, who were none other than Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, and Nalan Wangzi.

Nalan Wangzi smiled, seeing Qi Qingxiu enjoying herself in kissing Zhang Fei. Tianshi Shengjie shook her head helplessly as he kept adding new women to his harem. Meanwhile, Tian Huangjin showed no reaction, as she had grown accustomed to his debauchery.

Qi Qingxiu quivered slightly when Zhang Fei grabbed and kneaded her buttocks, but she quickly opened her eyes and pushed him back, especially after she noticed the others’ presence. ’Tch! This brat is really annoying, but my body is even more annoying!’

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at Qi Qingxiu’s reactions before looking at the other women. "Do you three want to join us? We want to go to the Empyrean Main Domain to look for something, but we’ll go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary first before that."
"Husband, I think you should bring Qing Qiu’er with us." Luo Yunxiao spoke.
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei immediately asked Qing Qiu’er to meet them, and he also invited Jia Yuyan to join them. "So, are you guys coming with us?"
"I’m in." Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin made their decision without hesitation.
Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Wangzi hesitated to go with them because they were demons, and the people of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary had never liked demons, especially their ancestors.
Luo Yunxiao spoke directly to them. "You guys are my husband’s women, so my family won’t do anything to you two."
"I’m not his woman." Qi Qingxiu retorted.
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled and teased Qi Qingxiu. "You say that, but you enjoyed your kiss with him, and—"
"Shut up!" Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Luo Yunxiao, but a loud slap landed on her buttocks. "Ahh! Why did you do that?"
Zhang Fei shrugged his shoulders. "Yunxiao is my wife, and you will be my wife soon, so you must get along with her."
"Humph!" Qi Qingxiu snorted and turned her face away.
After Qing Qiu’er and Jia Yuyan arrived, Zhang Fei took them all to the Empyrean Main Domain before heading to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

The presence of Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Wangzi shocked and frightened the residents there, but they were also confused by the presence of Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, and Jia Yuyan. They had never seen five different races walking together in one group, and they chatted casually as if there was no animosity between them.
The arrival of Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Wangzi alerted the ancestors of the Luo Clan, and all of them immediately rushed out, waiting for Zhang Fei and the others inside their sect.
Zhang Fei frowned when they arrived at the main hall, especially because of the presence of Luo Meizhen and the other four. Even though they were Luo Yunxiao’s ancestors, he never liked them.
Huang Xiaoyi glanced at the five ancestors before asking Zhang Fei, "Is there something important that you brought them here, son?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1348: Some Information
paragraphs: "Husband, you can talk to them first, and I’ll go to my old room to get some things." Luo Yunxiao darted away, leaving the main hall.
"Mother-in-law, I—"

"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei turned to one of the two female ancestors of the Luo Clan, Luo Jieyi. Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and the other four ancestors looked at him in shock, just realizing the progress of his cultivation. "How could your cultivation have reached the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm so quickly?"

"Naturally, I have my own way of improving my cultivation, Senior." Luo Jieyi and the other four ancestors curiously looked at Zhang Fei, but he didn’t want to explain anything to them; instead, he threw a bombshell at them. "By the way, you guys may not know about this yet, but I have already defeated Jia Zizhen, and I did it without your help."

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi naturally knew about it from Luo Yunxiao, and they deliberately didn’t tell their ancestors. However, Zhang Fei’s final sentence made them smile bitterly, as it showed his dislike for their ancestors.

Luo Qifeng and the other four looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief, and one of them wanted to ask him, but Jia Yuyan was immediately interrupted. "My husband defeated him with his strength, and Jia Zizhen’s position as the Fairy King has been replaced by Jia Leixuan."

Since Jia Yuyan was a member of the fairy race, they did not doubt her words, but they were still confused about how Zhang Fei could defeat Jia Ziezhen by himself. They knew that he had a technique to increase his strength because he once showed it to them, but they still found it hard to believe that he could defeat the former fairy king.
Unfortunately, the five ancestors of the Luo Clan didn’t know anything about Zhang Fei’s changes after their last meeting, let alone the existence of the nine evil beasts by his side.

Zhang Fei ignored them and answered Huang Xaoyi’s previous question. "Mother-in-law, I brought them here because I wanted to find the entrance portal to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, but I needed sister-in-law Bingying’s help first before looking for it. I contacted her before, but she didn’t give me an answer, so I came here looking for her."

The five ancestors of the Luo Clan were irritated because Zhang Fei ignored them, but none of them said anything because they realized that he was acting like that because they were unwilling to support him back then.
"I’ll call Bingying now." Huang Xiaoyi immediately left.
Zhang Fei looked at Luo Fenghan. "Do you two want to join us, Father-in-law?"
"Are you sure Bingying can help you find the entrance portal, son?" Luo Fenghan returned the question.
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "Sister-in-law Bingying might not be able to find the portal, but she can take me to someone who might know its location."
"I see." Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding. "In that case, let’s wait until you meet that person, and we’ll go with you if you manage to find the portal to that place."

Not long after, Huang Xiaoyi returned with Bing Xingying, and Zhang Fei frowned for a moment because her face looked pale. He immediately realized something before smiling teasingly, causing her to lower her embarrassed face. "Do you want to go there now, brother-in-law?"
"The sooner the better." Zhang Fei nodded at Bing Xingying.
A moment later, a small crack appeared in front of them and sucked Zhang Fei into it directly, shocking Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Wangzi, who had never seen that before.
"My real body took my brother-in-law to his destination," Bing Xingying explained briefly. "Father, mother, and ancestors, I’m not feeling well, so I’ll go back now."
"Take a rest, Xingying."
After Bing Xingying left, Luo Jieyi questioned Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. "Where did Zhang Fei actually go? Who is the person he wants to meet?"

"Ancestor Jieyi, Zhang Fei never explained to us about the place or the person’s identity, so we have no answers for you." Luo Jieyi and the other four didn’t believe Luo Fenghan, and they felt that he was deliberately hiding information about the two of them at his son-in-law’s request. "It’s up to you to believe it or not, but we really don’t know anything about either of them."
Huang Xiaoyi shook her head helplessly as they looked at her, and she looked at Qi Qingxiu, curious about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying were walking side by side into the Era of the Beginning. "Do you want to have a child with your husband, sister-in-law?"
"Eh?" Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei, repeatedly blinking her eyes. "Why do you ask that, brother-in-law?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Judging by your pale face, I’m sure you’ve been spending too much time in the outside world with my brother-in-law. Moreover, our parents-in-law couldn’t wait to have a grandchild, so I assume you couldn’t wait to have a child with him."

Bing Xingying shyly lowered her face. "I want to have a child with my husband, but I haven’t gotten pregnant, even though we’ve been married for so many years. Big sister told me that a spirit like me has difficulty getting pregnant, and it will be even more difficult for me to get pregnant because my husband is human."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If you are really ready to have a child, I might be able to help you and my brother-in-law have one soon."
"Eh?" Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei again. "Can you really help me get pregnant, brother-in-law?"
Zhang Fei nodded in response. "After we get back, we’ll go see my brother-in-law directly, and I’ll help you get pregnant with his child."
"I don’t know how you’re going to help me get pregnant, but I thank you, brother-in-law."
"No need for thank you, right? We are family, so I will be happy to assist you."

Soon, they arrived at the final room of the Era of the Beginning, and the woman was waiting for them there. {Do you want to ask me about the location of the portal to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, Zhang Fei?}
"Can you show me the location?"

{I can.} The woman flicked a finger at Zhang Fei’s forehead, and some information immediately appeared in her mind. {Your previous guess was correct, and the giant Yin-Yang Lotus can connect you to the Lotus Limbo World. However, I forbid you from entering that place given your current strength; otherwise, you will never be able to leave and will become one of those cursed souls.}

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I’m aware of my strength, so I won’t force myself to go to such a dangerous place. Perhaps, I’ll go there after I evolve into the Ten-Tails and reach the pinnacle of cultivation and demon rank."
{That’s the best choice.}
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. "Can you tell me where Yuan Xiajie took Wang Yin?"
{Yuan Xiajie is currently in the Ancient Realm, while Wang Yin is in the Paradise Realm with several others.}
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "Where is Wang Yin now? Who are the people with her?"
{Wang Yin is in the Endless Domain, and she is cultivating there. As for the people with her, you’ve met some of them before.}

Zhang Fei immediately thought of two people. "Bian Zhizhu and Nong Qinhua, right? However, I didn’t expect that Yuan Xiajie would bring the latter to this realm, especially since she is the daughter-in-law of the Yin Clan of the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
{Nong Qinhua is indeed their daughter-in-law, but she is Yuan Xiajie’s puppet like Wang Yin and Bian Zhizhu, and she will not be able to refuse her order.}

"The Endless Domain, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "I already had plans to go to that domain, and I’ve become even more eager to go since Wang Yin is there. Can you please help me stop Yuan Xiajie?"
{I won’t help you with that matter, and you must use your own strength to defeat Yuan Xiajie.}
"I understand." Zhang Fei asked her another question. "Can you help me open a portal to the Zenith Solar Sanctum?"

The woman shook her head at Zhang Fei. {You already possess the key to access the Zenith Solar Sanctum, and you just need to wait for Tian Taiyang’s soul power to recover while also working on increasing your own strength; therefore, I won’t assist you with that.}
"Alright then." Zhang Fei looked at Bing Xingying. "Let’s go back, Sister-in-law."
"Big Sis, I’ll bring Zhang Fei back." After the woman nodded, Bing Xingying immediately took Zhang Fei into the void.
The woman pondered for a moment before sighing softly and disappearing from the place.
"Wife? Why did you bring your real body out of the void?" Luo Zhenyu asked in concern as he pulled Bing Xingying to sit beside him. "You should go back inside now, or you’ll weaken if you stay here."
Bing Xingying smiled as she listened to her husband’s concern. "Husband, our brother-in-law told me that he has a way to help me get pregnant, so I brought him here to see you."
"Can you really help my wife get pregnant, brother-in-law?" Luo Zhenyu asked with full expectation.
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "I can do that, but you two have to do something first."
"What should we do, brother-in-law?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed. "Hey! You two know how a woman can get pregnant, right?"

He immediately realized something before smiling teasingly, causing her to lower her embarrassed face.
"Do you want to go there now, brother-in-law?"
"The sooner the better." Zhang Fei nodded at Bing Xingying.
A moment later, a small crack appeared in front of them and sucked Zhang Fei into it directly, shocking Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Wangzi, who had never seen that before.
"My real body took my brother-in-law to his destination," Bing Xingying explained briefly.
"Father, mother, and ancestors, I’m not feeling well, so I’ll go back now."
"Take a rest, Xingying."
After Bing Xingying left, Luo Jieyi questioned Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.
"Where did Zhang Fei actually go?
Who is the person he wants to meet?"

"Ancestor Jieyi, Zhang Fei never explained to us about the place or the person’s identity, so we have no answers for you." Luo Jieyi and the other four didn’t believe Luo Fenghan, and they felt that he was deliberately hiding information about the two of them at his son-in-law’s request.
"It’s up to you to believe it or not, but we really don’t know anything about either of them."
Huang Xiaoyi shook her head helplessly as they looked at her, and she looked at Qi Qingxiu, curious about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying were walking side by side into the Era of the Beginning.
"Do you want to have a child with your husband, sister-in-law?"
"Eh?" Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei, repeatedly blinking her eyes.
"Why do you ask that, brother-in-law?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly.
"Judging by your pale face, I’m sure you’ve been spending too much time in the outside world with my brother-in-law.
Moreover, our parents-in-law couldn’t wait to have a grandchild, so I assume you couldn’t wait to have a child with him."
Bing Xingying shyly lowered her face.
"I want to have a child with my husband, but I haven’t gotten pregnant, even though we’ve been married for so many years.
Big sister told me that a spirit like me has difficulty getting pregnant, and it will be even more difficult for me to get pregnant because my husband is human."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"If you are really ready to have a child, I might be able to help you and my brother-in-law have one soon."
"Eh?" Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei again.
"Can you really help me get pregnant, brother-in-law?"
Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"After we get back, we’ll go see my brother-in-law directly, and I’ll help you get pregnant with his child."
"I don’t know how you’re going to help me get pregnant, but I thank you, brother-in-law."
"No need for thank you, right?
We are family, so I will be happy to assist you."

Soon, they arrived at the final room of the Era of the Beginning, and the woman was waiting for them there. {Do you want to ask me about the location of the portal to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, Zhang Fei?}
"Can you show me the location?"

{I can.} The woman flicked a finger at Zhang Fei’s forehead, and some information immediately appeared in her mind. {Your previous guess was correct, and the giant Yin-Yang Lotus can connect you to the Lotus Limbo World.
However, I forbid you from entering that place given your current strength; otherwise, you will never be able to leave and will become one of those cursed souls.}
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I’m aware of my strength, so I won’t force myself to go to such a dangerous place.
Perhaps, I’ll go there after I evolve into the Ten-Tails and reach the pinnacle of cultivation and demon rank."
{That’s the best choice.}
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something.
"Can you tell me where Yuan Xiajie took Wang Yin?"
{Yuan Xiajie is currently in the Ancient Realm, while Wang Yin is in the Paradise Realm with several others.}
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.
"Where is Wang Yin now?
Who are the people with her?"
{Wang Yin is in the Endless Domain, and she is cultivating there.
As for the people with her, you’ve met some of them before.}
Zhang Fei immediately thought of two people.
"Bian Zhizhu and Nong Qinhua, right?
However, I didn’t expect that Yuan Xiajie would bring the latter to this realm, especially since she is the daughter-in-law of the Yin Clan of the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
{Nong Qinhua is indeed their daughter-in-law, but she is Yuan Xiajie’s puppet like Wang Yin and Bian Zhizhu, and she will not be able to refuse her order.}
"The Endless Domain, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself.
"I already had plans to go to that domain, and I’ve become even more eager to go since Wang Yin is there.
Can you please help me stop Yuan Xiajie?"
{I won’t help you with that matter, and you must use your own strength to defeat Yuan Xiajie.}
"I understand." Zhang Fei asked her another question.
"Can you help me open a portal to the Zenith Solar Sanctum?"

The woman shook her head at Zhang Fei. {You already possess the key to access the Zenith Solar Sanctum, and you just need to wait for Tian Taiyang’s soul power to recover while also working on increasing your own strength; therefore, I won’t assist you with that.}
"Alright then." Zhang Fei looked at Bing Xingying.
"Let’s go back, Sister-in-law."
"Big Sis, I’ll bring Zhang Fei back." After the woman nodded, Bing Xingying immediately took Zhang Fei into the void.
The woman pondered for a moment before sighing softly and disappearing from the place.
"Wife?
Why did you bring your real body out of the void?" Luo Zhenyu asked in concern as he pulled Bing Xingying to sit beside him.
"You should go back inside now, or you’ll weaken if you stay here."
Bing Xingying smiled as she listened to her husband’s concern.
"Husband, our brother-in-law told me that he has a way to help me get pregnant, so I brought him here to see you."
"Can you really help my wife get pregnant, brother-in-law?" Luo Zhenyu asked with full expectation.
Zhang Fei nodded at him.
"I can do that, but you two have to do something first."
"What should we do, brother-in-law?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed.
"Hey!
You two know how a woman can get pregnant, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1349: Ashen Lotus Monastery
paragraphs: Luo Zhenyu was stunned by that, and Bing Xingying lowered her red face in embarrassment.

Zhang Fei took out a large, thick cloth and handed it to them. "I can only do it as soon as you release your fluid inside her, so you two should do it here, and you can use the cloth to cover your lower bodies."
"Wife." Bing Xingying nodded to Luo Zhenyu, but she was embarrassed to do such a thing with Zhang Fei in front of them. "Brother-in-law, I need your help."
"I know."
Luo Zhenyu pulled Bing Xingying onto his lap, covered their lower bodies with the cloth, and prepared themselves.
"Ready?"
Both Luo Zhenyu and Bing Xingying nodded to Zhang Fei. "We are ready."
Zhang Fei grabbed their shoulders and used his demon touch on them, causing Luo Zhenyu and Bing Xingying to moan and become aroused. "Do it now."
"Wife." Luo Zhenyu whispered to Bing Xingying with heavy breaths.
"Uhm." Bing Xingying nodded slightly at Luo Zhenyu, and her heart skipped a beat. She buried her face in his chest and tightly shut her mouth, feeling embarrassed.
Zhang Fei closed his eyes to avoid making Bing Xingying feel more embarrassed, but the next moment he could hear her soft moan as Luo Zhenyu penetrated her. "Both of you have to release it now."
"It’s done."
"Me too."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly, pressed his palm against Bing Xingying’s stomach, and used the reproduction manipulation ability on her. He could have used his ability to make her pregnant without mating, but the result would be different because her child would be fatherless, like when Lillea gave birth to Janette in the past. Therefore, he needed Luo Zhenyu’s sperm to help him conceive a child that would be biologically theirs.
A while later, Zhang Fei pulled his hand back. "You two can’t feel it now because it’s still the earliest stage, but you will be able to see the signs of her pregnancy in a few days."
"Am I really pregnant now, brother-in-law?" Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei.
Luo Zhenyu also looked at Zhang Fei. "Is that one of your demon abilities, brother-in-law?"

"I got my ability after I evolved into a lust demon monarch." Zhang Fei then answered Bing Xingying. "Sister-in-law, I guarantee that you are pregnant now, and you just need to wait until the signs of your pregnancy appear by themselves. Since you have difficulty getting pregnant normally, I suggest you both reduce your sexual activity, and you can do it again after your pregnancy is mature."
Bing Xingying’s face turned extremely red as smoke billowed out of her head, and she buried her face into her husband’s chest once again with a smile full of happiness on her face.
"Brother-in-law, I—"
"No need." Zhang Fei then walked out. "I have to go now."

As soon as Zhang Fei left the room, Luo Zhenyu lifted Bing Xingying’s face to look at him and gently kissed her lips. "I can’t wait for the results, wife. I won’t tell our parents about this matter for now, but I will tell them once your pregnancy symptoms appear, and I’m sure they’ll be overjoyed if they find out you’re pregnant."
"Uhm." Big Xingying nodded to him. "I sincerely hope I’m pregnant now, especially since I’ve wanted a child from you for a long time, husband."

"Haha." Luo Zhenyun laid Bing Xingying onto the bed and pinned her beneath him. "I have long wanted to have children with you, wife. I don’t know how our brother-in-law’s abilities work, but I believe he would never lie to us, and you should really be pregnant by now."
Big Xingying smiled at that. "Let’s do it once, and I’ll return to the void after we’re done."
"Alright."
"Why are you smiling to yourself, husband?" Qing Qiu’er asked as Zhang Fei entered the main hall.
"Haha." Zhang Fei replied to Qing Qiu’er with a laugh before looking at Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. "Wait for a few days; there will be a big surprise for you two."
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi exchanged confused glances before asking again. "What do you mean by that, son? What kind of surprise are you referring to?"

"It’s no fun if I tell you two now, and you’ll just have to wait a few days to find out what the surprise is." Zhang Fei turned to Luo Yunxiao, who had just returned. "I’ve found the portal to enter the Ashen Lotus Monastery, so we’ll go there now."

Zhang Fei did not explain the details to them, and he hurriedly led the women out of the hall. Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi exchanged glances before hurriedly leaving the hall, with the five Luo Ancestors following behind them.

"Huh?" Qing Qiu’er turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you sure the portal is in this forest, husband? In the past, I accidentally entered the portal in this forest too, and I’ve checked this entire area countless times to no avail."

Zhang Fei nodded and explained. "The portal never moves from this forest, but you and the others can’t see it. By the way, release your soul now, and we must form the true Yin-Yang Lotus to activate the portal."
"Do we need to do that too, husband?" Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan asked.
"No need." Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er released their souls before starting to merge the black and white lotuses in their souls to form the true Yin-Yang Lotus.

Qi Qingxiu was astonished as she watched the black and white lotuses begin to merge. ’Is this the soul cultivation technique of the Moonlit Passion Sect? Their lotuses contain a lot of their soul power, so I’m sure they are the result of a soul cultivation technique.’

The five Luo Ancestors also watched the two lotuses seriously, occasionally glancing at Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er. Their ancestors had entered the Ashen Lotus Monastery in the past, but they hadn’t found the soul cultivation technique, only the Lotus Heart Sutra within.

Sometime later, a black and white Yin-Yang Lotus appeared before their eyes, causing tremors in the area below them. Soon, they saw a portal appear in the middle of the forest, and a light pillar shot out from it, piercing the sky.
"Unbelievable! This portal is really here!" Luo Zhigui and the other four exclaimed, and they hurriedly entered it.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi could only sigh at their behavior, and they did not immediately follow their ancestors; instead, they waited for Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er.
"Such greedy and foolish old people." Zhang Fei commented after he returned his soul into his body, and he immediately led them into the portal. "Let’s go in."

As soon as they walked out of the portal, they arrived at a vast expansion of garden filled with many types of trees and plants. A little further ahead, they could see the entire area of the Ashen Lotus Monastery, but most of the building was ruined.

The Ashen Lotus Monastery is located in the middle of the vast, desolate expanse of the plateau. From the distance, the building looks like a crumbling silhouette. Despite their distance, they can see many broken outer walls, collapsed gates, and scattered statues around the area.

From the distance, the monastery exudes an aura of quiet power and the lingering presence of the past. The surrounding terrain is steep and slippery, filled with cracked, overgrown vegetation and winding stone steps leading to the monastery. Cliffs, boulders and shallow crevices form a natural barrier around the ruins, with pools of stagnant water reflecting the bright sky above.
"Huge!" They shouted loudly in awe, except for Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi, who had already seen that place from the memories of their past ancestors.
Qing Qiu’er spoke to Zhang Fei directly. "Back then, I didn’t appear in the outer area like now; instead, I appeared directly in the inner area, where I encountered the giant Yin-Yang Lotus."
"I see." Zhang Fei scanned the area while examining the map. "It seems the portal brought us in randomly because those five old fools aren’t here now."
"Let’s go there now, son." Luo Fengyan spoke. "However, we can only walk to get there because there’s a formation that restricts flying here."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately led them through the broken streets, and they saw many small beasts running around the area.
After they walked for some time, they finally arrived at the main gate of the Ashen Lotus Monastery.

The gate, once a grand and imposing entrance, now lies in ruins. It is flanked by statues of lotus flowers and fallen guardian stones, many half-buried in ash, moss and vines. The massive stone pillars, carved with intricate lotus motifs, are chipped and cracked, some leaning precariously as if defying gravity.
The wooden gate that once opened to welcome the students was crumbling and rotting, with broken wooden beams scattered throughout the courtyard.
Jia Yuyan suddenly hugged Zhang Fei’s arm. "Husband, this place is creepy, and I can sense many unusual auras coming from the areas inside."
Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, Qi Qingxiu, and Luo Yunxiao agreed with Jia Yuyan, as they too could sense the unusual auras.
Even Qing Qiu’er, who had entered the place in the past, looked a little frightened, sending shivers down her spine.

Huang Xiaoyi also reacted the same as them, and she hugged Luo Fenghan’s arm very tightly. "Husband, we must find our ancestors as quickly as possible, or we will be in big trouble if something bad happens to them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1350: The History
paragraphs: The moment they passed through the main gate, Zhang Fei immediately froze in place, and his eyes turned blank.
"Husband!" Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, and Jia Yuyan shouted as they stood before Zhang Fei. "What happened to him? Why did he suddenly become like this?"

Qi Qingxiu immediately observed Zhang Fei’s face before speaking to them. "You guys don’t need to worry about him because there’s nothing wrong with him, and he seems to have seen something we can’t see here."

"I agree with you, Demon God Qingxiu." Tian Huangjin stood behind Zhang Fei, pressed her palm to his back, and tried to wake him up to no avail. "I can’t wake him up, so I think we shouldn’t go into the inner area yet, and we should wait for him to wake up first."
Tianshi Shengjie scanned the area around them. "What did Zhang Fei actually see in this place? Why was he the only one who could see it?"

"I think it has something to do with past civilizations in this place." Nalan Wangzi spoke, looking at the surrounding area. "This place is like a domain within a domain, and it’s almost the same size as my domain. Strangely, there are no other buildings apart from this monastery, which leads me to believe that the people who once lived here concentrated their population in this area."

Huang Xiaoyi turned to Luo Fenghan, who nodded to her. She immediately spoke to the others. "You guys have to wait here until our son-in-law wakes up, and we will go look for our ancestors in the inner area."
"Mother, but—"
"I’ll go with them." Qi Qingxiu walked beside Huang Xiaoyi and Luo Fenghan. "This place is indeed mysterious, but I’m sure there’s nothing dangerous here, so I’m sure we’ll be fine."
"Let’s go." After that, Qi Qingxiu, Huang Xiaoyi, and Luo Fenghan walked towards the first building right in front of the main gate.
Although the building was ruined, most of its walls still stood tall, and the shape was still visible, indicating that it was the first hall of the Ashen Lotus Monastery.
Luo Yunxiao released a soft sigh as she looked at Zhang Fei again. "Old fox, I know you can hear me; can you come out to meet us?"
*Swoosh*

Soon, Hu Tianlang’s benevolent soul emerged from Zhang Fei’s body, surprising Qing Qiu’er and the other three. "You don’t need to worry about this kid, Yunxiao. Nalan Wangzi’s guess just now was correct, and he did see the ancient civilization in this domain."

"Do you know anything about this domain, Senior? Who exactly were the people who lived in this domain in the past? How is this domain connected to the Empyrean Main Domain?" Tian Huangjin and the others asked at the same time.

Hu Tianlang let out a soft sigh as he looked ahead. "As you’ve heard before, Qing Qiu’er found the giant Yin-Yang Lotus here, and the lotus is its main core. In fact, this domain was once part of the Ancient Realm, and people from the past called it the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, which connected two different worlds created by the lotus. This monastery was once the hub between the two worlds, and the people who used to live in this domain were the lotus protectors."
"Huh? They were shocked after hearing that the domain was once part of the Ancient Realm.
Luo Yunxiao then asked. "Is this domain separate from the Ancient Realm now, Old Fox?"

"No." Hu Tianlang shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "This domain is still connected to the Ancient Realm, just like the Forgotten Land, the Endless Night Dungeon, and the Zenith Solar Sanctum, which are also connected to that realm. If Zhang Fei wants to go to the Ancient Realm in the future, this domain is his best choice, but he needs an item to open the path. However, the item doesn’t seem to be here anymore, so he has to look for it elsewhere."
"What kind of places are you referring to, Senior?" Jia Yuyan asked.

"Do you guys know the Yin-Yang principle?" All of them nodded at Hu Tianlang. "Night and day are born from Yin and Yang, and so are evil and good. Those two places are also born from Yin and Yang, and the Yin place is—"
"The Lotus Limbo World."

"That’s right." Hu Tianlang nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "The place born from the Yang is the Lotus Luminous World, which is the opposite of the Lotus Limbo World. Those who failed to defy the cycle of reincarnation, or those who went astray in their cultivation journey, will be sent to the Lotus Limbo World. Those who succeeded in defying the cycle of reincarnation, or those who succeeded in gaining enlightenment on their path of cultivation, will be sent to the Lotus Luminous World."
"Does that mean the Lotus Luminous World is the heavens?"
"No." Hu Tianlang denied Tian Huangjin with a shake of his head. "The heavens have no form, and no one has ever seen them, not even my original self."
"Then, what kind of place is the Lotus Luminous World?"

Hu Tianlang explained immediately. "The Lotus Luminous World is a place where enlightened souls live, free from doubt and despair. They have the opportunity to be reincarnated, but they choose not to take that chance; instead, they prefer to live in that place because it is free from evil, burdens, and worldly emotions."
"Doesn’t that mean the Lotus Luminous World and the Lotus Limbo World are false worlds?"

"Both worlds are like false worlds, but they are also real." Hu Tianlang nodded to Tian Huangjin. "The giant Yin-Yang Lotus that Qing Qiu’er encountered in the past directly connects the two worlds, and my original self once entered both of these worlds; however, I do not know who or what created the lotus or the two worlds. The lotus contains immense power from both worlds, and the people of the past who lived in this domain increased their strength by absorbing its power."
"That means—"
